Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130008}<color=#FFD780FF>Return to Oblivion</color>{/LINK}: Each Death's Crossing stack also increases Skirk's ATK by 10%/20%/40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Return to Oblivion.

10000114.name: End of Wishes
10000114.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11142}<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Warp</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000114.name: To the Source
10000114.description:
Each Void Rift Skirk absorbs via the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130007}<color=#FFD780FF>Reason Beyond Reason</color>{/LINK} will grant her 1 Havoc: Sever stack. She can consume such stacks to initiate coordinated attacks and decrease the DMG she takes while in {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode. These stacks last for 15s, and each stack's duration is counted independently (max 3 stacks).
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Reason Beyond Reason."

<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color>
· When Skirk uses the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Ruin</color>, she will consume all <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stacks to initiate a coordinated attack in which each <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will deal 750% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
· When she uses Normal Attacks while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will be consumed when her third or fifth sequenced attacks hit an opponent to launch 3 coordinated attacks. Each coordinated attack deals 180% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This damage is considered Normal Attack DMG.
· When Skirk takes DMG while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will be consumed to decrease this DMG instance by 80% and attack nearby opponents 3 times, with each attack dealing 180% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.

10000115.name: Infallible Procession
10000115.description: Each time Dahlia gains 1 of his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Benison stacks, he will regain 2.5 Elemental Energy.

10000115.name: Revelation of Mercy
10000115.description: After Dahlia consumes his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Benison stacks to summon a Shield of Sacred Favor, the character protected by said Shield will gain 25% increased Shield Strength for 12s.

10000115.name: Windblume Offertory
10000115.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000115.name: Collect of the Assembly
10000115.description: The Favonian Favor from Dahlia's Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color> lasts 3 more seconds.

10000115.name: Let It Be Subtly So
10000115.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11152}Immersive Ordinance{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000115.name: You Shall Go Out With Joy
10000115.description:
The current active character affected by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Favonian Favor has their ATK SPD increased by 10%.
Additionally, when an active character affected by Favonian Favor falls, immediately:
· Revive them.
· Restore their HP to 100%.
This effect can trigger once every 15 minutes.

10000116.name: Rectifying Processor
10000116.description: When Ineffa activates her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, all nearby party members will gain the Carrier Flow Composite effect for 20s: Increases Lunar-Charged DMG by 2.5% for every 100 ATK that Ineffa has, up to a maximum of 50%.

10000116.name: Support Cleaning Module
10000116.description:
After the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11165}Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator{/LINK}</color> hits opponents, it will inflict the Punishment Edict status on one of those hit opponents: After a brief delay, or when this opponent is defeated, nearby opponents will take <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 300% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Additionally, when the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator</color> is unleashed, nearby party members will gain Optical Flow Shield Barriers.

10000116.name: Enhanced Emotion Emulator
10000116.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11162}Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000116.name: The Edictless Path
10000116.description: When your own party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, recover 5 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 4s.

10000116.name: Mirror's Dream Transcension
10000116.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11165}Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000116.name: A Dawning Morn for You
10000116.description: When Ineffa is affected by the Carrier Flow Composite effect, she will deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 135% of her ATK to opponents in the current active character's vicinity after nearby thunderclouds release bursts of lightning at opponents. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 3.5s.

10000119.name: "O Lips, Weave Me Songs and Psalms"
10000119.description:
After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color> or her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11195}Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon{/LINK}</color>, she will gain Threads of Life for 20s.
During this time, when nearby party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, nearby active characters will recover HP equal to 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 1.9s.
Additionally, the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form will be reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration will be extended by 5s.

10000119.name: "Twine Warnings and Tales From the North"
10000119.description:
The Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11195}Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon{/LINK}</color> is enhanced:
· {LINK#N11190003}<color=#FFD780FF>Pale Hymn</color>{/LINK} effects are increased: All nearby party members' Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG is further increased by 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery, and their Lunar-Bloom DMG is further increased by 400% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is increased by 40%.

10000119.name: "Seek Not to Tread the Sly Fox's Path"
10000119.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11195}Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000119.name: "Nor Yearn for the Great Bear's Might"
10000119.description: When attacks from the {LINK#N11190001}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostgrove Sanctuary</color>{/LINK} summoned by her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color> hit opponents, Lauma will regain 4 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

10000119.name: "If Truth May Be Subject to Witness"
10000119.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000119.name: "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight"
10000119.description:
When the {LINK#N11190001}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostgrove Sanctuary</color>{/LINK} attacks opponents, it will deal 1 additional instance of <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> equal to 185% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. This instance of DMG will not consume any {LINK#N11190003}<color=#FFD780FF>Pale Hymn</color>{/LINK} stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner.
This effect can occur up to 8 times during each Frostgrove Sanctuary. When using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color>, all Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner will be removed.

Additionally, when Lauma uses a Normal Attack while she has Pale Hymn stacks, she will consume 1 stack to convert this to deal <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> equal to 150% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%.

10000120.name: Part the Veil of Snow
10000120.description:
The basic cooldown of the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color> is reduced to 4s.
Additionally, when party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, Flins will recover 8 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 5.5s.

10000120.name: The Devil's Wall
10000120.description:
For the next 6s after using the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>, when Flins's next Normal Attack hits an opponent, it will deal an additional 50% of Flins's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: While Flins is on the field, after his <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> attacks hit an opponent, that opponent's <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> will be decreased by 25% for 7s.

10000120.name: Stranger in the Night
10000120.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11205}<color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000120.name: Night on Bald Mountain
10000120.description:
Flins's ATK is increased by 20%.
Additionally, his Ascension Talent {LINK#P1202201}<color=#FFD780FF>Whispering Flame</color>{/LINK} is enhanced: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 10% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 220.

10000120.name: Exile's Shadow
10000120.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11202}<color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Rite: Arcane Light</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000120.name: Songs and Dances of Death
10000120.description:
The DMG dealt to opponents by Flins's Lunar-Charged reactions is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 35%.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: All nearby party members' Lunar-Charged DMG is <color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color> by 10%.

10000121.name: The Theory of Ash—Field Equilibrium
10000121.description:
After Aino uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11212}Musecatcher{/LINK}</color> or her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color>, her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s.

The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.

10000121.name: The Principle of Transference in Gear Differentials
10000121.description: If Aino is off-field while the <color=#FFD780FF>Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone</color> of her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color> is active, when your active party member hits a nearby opponent with an attack, the <color=#FFD780FF>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> will fire an additional water ball at that opponent, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> equal to 25% of Aino's ATK and 100% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

10000121.name: Cake and the Art of Mechanism Repair
10000121.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000121.name: Butter and Cats and the Law of Energy Supply
10000121.description: When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11212}Musecatcher{/LINK}</color> hits an opponent, it will restore 10 Elemental Energy for Aino. Energy can be restored to her in this manner once every 10s.

10000121.name: Perpetual Turbine of Metal and Light
10000121.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11212}Musecatcher{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000121.name: The Burden of Creative Genius
10000121.description:
For the next 15s after using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color>, DMG from nearby active characters' Electro-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize reactions is increased by 15%.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: DMG from the aforementioned reactions will be further increased by 20%.

10000122.name: Planning Breeds Success
10000122.description: The Base DMG for Lunar-Bloom reactions caused by Nefer's {LINK#N11220002}<color=#FFD780FF>Phantasm Performance</color>{/LINK} is increased by 60% of her Elemental Mastery. This effect is also boosted by {LINK#N11220003}<color=#FFD780FF>Veil of Falsehood</color>{/LINK}.

10000122.name: Observation Feeds Strategy
10000122.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#P1222101}<color=#FFD780FF>A Wager of Moonlight</color>{/LINK}: Extends {LINK#N11220003}<color=#FFD780FF>Veil of Falsehood</color>{/LINK}'s duration by 5s, and increases its stack limit to 5, as well as causing {LINK#N11220002}<color=#FFD780FF>Phantasm Performance</color>{/LINK} to deal up to 140% of its original DMG. When Nefer unleashes her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11222}Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights{/LINK}</color>, she will instantly gain 2 stacks of Veil of Falsehood. Additionally, when Veil of Falsehood reaches 5 stacks, or when the fifth stack's duration is refreshed, Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 200 for 8s instead.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "A Wager of Moonlight."

10000122.name: Deceit Cloaks the Truth
10000122.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11222}Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000122.name: Delusion Ensnares Reason
10000122.description:
When Nefer is on the field and in the {LINK#N11220001}<color=#FFD780FF>Shadow Dance</color>{/LINK} state, you will gain Verdant Dew 25% faster.
Additionally, while Nefer is in the Shadow Dance state, nearby opponents will have their <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> decreased by 20%. When Nefer exits the Shadow Dance state or after she strays a certain distance away from the opponents, this effect will be removed after 4.5s.

10000122.name: Opportunity Hides in the Margins
10000122.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11225}Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000122.name: Victory Flows from the Turning of Tides
10000122.description:
When Nefer unleashes {LINK#N11220002}<color=#FFD780FF>Phantasm Performance</color>{/LINK}, the second stage of DMG dealt by herself will be converted to deal <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> equal to 85% of her Elemental Mastery. Additionally, when the attacks from Phantasm Performance end, an extra instance of <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> equal to 120% of Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be dealt. All of the aforementioned DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG dealt by Phantasm Performance.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>
Nefer's Lunar-Bloom DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 15%.

10000123.name: Adamah's Redemption
10000123.description:
After casting his Elemental Burst, Durin's effects will vary depending on the form of his Elemental Burst:
· <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color>: All other nearby party members gain 20 stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Cycle of Enlightenment</color> lasting 20s. When nearby active characters deal Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst DMG, 1 stack of Cycle of Enlightenment will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 60% of Durin's ATK. Stack counts for characters in the party who have Cycle of Enlightenment are managed individually.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder</color>: Durin gains 20 stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Cycle of Enlightenment</color> lasting 20s. When Durin deals Elemental Burst DMG, 2 stacks of Cycle of Enlightenment will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Durin's ATK.

When an Elemental Burst is used, <color=#FFD780FF>Cycle of Enlightenment</color> stacks will be refreshed.

10000123.name: Unground Visions
10000123.description: For 20s after Durin uses an Elemental Burst, after nearby party members trigger Vaporize, Melt, Burning, Overloaded, Pyro Swirl, or Pyro Crystallize reactions, or deal <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> or <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> to an opponent affected by Burning, all nearby party members gain a 50% increase to their <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> and to the corresponding elemental DMG involved in the reaction for 6s.

10000123.name: Flame Mirror's Revelation
10000123.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11235}Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000123.name: Emanare's Source
10000123.description: Durin's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 40%. Additionally, when effects that consume <color=#FFD780FF>Cycle of Enlightenment</color> stacks are triggered as part of the Constellation <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#T1231}Adamah's Redemption{/LINK}</color>, there is a 30% chance that no Cycle of Enlightenment stacks will be consumed.

10000123.name: Scouring Flame's Sundering
10000123.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11232}Binary Form: Convergence and Division{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000123.name: Dual Birth
10000123.description:
Durin's Elemental Burst DMG ignores 30% of opponents' DEF.
Additionally, Durin's Elemental Bursts <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder</color> are each enhanced:
· After <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of White Flame</color> hit an opponent, that opponent's DEF is decreased by 30% for 6s.
· DMG from <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of Dark Decay</color> will ignore an additional 40% of opponents' DEF.

10000124.name: One More Flask!
10000124.description: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Fluffy Meowball</color> fired by the {LINK#N11240001}<color=#FFD780FF>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils</color> hits an enemy, there is a 50% chance for it to bounce, dealing the corresponding Elemental DMG to nearby opponents.

10000124.name: Rogue's Quick Thinking
10000124.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: In the Ascension Talent {LINK#P1242101}<color=#FFD780FF>"Plan to Get Paid,"</color>{/LINK} Jahoda can secretly track, in addition to the element with the highest number of characters, the element with the next highest number of characters among the remaining types. This allows up to two elemental effects to be active at once. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Plan to Get Paid."

10000124.name: Desperate Gamble
10000124.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11245}Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000124.name: Wild Berry Amid the Dust
10000124.description: When a {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> undergoes an Elemental Conversion, Jahoda will recover 4 Elemental Energy.

10000124.name: The Greatest Treasure
10000124.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11242}Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000124.name: The Littlest Luck
10000124.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: After the {LINK#N11240001}<color=#FFD780FF>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils</color> is full, nearby Moonsign characters in your party have their CRIT Rate increased by 5% and CRIT DMG increased by 40% for 20s.

10000125.name: Radiance Over Blossoms and Peaks
10000125.description:
Unleashing her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Eternal Tides</color> will immediately trigger an effect equivalent to the effect of {LINK#N11250001}<color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Interference</color>{/LINK}. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>
When Gravity Interference is triggered, if the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Charged</color>: Your current active character will recover 6 Energy.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Bloom</color>: Your active character's interruption resistance will be increased for 8s.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Crystallize</color>: Summons a <color=#FFD780FF>Rainsea Shield</color>. The Rainsea Shield's DMG absorption is based on 12% of Columbina's Max HP, and it will absorb <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness for 8s.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 1.5%.

10000125.name: Not in Lone Splendor
10000125.description:
Rate of accumulating {LINK#N11250001}<color=#FFD780FF>Gravity</color>{/LINK} increases by 34%. 
When <color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Interference</color> is triggered, Columbina will receive the <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Brilliance</color> effect, which increases her Max HP by 40% for 8s.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Brilliance</color> is active, if, during the current trigger of <color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Interference</color>, the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Charged</color>: ATK of your current active character increases. Increase in ATK is equal to 1% of Columbina's Max HP.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Bloom</color>: Elemental Mastery of your current active character increases. Increase in Elemental Mastery is equal to 0.35% of Columbina's Max HP.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Crystallize</color>: DEF of your current active character increases. Increase in DEF is equal to 1% of Columbina's Max HP.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 7%.

10000125.name: Dreamlike Glow Across Tranquil Waters
10000125.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11252}Eternal Tides{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 1.5%.

10000125.name: Cloudveiled Ridges in Floral Mists
Silence Tending One Lone Song
10000125.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11255}Moonlit Melancholy{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 1.5%.

10000125.name: Through Darkness Led by Moonlight
10000125.description:
For 8s after characters in the {LINK#N11250002}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Domain</color>{/LINK} trigger a Lunar reaction, based on the elements involved in the reaction, the CRIT DMG of the corresponding Elemental DMG done by all party members is increased by 80%. The CRIT DMG-increasing effects for the same Elemental Type do not stack.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 7%.

10000126.name: Burst Forth With Vigor, But Enter in Silence
10000126.description:
After using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color>, Zibai will immediately gain 100 {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color>{/LINK}, and the max number of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> usages per <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color> mode is increased to 5 times.
Additionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.

10000126.name: At Birth Are Souls Born, and in Death Leave But Husks
10000126.description:
When in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1262101}The Selenic Adeptus Descends{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Selenic Adeptus Descends."

10000126.name: Free From Constraints and Worldly Ties
10000126.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000126.name: The Spirit Passes, Then Form Follows
10000126.description: While in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> hits opponents, Zibai will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>"Scattermoon Splendor"</color> effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

10000126.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not
10000126.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11265}Tri-Sphere Eminence{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000126.name: The World, A Journey in Passing
10000126.description:
While Zibai is in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, her <color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color> gain rate is increased by 50%.
Additionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevate</color>{/LINK} the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.

10000127.name: Vigilant Sentinel
10000127.description: After Illuga triggers a <color=#FFE699FF>Geo-related Reaction</color> on the field, he will regain 12 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s.

10000127.name: Elk With Fanged Antlers
10000127.description: When Elemental Burst {LINK#S11275}<color=#FFD780FF>Shadowless Reflection</color>{/LINK}'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, for every 7 stacks of {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK} consumed, Illuga will summon Aedon, dealing a single instance of <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to 1 nearby opponent. The DMG dealt is based on 400% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery and 200% of his DEF. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

10000127.name: Earthshaking Maw
10000127.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000127.name: Solarhunting Wolf
10000127.description: When Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color>'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, nearby active party members will have their DEF increased by 200.

10000127.name: Hurricane Steed
10000127.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}Dawnbearing Songbird{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000127.name: Nightmare Orioles
10000127.description:
Enhances the Lightkeeper's Oath effect of the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1272101}Torchforger's Covenant{/LINK}</color>: For <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, CRIT DMG is increased by 30%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam:</color>
When characters are affected by Lightkeeper's Oath, Elemental Mastery is increased by 80.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "<color=#FFD780FF>Torchforger's Covenant</color>."

10000128.name: "Come, Friend, Let Us Dance Beneath the Moon's Soft Glow"
10000128.description:
When Varka switches to {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK}, he will obtain an additional use of the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}.
Additionally, after switching to <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, Varka will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Lyrical Libation</color> effect: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>, or when performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, Varka will consume this effect to deal 200% of the original DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>.

10000128.name: "When Dawn Breaks, Our Journey Shall Take Flight"
10000128.description: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, or when performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, Varka will perform an additional strike, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> equal to 800% of Varka's ATK.

10000128.name: "O Friend, Quaff Not the Bitter Wine That Brings Tears of Woe"
10000128.description:
Increases Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11282}Windbound Execution{/LINK}</color> Level by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000128.name: "For None May Take From Us Our Freedom of Song"
10000128.description: When Varka triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, based on the Elemental Types involved in the reaction, all nearby party members gain a 20% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> and the corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.

10000128.name: "Fill High the Cup With Fine Wine, for Tyrants Come and Go"
10000128.description:
Increases Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11285}Northwind Avatar{/LINK}</color> Level by 3.
 Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000128.name: "Beloved Mondstadt, Steadfast You Shall Shine"
10000128.description:
{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} is enhanced:
· For a short time after unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, Tapping on Varka's Elemental Skill or Holding his Normal Attack will not expend any uses of Four Winds' Ascension, and will perform one additional instance of the special Charged Attack, <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>.
· For a short time after performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, tap on Varka's Elemental Skill to unleash an additional instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> without expending any uses of Four Winds' Ascension.
When triggering an additional special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, or unleashing an additional special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, in this manner, the above effect cannot be triggered.

Additionally, the <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> effect in Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1282201}Wind's Vanguard{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: Every stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> will increase Varka's CRIT DMG by 20%.

10000129.name: O Breezes, That So Oft Bear Sorrowful Lament
10000129.description:
Lohen's maximum {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} limit is increased to 300% of its original value.
Additionally, when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, they accumulate 500% as much <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color> for him as they originally would have.

10000129.name: In Flight, I Strike Whatever Flies
10000129.description: When in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, after the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> is unleashed, Lohen gains "Evilsbane Blade" for 4s: The next time Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will follow up with an additional strike that deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> equal to 500% of his ATK, and increase the Elemental Mastery of other nearby party members by 200 for 8s. Evilsbane Blade can be triggered once every 4s.

10000129.name: Only the Spear That Wounds Can Heal
10000129.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11292}Unforeseen Strike{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000129.name: Radiant Love, Laughing Death
10000129.description:
When Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> while in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, his {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} will be maxed out, causing this instance of his Elemental Burst to gain the maximum possible DMG increase.

Additionally, when Lohen switches to <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> mode, the following will occur depending on how much Elemental Energy he has:
· When Elemental Energy is not full: Lohen recovers 15 Elemental Energy.
· When Elemental Energy is full: If, during the next 15s, Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color>, he will recover 15 Elemental Energy.

10000129.name: Never Ask, Nor Trouble You to Know
10000129.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11295}Manifest Judgment{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000129.name: To Drown, to Sink, Unconscious — Supreme Joy
10000129.description:
Using the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} and hitting an opponent with it or, while {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode is active, unleashing the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color>, will not consume any {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK}. Instead, Lohen's {LINK#N11290003}<color=#FFD780FF>Joy</color>{/LINK} will be maxed out, and if he hits an opponent the next time he uses the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>, the duration of this instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> will be extended by 1.25s. This effect can be triggered once every 7s.
Additionally, the CRIT DMG of all the DMG described above is increased by 175%, and the number of times Lohen can unleash <color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color> during this instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> is increased by 2.

10000130.name: Provisional Classification
10000130.description:
When unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color>, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea gains 6 stacks of the <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color> effect for 10s. Max 18 stacks. When nearby party members deal Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, consume 1 stack of Field Catalog to increase the DMG dealt. The increase in DMG is equal to 75% of Linnea's DEF.
Additionally, when Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}</color>, Linnea can consume up to 5 stacks of Field Catalog. Each stack will increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Linnea's DEF.

10000130.name: Tidings of Joy and Sorrow
10000130.description:
Within 8s after triggering Moondrift Harmony, all <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> and <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party members have their CRIT DMG increased by 40%. Additionally, when Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}</color>, the CRIT DMG of that attack increases by an additional 150%. 

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: When Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Heavy Overdrive Hammer</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}</color>, or when she uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her Ultimate Power Form, an instance of Moondrift Harmony will be triggered. For this instance of Moondrift Harmony, all <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> and <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> characters in the party will be considered to have applied their Elements in the reaction.

10000130.name: Eventful Log Page
10000130.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000130.name: Expert Instinct
10000130.description: Within 5s after Moondrift Harmony is triggered, increase the DEF of Linnea and your current active character by 25% respectively. When Linnea is on field, the DEF-increasing effect can be stacked.

10000130.name: Fairyland's Farewell Gift
10000130.description:
Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions{/LINK}</color> increases by 3 Levels.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000130.name: Golden Beagle's Dream
10000130.description:
The effects of the Constellation, <color=#FFD780FF>Provisional Classification</color>, are enhanced: When unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color>, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea will directly gain the maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color> stacks. When consuming <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color>, consume twice the original number of stacks, such that the increase in DMG will be boosted to 150% of the original value.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%.

10000131.name: "Do Not Be Afraid, Child Who Is Loved"
10000131.description:
When the current active character of your own in the party hits an opponent, an additional special "Arcane Projection: Unity" will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type at 600% of their ATK. This DMG will be considered as having been dealt by the corresponding character.
This effect can trigger once every 6s.

10000131.name: "I Will Guide You and Show You the Path You Should Tread"
10000131.description:
Enhances the effects of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11312}Revelation: Uncreated Light{/LINK}</color>: {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK} increases ATK by an additional 300 (which does not count toward this effect's ATK Bonus limit), while {LINK#N11310002}<color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>{/LINK} decreases nearby opponents' Elemental RES based on the corresponding character's Elemental Type by 25%. This effect does not stack for the same Element.
Additionally, when Nicole unleashes her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Revelation: Uncreated Light</color>, nearby active party members will also gain a Shield of Blazing Light.

10000131.name: "A Lamp by Your Side, A Light to Shine the Way"
10000131.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11312}Revelation: Uncreated Light{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000131.name: "Whether Left or Right, No Matter Which Way You Turn"
10000131.description:
When nearby party members have their {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK} upgraded to {LINK#N11310002}<color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>{/LINK}, Nicole also bestows upon them the Pathfinder's Blessing effect for 20s. Each character can gain this effect once every 16s.
The Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG of characters with Pathfinder's Blessing is increased by 70% of Nicole's ATK. This effect will be removed once it has taken effect 8 times or when its duration is over.
When multiple opponents are hit at once, instances of Pathfinder's Blessing are consumed equal to the number of opponents hit. Each character's Pathfinder's Blessing is counted independently.

10000131.name: "You Will Hear My Voice Beside You"
10000131.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11315}Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000131.name: "This Is the Path, Walk It Without Delay"
10000131.description:
When Nicole's {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK} is upgraded to {LINK#N11310002}<color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>{/LINK}, all nearby party members' <color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color> will also be upgraded to <color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>. Once upgraded, <color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color> will no longer revert to <color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>.
Additionally, DMG dealt by characters with <color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color> will ignore 40% of opponents' DEF.

10000132.name: With a Vow to Rescue, the Journey Begins
10000132.description: After the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, Prune will regain 2 Energy. This effect can occur once every 1.8s.

10000132.name: Useful for Cleaning Messy Baggage, Elemental Powers Are Indeed
10000132.description:
During the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color>, when the Witchlure Bell is in Hunter-Seeker mode, Prune gains the Hunt the Witch effect: Prune's ATK increases by 10%, and when the Witchlure Bell and the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it further increases her ATK by 5%. Prune's ATK can be increased by up to 40% in this way.
The original instance of the above effect will be removed if "The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!" is used again during this time.

10000132.name: The Caravan Exits the Mountain Pass, the Scenery Once More Changed
10000132.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000132.name: Looking Back Following the Wind, One's Shadow Still Halved
10000132.description: After the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it will ricochet and land on a nearby opponent, dealing 80% ATK as DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type.

10000132.name: 100 Defeats? No Problem, Tomorrow, We Go Again
10000132.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11322}Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000132.name: And That's the Story! Share It With Your Friends!
10000132.description:
The duration of the Witchlure Bell's Hunter-Seeker mode from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color> is extended by 4s.
Additionally, after party members affected by Tolling Rally trigger any Elemental Reaction, they will cause Prune and the other current active character(s) affected by Tolling Rally to gain 350 ATK for 5s.

10000133.name: Morrow After the Golden Dusk
10000133.description: When in <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> increases at a 50% lower rate, and all party members deal 30% increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

10000133.name: An Heiress Gazed Into the Looking-Glass
10000133.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: Increases CRIT DMG from Charged Attack condensed beams by 40%. Also, each time a beam is fired, CRIT DMG dealt by all condensed beams fired during this <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode period will be further increased by 20%. Max 3 stacks.

10000133.name: Refuse the Wake of Dusk, the Moonlit Yoke
10000133.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11331}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000133.name: In Knowledge Lies the World's True Ground
10000133.description: When Sandrone deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, she will also summon an extra Prismatic Resonance Cannon to fire off a coordinated attack which deals <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> at 125% or 187.5% of her ATK, respectively. This DMG is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, and the effect can occur once every 4s.

10000133.name: Of All Beside, She Takes No Part
10000133.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000133.name: Narcissus Wakes, Her Eyes Upon the Dawn
10000133.description:
When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode, the beam becomes a more powerful <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> at 100% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> attack deals 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. The DMG dealt with this attack, which is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, is equal to:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: 80% of Sandrone's ATK.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: 120% of Sandrone's ATK.
Additionally, all Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Sandrone is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 20%.

10000136.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing
10000136.description:
The maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> additionally creates 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color>.
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.
Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

10000136.name: The Matter That Slumbers Beyond Inertness
10000136.description:
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, all opponents within the <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color> have their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> decreased by 20%.
Additionally, if the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> created is:
·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery;
·Overloaded: Your own active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.

10000136.name: The Knotted String of Invariant Topology
10000136.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11362}<color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000136.name: The Isotopes Born of Decay
10000136.description: <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Cores{/LINK}</color> created by Mitya himself deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 300% of Mitya's Elemental Mastery to nearby opponents for every 5 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> consumed while it is on the field. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

10000136.name: The Periodic Law That Orders All
10000136.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: {LINK#S11361}<color=#FFD780FF>Chain Reaction</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000136.name: Elemental Transition at the Gate of Reason
10000136.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is enhanced. If the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color>:
 · Is in the Steady State: <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> deals 115% of its original DMG.
· Is Overloaded: There is a 34% chance to create 1 new <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color> whenever Mitya consumes a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> with the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11190007}Elevated{/LINK}</color> by 20%.

10000137.name: The Cadence of Suppressive Fire
10000137.description:
Valeriy regenerates 6 Elemental Energy after performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>. For every 10 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> consumed beyond 40 when performing this special Charged Attack, he regenerates an additional 1.5 Elemental Energy. Each time he performs <color=#FFD780FF>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</color>, he can regenerate up to 15 Elemental Energy in this way. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Additionally, each time Valeriy enters combat, the first time he uses his Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color>, he gains an additional amount of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> equal to 150% of the amount normally gained.

10000137.name: Ranks That Charge as One
10000137.description:
All nearby party members gain 100 Elemental Mastery for 18s after Valeriy uses his Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, while protected by a Supercharged Shield, if Valeriy is already at maximum <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, any further <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> he would gain is instead converted into increased DMG Absorption for the shield. Each point of excess <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> increases the Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption by an amount equal to 8% of Valeriy's ATK. Up to 20 excess <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> can be converted in this way.

10000137.name: Vigilance at Close Quarters
10000137.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30601}Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000137.name: Fortitude Unshaken by Attrition
10000137.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>'s limit is increased by 30, and its charging efficiency is increased by 30%.
Additionally, the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1372101}Advance With the Creeping Barrage{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: The maximum amount of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> that can be gained from this Talent after using the Elemental Burst is 104. You must unlock the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>Advance With the Creeping Barrage</color> to gain access to this effect.

10000137.name: Resolve to Divide and Destroy
10000137.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000137.name: The Strength to Breach Enemy Lines
10000137.description: The special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shells</color> from Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30605}Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo{/LINK}</color> are enhanced: Their DMG is increased by 100%, and opponents they hit have the CRIT Rate of <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> they take increased by 10% for 7s. If the <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> taken is Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, that DMG instance's CRIT DMG is also increased by 40%.

10000140.name: Waters in Full Splendor
10000140.description: Each time Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color>, it also increases the ATK of all nearby party members by 0.8% of her Max HP for 5s.

10000140.name: Echoes That Pierce the Snow
10000140.description:
When the <color=#FFD780FF>Horn of Spring's Call</color> from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> attacks the opponent, Vodyanitsa gains the "Two Voices in Black and White" effect which increases the CRIT DMG from <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> dealt by your own currently active party member by 50% for 5s.
If there is a Wandering Vortex present on the field or in the 5s after a Wandering Vortex explodes, the effect changes to: increases the CRIT DMG from Stellar Swirl reaction DMG caused by your own currently active party member by 60% for 5s.
Additionally, the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is enhanced as follows: the duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is extended by 9s.

10000140.name: Song Lingering on a Spring Morning
10000140.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000140.name: Melancholic Voice Upon the Gentle Waters
10000140.description:
When Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color>, an additional effect will be triggered based on the healed character's HP.
· If the character's HP is below 40%: The healing is increased by 50%; and
· If the character's HP is 40% or above: Vodyanitsa's Max HP is increased by 20% for 6s. Max 3 stacks, and each stack's duration is counted independently.

10000140.name: Together, Down Into the Deep
10000140.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11405}Koda: Sink With Thee{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000140.name: Neverending Song of Revelry
10000140.description:
The Constellation <color=#FFD780FF>Echoes That Pierce the Snow</color> is enhanced: "Two Voices in Black and White" now applies to all nearby party members.
Additionally, while the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is active, Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25% while <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> dealt are increased by 60%.

10000143.name: Winter's Farewell Feast
10000143.description:
When in the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430001}Armed for Action{/LINK}</color> mode, Vesna can unleash <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430003}Windborne Sword{/LINK}</color> at the highest level 4 times instead of 3. Also, each time she enters the <color=#FFD780FF>Armed for Action</color> mode, she will not consume <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430002}Sword Essence{/LINK}</color> the first time she uses <color=#FFD780FF>Windborne Sword</color> at the highest level.
Additionally, Vesna deals 20% increased Stellar Swirl reaction DMG when in the <color=#FFD780FF>Armed for Action</color> mode.

10000143.name: Kolo of Spring's Arrival
10000143.description:
The Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1432101}Rite of Spring's Procession{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: Vesna gains the maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>Disciplinary Action</color> stacks when she enters <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430001}Armed for Action{/LINK}</color> mode. Vesna's ATK is increased by 40% when she has maximum <color=#FFD780FF>Disciplinary Action</color> stacks.
You must unlock the Ascension Talent "Rite of Spring's Procession" to gain access to the above effects.

10000143.name: Winter's Last Offering
10000143.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11432}The Art of Victory{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000143.name: Glory to Our Forebears
10000143.description: The Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1432201}Truth Prevails{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: Its ATK and Elemental Mastery bonuses increase to 3 times their original values.

10000143.name: The Nobleborn's Charge
10000143.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11435}For the Tsaritsa!{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000143.name: Unwavering Ardor
10000143.description:
Tapping on Normal Attack or Elemental Skill in the 5s after Vesna uses <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430003}Windborne Sword{/LINK}</color> at its highest level will unleash the secret Vila ability <color=#FFD780FF>Windborne Sword: Transpose</color>, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> at 150% of Vesna's ATK as well as summoning <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430004}Spirit Blades{/LINK}</color> which deal an additional instance of <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> at 200% of Vesna's ATK. If Vesna is in the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430001}Armed for Action{/LINK}</color> mode, she will also summon a wind pinion to perform Coordinated Attacks against opponents.
Additionally, Vesna's Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 20%.

10000148.name: Frostvale Thunderclap
10000148.description: Alyosha regenerates 15 Elemental Energy when nearby party members trigger an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related reaction</color> on an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

10000148.name: Howl From Afar
10000148.description:
The duration of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> is extended by 6s.
Additionally, each time {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks the opponent, he will also apply the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to a target. This effect does not activate existing <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Marks</color>.

10000148.name: Friendly Call
10000148.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderbolt Strike</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000148.name: Harvest the Spoils
10000148.description: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, he will also restore 60% of Alyosha's ATK as HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP by percentage.

10000148.name: When the Nightbird Falls Silent
10000148.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000148.name: Standard Reclaimed
10000148.description: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained from activating a {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} can now stack, max 2 stacks. When the stack count reaches 2, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> will also have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100 if they are on the field.

10000150.name: "On This Danceless Morn, She Gazes at Her Reflection"
10000150.description:
After unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}, at the dance duet's end Odette will deal an additional instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo AoE DMG</color> to nearby opponents that is considered:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 300% of Odette's ATK;
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 450% of Odette's ATK.

Additionally, the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is also enhanced: now, when the {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} is summoned, Odette also gains 2 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}. When Odette is off-field, the rate at which <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> is removed is sped up to 2 stacks per second.

10000150.name: "I Must See the Snow Swan's Unseen Dream for Myself, She Thought"
10000150.description:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: every stack of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} active also increases the character's ATK by 7%.
Additionally, if Odette is in the {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK} state when there is a {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} on the field, opponents near the <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> will also have their corresponding Elemental RES lowered by 20%.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color>.

10000150.name: "I'll Chase the Shouting Wind Along, Climbing Alone As I Go"
10000150.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11502}Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000150.name: "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue"
10000150.description:
The Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color> is enhanced as follows: when Odette obtains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other nearby party members is increased by 50% of <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan Dream</color>'s effects.

Additionally, when a party member deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to an opponent, Odette will also join in with a coordinated attack, dealing an instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. This effect, which can trigger once every 3.5s, will be considered:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 66% of Odette's ATK.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 99% of Odette's ATK.

10000150.name: "Oh! I Have Slipped the Surly Bonds of Earth"
10000150.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11505}Presto: Bluebird Finale{/LINK} </color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000150.name: "Put Out My Hand, and Touched the Face of the Divine"
10000150.description:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: When Odette grants {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} to all nearby party members, her own Marvelous Splendor stacks will no longer decrease.
Additionally, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> have their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt to opponents {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%, and Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Odette is elevated by an additional 20%.

10000005-pyro.name: Starfire's Flowing Light
10000005-pyro.description: While <color=#FFD780FF>Blazing Threshold</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Scorching Threshold</color> are active, the current active character deals 6% increased DMG. If said character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, they will deal an additional 9% DMG.

10000005-pyro.name: Ever-Lit Candle
10000005-pyro.description: Within 12s of using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Flowfire Blade</color>, after nearby party members trigger a <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro-related reaction</color> on an opponent, the Traveler will regain 14 Nightsoul points. Each use of <color=#FFD780FF>Flowfire Blade</color> will restore at most 28 Nightsoul points in this way.

10000005-pyro.name: Relayed Beacon
10000005-pyro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Flowfire Blade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-pyro.name: Ravaging Flame
10000005-pyro.description: After using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Plains Scorcher</color>, the Traveler gains 20% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color> for 9s.

10000005-pyro.name: The Fire Inextinguishable
10000005-pyro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Plains Scorcher</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-pyro.name: The Sacred Flame Imperishable
10000005-pyro.description: While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Traveler's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> that cannot be overridden, and the CRIT DMG of these attacks is increased by 40%.

10000005-geo.name: Invincible Stonewall
10000005-geo.description: Party members within the radius of <color=#FFD780FF>Wake of Earth</color> have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption.

10000005-geo.name: Rockcore Meltdown
10000005-geo.description: When the meteorite created by <color=#FFD780FF>Starfell Sword</color> is destroyed, it will also explode, dealing additional <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color> equal to the amount of damage dealt by Starfell Sword.

10000005-geo.name: Will of the Rock
10000005-geo.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Wake of Earth</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-geo.name: Reaction Force
10000005-geo.description:
The shockwave triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Wake of Earth</color> regenerates 5 Energy for every opponent hit.
A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

10000005-geo.name: Meteorite Impact
10000005-geo.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Starfell Sword</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-geo.name: Everlasting Boulder
10000005-geo.description:
The barrier created by <color=#FFD780FF>Wake of Earth</color> lasts 5s longer.
The meteorite created by <color=#FFD780FF>Starfell Sword</color> lasts 10s longer.

10000005-hydro.name: Swelling Lake
10000005-hydro.description:
Picking up a Sourcewater Droplet will restore 2 Energy to the Traveler.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Spotless Waters."

10000005-hydro.name: Trickling Purity
10000005-hydro.description: The Movement SPD of <color=#FFD780FF>Rising Waters</color>' bubble will be decreased by 30%, and its duration increased by 3s.

10000005-hydro.name: Turbulent Ripples
10000005-hydro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Aquacrest Saber</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-hydro.name: Pouring Descent
10000005-hydro.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Aquacrest Saber</color>, an Aquacrest Aegis that can absorb 10% of the Traveler's Max HP in DMG will be created and will absorb <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness. It will persist until the Traveler finishes using the skill.
Once every 2s, after a Dewdrop hits an opponent, if the Traveler is being protected by Aquacrest Aegis, the DMG Absorption of the Aegis will be restored to 10% of the Traveler's Max HP. If the Traveler is not presently being protected by an Aegis, one will be redeployed.

10000005-hydro.name: Churning Whirlpool
10000005-hydro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Rising Waters</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-hydro.name: Tides of Justice
10000005-hydro.description: When the Traveler picks up a Sourcewater Droplet, they will restore HP to a nearby party member with the lowest remaining HP percentage based on 6% of said member's Max HP.

10000005-electro.name: Spring Thunder of Fertility
10000005-electro.description: The number of Abundance Amulets that can be generated using <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Blade</color> is increased to 3.

10000005-electro.name: Violet Vehemence
10000005-electro.description: When Falling Thunder created by <color=#FFD780FF>Bellowing Thunder</color> hits an opponent, it will decrease their <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> by 15% for 8s.

10000005-electro.name: Distant Crackling
10000005-electro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Bellowing Thunder</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-electro.name: Fickle Cloudstrike
10000005-electro.description: When a character obtains Abundance Amulets generated by <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Blade</color>, if this character's Energy is less than 35%, the Energy restored by the Abundance Amulets is increased by 100%.

10000005-electro.name: Clamor in the Wilds
10000005-electro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Blade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-electro.name: World-Shaker
10000005-electro.description: Every 2 Falling Thunder attacks triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Bellowing Thunder</color> will greatly increase the DMG dealt by the next Falling Thunder, which will deal 200% of its original DMG and will restore an additional 1 Energy to the current character.

10000005-anemo.name: Raging Vortex
10000005-anemo.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Palm Vortex</color> pulls in opponents and objects within a 5m radius.

10000005-anemo.name: Sweeping Gust
10000005-anemo.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Gust Surge</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-anemo.name: Cherishing Breezes
10000005-anemo.description: Reduces DMG taken while casting <color=#FFD780FF>Palm Vortex</color> by 10%.

10000005-anemo.name: Vortex Stellaris
10000005-anemo.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Palm Vortex</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-anemo.name: Intertwined Winds
10000005-anemo.description:
Targets who take DMG from <color=#FFD780FF>Gust Surge</color> have their <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.

10000005-cryo.name: Somber Freeze
10000005-cryo.description: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

10000005-cryo.name: Frostfall Reverberation
10000005-cryo.description:
The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an <color=#FFD780FF>ice crystal</color> fired by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.

10000005-cryo.name: Glacial Shard
10000005-cryo.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-cryo.name: Enduring Ice
10000005-cryo.description: The duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> created by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> is increased by 25%.

10000005-cryo.name: Bittercold Fog
10000005-cryo.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000005-cryo.description: Every stack of {LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostglow</color>{/LINK} consumed when using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. 10000005-dendro.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Lea Lotus Lamp</color>'s duration is increased by 3s.
