10000007-electro.name: Distant Crackling
10000007-electro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Bellowing Thunder</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000007-electro.name: Fickle Cloudstrike
10000007-electro.description: When a character obtains Abundance Amulets generated by <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Blade</color>, if this character's Energy is less than 35%, the Energy restored by the Abundance Amulets is increased by 100%.

10000007-electro.name: Clamor in the Wilds
10000007-electro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Blade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000007-electro.name: World-Shaker
10000007-electro.description: Every 2 Falling Thunder attacks triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Bellowing Thunder</color> will greatly increase the DMG dealt by the next Falling Thunder, which will deal 200% of its original DMG and will restore an additional 1 Energy to the current character.

10000007-dendro.name: Symbiotic Creeper
10000007-dendro.description: After <color=#FFD780FF>Razorgrass Blade</color> hits an opponent, it will regenerate 3.5 Energy for the Traveler.

10000007-dendro.name: Green Resilience
10000007-dendro.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Lea Lotus Lamp</color>'s duration is increased by 3s.

10000007-dendro.name: Whirling Weeds
10000007-dendro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Razorgrass Blade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000007-dendro.name: Treacle Grass
10000007-dendro.description:
After the <color=#FFD780FF>Lea Lotus Lamp</color> triggers a Lotuslight Transfiguration, it will obtain 5 stacks of the Overflowing Lotuslight effect from the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."

10000007-dendro.name: Viridian Transience
10000007-dendro.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Surgent Manifestation</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

10000007-dendro.name: Withering Aggregation
10000007-dendro.description: The <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG Bonus</color> of the character under the effect of Overflowing Lotuslight as created by the <color=#FFD780FF>Lea Lotus Lamp</color> is increased by 12%. If the Lamp has experienced a Lotuslight Transfiguration previously, the character will also gain 12% DMG Bonus for the corresponding element.

kamisatoayaka.name: Snowswept Sakura
kamisatoayaka.description: When Kamisato Ayaka's Normal or Charged Attacks deal <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> to opponents, it has a 50% chance of decreasing the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Hyouka</color> by 0.3s. This effect can occur once every 0.1s.

kamisatoayaka.name: Blizzard Blade Seki no To
kamisatoayaka.description: When casting <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Soumetsu</color>, unleashes 2 smaller additional Frostflake Seki no To, each dealing 20% of the original storm's DMG.

kamisatoayaka.name: Frostbloom Kamifubuki
kamisatoayaka.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Soumetsu</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kamisatoayaka.name: Ebb and Flow
kamisatoayaka.description: Opponents damaged by <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Soumetsu</color>'s Frostflake Seki no To will have their DEF decreased by 30% for 6s.

kamisatoayaka.name: Blossom Cloud Irutsuki
kamisatoayaka.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Hyouka</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kamisatoayaka.name: Dance of Suigetsu
kamisatoayaka.description: Kamisato Ayaka gains Usurahi Butou every 10s, increasing her Charged Attack DMG by 298%. This buff will be cleared 0.5s after Ayaka's Charged ATK hits an opponent, after which the timer for this ability will restart.

jean.name: Spiraling Tempest
jean.description: Increases the pulling speed of <color=#FFD780FF>Gale Blade</color> after holding for more than 1s, and increases the DMG dealt by 40%.

jean.name: People's Aegis
jean.description: When Jean picks up an Elemental Orb/Particle, all party members have their Movement SPD and ATK SPD increased by 15% for 15s.

jean.name: When the West Wind Arises
jean.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dandelion Breeze</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

jean.name: Lands of Dandelion
jean.description: Within the Field created by <color=#FFD780FF>Dandelion Breeze</color>, all opponents have their <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> decreased by 40%.

jean.name: Outbursting Gust
jean.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Gale Blade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

jean.name: Lion's Fang, Fair Protector of Mondstadt
jean.description: Incoming DMG is decreased by 35% within the Field created by <color=#FFD780FF>Dandelion Breeze</color>. Upon leaving the Dandelion Field, this effect lasts for 3 attacks or 10s.

lisa.name: Infinite Circuit
lisa.description:
Lisa regenerates 2 Energy for every opponent hit while holding <color=#FFD780FF>Violet Arc</color>.
A maximum of 10 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

lisa.name: Electromagnetic Field
lisa.description:
Holding <color=#FFD780FF>Violet Arc</color> has the following effects:
·Increases DEF by 25%.
·Increases Lisa's resistance to interruption.

lisa.name: Resonant Thunder
lisa.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Rose</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

lisa.name: Plasma Eruption
lisa.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Rose</color> now unleashes 1-3 lightning bolts when it attacks.

lisa.name: Electrocute
lisa.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Violet Arc</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

lisa.name: Pulsating Witch
lisa.description:
When Lisa takes the field, she applies 3 stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Violet Arc</color>'s Conductive status onto nearby opponents.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

kaeya.name: Excellent Blood
kaeya.description: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> is increased by 15%.

kaeya.name: Never-Ending Performance
kaeya.description: While <color=#FFD780FF>Glacial Waltz</color> is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

kaeya.name: Dance of Frost
kaeya.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Frostgnaw</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kaeya.name: Frozen Kiss
kaeya.description:
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.

kaeya.name: Frostbiting Embrace
kaeya.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Glacial Waltz</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kaeya.name: Glacial Whirlwind
kaeya.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Glacial Waltz</color> will generate 1 additional icicle, and will regenerate 15 Energy when cast.

barbara.name: Vitality Burst
barbara.description:
Decreases the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Let the Show Begin♪</color> by 15%.
During the ability's duration, your active character gains a 15% <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG Bonus</color>.

barbara.name: Star of Tomorrow
barbara.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Miracle♪</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

barbara.name: Attentiveness Be My Power
barbara.description:
Every opponent Barbara hits with her Charged Attack regenerates 1 Energy for her.
A maximum of 5 energy can be regenerated in this manner with any one Charged Attack.

barbara.name: The Purest Companionship
barbara.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Let the Show Begin♪</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

barbara.name: Dedicating Everything to You
barbara.description:
When Barbara is in the party but not on the field, and one of your own party members falls:
·Automatically revives the fallen character.
·Fully restores the revived character's HP to 100%.
This effect can only occur once every 15 mins.

diluc.name: Conviction
diluc.description: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.

diluc.name: Searing Ember
diluc.description:
When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s.
This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s.

diluc.name: Fire and Steel
diluc.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Searing Onslaught</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

diluc.name: Flowing Flame
diluc.description:
Casting <color=#FFD780FF>Searing Onslaught</color> in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt.
2s after casting <color=#FFD780FF>Searing Onslaught</color>, casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s.

diluc.name: Phoenix, Harbinger of Dawn
diluc.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dawn</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

diluc.name: Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark
diluc.description:
After casting <color=#FFD780FF>Searing Onslaught</color>, the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%.
Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo.

xiangling.name: Crispy Outside, Tender Inside
xiangling.description: Opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro RES</color> reduced by 15% for 6s.

xiangling.name: Oil Meets Fire
xiangling.description: The last attack in a Normal Attack sequence applies the Implode status onto the opponent for 2s. An explosion will occur once this duration ends, dealing 75% of Xiangling's ATK as <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color>.

xiangling.name: Deepfry
xiangling.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Pyronado</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xiangling.name: Guoba Mad
xiangling.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Guoba Attack</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xiangling.name: Condensed Pyronado
xiangling.description: For the duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Pyronado</color>, all party members receive a 15% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color>.

amber.name: One Arrow to Rule Them All
amber.description: Fires 2 arrows per <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color>. The second arrow deals 20% of the first arrow's DMG.

amber.name: Bunny Triggered
amber.description:
Baron Bunny, new and improved! Hitting Baron Bunny's foot with a fully-charged Aimed Shot manually detonates it.
Explosion via manual detonation deals 200% additional DMG.

amber.name: It Burns!
amber.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Fiery Rain</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

amber.name: It's Not Just Any Doll...
amber.description: Decreases <color=#FFD780FF>Explosive Puppet</color>'s CD by 20%. Adds 1 additional charge.

amber.name: It's Baron Bunny!
amber.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Explosive Puppet</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

amber.name: Wildfire
amber.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Fiery Rain</color> increases all party members' Movement SPD by 15% and ATK by 15% for 10s.

venti.name: Splitting Gales
venti.description: Fires 2 additional arrows per <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color>, each dealing 33% of the original arrow's DMG.

venti.name: Breeze of Reminiscence
venti.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Skyward Sonnet</color> decreases opponents' <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> and Physical RES by 12% for 10s.
Opponents launched by <color=#FFD780FF>Skyward Sonnet</color> suffer an additional 12% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> and Physical RES decrease while airborne.

venti.name: Ode to Thousand Winds
venti.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Wind's Grand Ode</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

venti.name: Hurricane of Freedom
venti.description: When Venti picks up an Elemental Orb or Particle, he receives a 25% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> for 10s.

venti.name: Concerto dal Cielo
venti.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Skyward Sonnet</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

venti.name: Storm of Defiance
venti.description:
Targets who take DMG from <color=#FFD780FF>Wind's Grand Ode</color> have their <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.

razor.name: Wolf's Instinct
razor.description: Picking up an Elemental Orb or Particle increases Razor's DMG by 10% for 8s.

razor.name: Suppression
razor.description: Increases CRIT Rate against opponents with less than 30% HP by 10%.

razor.name: Soul Companion
razor.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Fang</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

razor.name: Bite
razor.description: #When casting <color=#FFD780FF>Claw and Thunder</color> ({LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}), opponents hit will have their DEF decreased by 15% for 7s.

razor.name: Sharpened Claws
razor.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Claw and Thunder</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

razor.name: Lupus Fulguris
razor.description:
Every 10s, Razor's sword charges up, causing the next Normal Attack to release lightning that deals 100% of Razor's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.
When Razor is not using <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Fang</color>, a lightning strike on an opponent will grant Razor an Electro Sigil for <color=#FFD780FF>Claw and Thunder</color>.

beidou.name: Sea Beast's Scourge
beidou.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Stormbreaker</color> is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 16% of Beidou's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> 250% more effectively.

beidou.name: Upon the Turbulent Sea, the Thunder Arises
beidou.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Stormbreaker</color>'s arc lightning can jump to 2 additional targets.

beidou.name: Summoner of Storm
beidou.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Tidecaller</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

beidou.name: Stunning Revenge
beidou.description: Upon being attacked, Beidou's Normal Attacks gain an additional instance of 20% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> for 10s.

beidou.name: Crimson Tidewalker
beidou.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Stormbreaker</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

beidou.name: Bane of Evil
beidou.description: During the duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Stormbreaker</color>, the <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> of surrounding opponents is decreased by 15%.

ningguang.name: Piercing Fragments
ningguang.description: When a Normal Attack hits, it deals AoE DMG.

ningguang.name: Shock Effect
ningguang.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Jade Screen</color> is shattered, its CD will reset.
Can occur once every 6s.

ningguang.name: Majesty Be the Array of Stars
ningguang.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Starshatter</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

ningguang.name: Exquisite be the Jade, Outshining All Beneath
ningguang.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Jade Screen</color> increases nearby characters' Elemental RES by 10%.

ningguang.name: Invincible Be the Jade Screen
ningguang.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Jade Screen</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

ningguang.name: Grandeur Be the Seven Stars
ningguang.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Starshatter</color> is used, Ningguang gains 7 Star Jades.

klee.name: Chained Reactions
klee.description: Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of <color=#FFD780FF>Sparks 'n' Splash</color>'s DMG.

klee.name: Explosive Frags
klee.description: Being hit by <color=#FFD780FF>Jumpy Dumpty</color>'s mines decreases opponents' DEF by 23% for 10s.

klee.name: Exquisite Compound
klee.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Jumpy Dumpty</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

klee.name: Sparkly Explosion
klee.description: If Klee leaves the field during the duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Sparks 'n' Splash</color>, her departure triggers an explosion that deals 555% of her ATK as <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color>.

klee.name: Nova Burst
klee.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sparks 'n' Splash</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

klee.name: Blazing Delight
klee.description:
While under the effects of <color=#FFD780FF>Sparks 'n' Splash</color>, Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s.
When <color=#FFD780FF>Sparks 'n' Splash</color> is used, all party members will gain a 10% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color> for 25s.

xingqiu.name: The Scent Remained
xingqiu.description: Increases the maximum number of Rain Swords by 1.

xingqiu.name: Rainbow Upon the Azure Sky
xingqiu.description:
Extends the duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Guhua Sword: Raincutter</color> by 3s.
Decreases the <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> of opponents hit by sword rain attacks by 15% for 4s.

xingqiu.name: Weaver of Verses
xingqiu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Guhua Sword: Raincutter</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xingqiu.name: Evilsoother
xingqiu.description: Throughout the duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Guhua Sword: Raincutter</color>, the DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen</color> is increased by 50%.

xingqiu.name: Embrace of Rain
xingqiu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xingqiu.name: Hence, Call Them My Own Verses
xingqiu.description: Activating 2 of <color=#FFD780FF>Guhua Sword: Raincutter</color>'s sword rain attacks greatly enhances the third sword rain attack. On hit, the third sword rain attack also regenerates 3 Energy for Xingqiu.

xiao.name: Annihilation Eon: Blossom of Kaleidos
xiao.description: When in the party and not on the field, Xiao's Energy Recharge is increased by 25%.

xiao.name: Conqueror of Evil: Wrath Deity
xiao.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lemniscatic Wind Cycling</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xiao.name: Transcension: Extinction of Suffering
xiao.description: When Xiao's HP falls below 50%, he gains a 100% DEF Bonus.

xiao.name: Evolution Eon: Origin of Ignorance
xiao.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Bane of All Evil</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xiao.name: Conqueror of Evil: Guardian Yaksha
xiao.description: While under the effects of <color=#FFD780FF>Bane of All Evil</color>, hitting at least 2 opponents with Xiao's Plunging Attack will immediately grant him 1 charge of <color=#FFD780FF>Lemniscatic Wind Cycling</color>, and for the next 1s, he may use Lemniscatic Wind Cycling while ignoring its CD.

zhongli.name: Rock, the Backbone of Earth
zhongli.description: Increases the maximum number of Stone Steles created by <color=#FFD780FF>Dominus Lapidis</color> that may exist simultaneously to 2.

zhongli.name: Stone, the Cradle of Jade
zhongli.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Planet Befall</color> grants nearby characters on the field a Jade Shield when it descends.

zhongli.name: Jade, Shimmering through Darkness
zhongli.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dominus Lapidis</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

zhongli.name: Topaz, Unbreakable and Fearless
zhongli.description: Increases <color=#FFD780FF>Planet Befall</color>'s AoE by 20% and increases the duration of Planet Befall's Petrification effect by 2s.

zhongli.name: Lazuli, Herald of the Order
zhongli.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Planet Befall</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

zhongli.name: Chrysos, Bounty of Dominator
zhongli.description:
When the Jade Shield takes DMG, 40% of that incoming DMG is converted to HP for the current character.
A single instance of regeneration cannot exceed 8% of that character's Max HP.

tartaglia.name: Foul Legacy: Tide Withholder
tartaglia.description: Decreases the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Foul Legacy: Raging Tide</color> by 20%.

tartaglia.name: Foul Legacy: Understream
tartaglia.description: When opponents affected by Riptide are defeated, Tartaglia regenerates 4 Elemental Energy.

tartaglia.name: Abyssal Mayhem: Vortex of Turmoil
tartaglia.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Foul Legacy: Raging Tide</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

tartaglia.name: Abyssal Mayhem: Hydrospout
tartaglia.description:
If Tartaglia is in <color=#FFD780FF>Foul Legacy: Raging Tide</color>'s Melee Stance, triggers Riptide Slash against opponents on the field affected by Riptide every 4s, otherwise, triggers Riptide Flash.
Riptide Slashes and Riptide Flashes triggered by this Constellation effect are not subject to the time intervals that would typically apply to these two Riptide effects, nor do they have any effect on those time intervals.

tartaglia.name: Havoc: Formless Blade
tartaglia.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Obliteration</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

tartaglia.name: Havoc: Annihilation
tartaglia.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Obliteration</color> is cast in Melee Stance, the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Foul Legacy: Raging Tide</color> is reset.
This effect will only take place once Tartaglia returns to his Ranged Stance.

bennett.name: Grand Expectation
bennett.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Fantastic Voyage</color>'s ATK increase no longer has an HP restriction, and gains an additional 20% of Bennett's Base ATK.

bennett.name: Impasse Conqueror
bennett.description: When Bennett's HP falls below 70%, his Energy Recharge is increased by 30%.

bennett.name: Unstoppable Fervor
bennett.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Passion Overload</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

bennett.name: Unexpected Odyssey
bennett.description:
Using a Normal Attack as the second attack of <color=#FFD780FF>Passion Overload</color>'s Charge Level 1 will perform a follow-up attack.
This additional attack does 135% of the second attack's DMG.

bennett.name: True Explorer
bennett.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Fantastic Voyage</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

bennett.name: Fire Ventures With Me
bennett.description: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters inside <color=#FFD780FF>Fantastic Voyage</color>'s radius gain a 15% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color> and their weapons are infused with <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>.

fischl.name: Gaze of the Deep
fischl.description: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.

fischl.name: Devourer of All Sins
fischl.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Nightrider</color> is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.

fischl.name: Wings of Nightmare
fischl.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Nightrider</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

fischl.name: Her Pilgrimage of Bleak
fischl.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Midnight Phantasmagoria</color> is used, it deals 222% of ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> to surrounding opponents.
When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.

fischl.name: Against the Fleeing Light
fischl.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Midnight Phantasmagoria</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

fischl.name: Evernight Raven
fischl.description: Extends the duration of Oz's presence on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character when present, dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.

noelle.name: I Got Your Back
noelle.description: While <color=#FFD780FF>Sweeping Time</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Breastplate</color> are both in effect, the chance of Breastplate's healing effects activating is increased to 100%.

noelle.name: Combat Maid
noelle.description: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Noelle's Charged Attacks by 20% and increases her Charged Attack DMG by 15%.

noelle.name: Invulnerable Maid
noelle.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Breastplate</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

noelle.name: To Be Cleaned
noelle.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Breastplate</color>'s duration expires or it is destroyed by DMG, it will deal 400% of Noelle's ATK as <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to surrounding opponents.

noelle.name: Favonius Sweeper Master
noelle.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sweeping Time</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

noelle.name: Must Be Spotless
noelle.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Sweeping Time</color> increases Noelle's ATK by an additional 50% of her DEF.
Additionally, every opponent defeated during the skill's duration adds 1s to the duration, up to 10s.

diona.name: A Lingering Flavor
diona.description: Regenerates 15 Energy for Diona after the effects of <color=#FFD780FF>Signature Mix</color> end.

diona.name: Shaken, Not Purred
diona.description:
Increases <color=#FFD780FF>Icy Paws</color>' DMG by 15%, and increases its shield's DMG Absorption by 15%.
Additionally, when paws hit their targets, creates a shield for other nearby characters on the field with 50% of the <color=#FFD780FF>Icy Paws</color> shield's DMG Absorption for 5s.

diona.name: A—Another Round?
diona.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Signature Mix</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

diona.name: Wine Industry Slayer
diona.description: Within the radius of <color=#FFD780FF>Signature Mix</color>, Diona's charge time for aimed shots is reduced by 60%

diona.name: Double Shot, on the Rocks
diona.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Icy Paws</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

diona.name: Cat's Tail Closing Time
diona.description:
Characters within <color=#FFD780FF>Signature Mix</color>'s radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts:
·Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%.
·Elemental Mastery increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.

ganyu.name: Dew-Drinker
ganyu.description:
Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrows or Frostflake Arrow Blooms decrease opponents' <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> by 15% for 6s upon hit.
A hit also regenerates 2 Energy for Ganyu. This effect can only occur once per Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrow, regardless if Frostflake Arrow itself or its Bloom hits the target.

ganyu.name: The Auspicious
ganyu.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Trail of the Qilin</color> gains 1 additional charge.

ganyu.name: Cloud-Strider
ganyu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Celestial Shower</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

ganyu.name: Westward Sojourn
ganyu.description:
Opponents standing within the AoE of <color=#FFD780FF>Celestial Shower</color> take increased DMG. This effect strengthens over time.
Increased DMG taken begins at 5% and increases by 5% every 3s, up to a maximum of 25%.
The effect lingers for 3s after the opponent leaves the AoE.

ganyu.name: The Merciful
ganyu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Trail of the Qilin</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

ganyu.name: The Clement
ganyu.description: Using <color=#FFD780FF>Trail of the Qilin</color> causes the next Frostflake Arrow shot within 30s to not require charging.

albedo.name: Flower of Eden
albedo.description: Transient Blossoms generated by Albedo's <color=#FFD780FF>Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma</color> regenerate 1.2 Energy for Albedo.

albedo.name: Opening of Phanerozoic
albedo.description:
Transient Blossoms generated by <color=#FFD780FF>Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma</color> grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s:
·Unleashing <color=#FFD780FF>Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide</color> consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide's burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF.
·This effect stacks up to 4 times.

albedo.name: Grace of Helios
albedo.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

albedo.name: Descent of Divinity
albedo.description: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.

albedo.name: Tide of Hadean
albedo.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

albedo.name: Dust of Purification
albedo.description: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a shield created by Crystallize, or when Moondrifts are present within the Solar Isotoma field, have their DMG increased by 17%.

chongyun.name: Ice Unleashed
chongyun.description: The last attack of Chongyun's Normal Attack combo releases 3 ice blades. Each blade deals 50% of Chongyun's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> to all opponents in its path.

chongyun.name: Atmospheric Revolution
chongyun.description: Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts cast within the Frost Field created by <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost</color> have their CD time decreased by 15%.

chongyun.name: Cloudburst
chongyun.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

chongyun.name: Frozen Skies
chongyun.description:
Chongyun regenerates 1 Energy every time he hits an opponent affected by <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>.
This effect can only occur once every 2s.

chongyun.name: The True Path
chongyun.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

chongyun.name: Rally of Four Blades
chongyun.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star</color> deals 15% more DMG to opponents with a lower percentage of their Max HP remaining than Chongyun.
This skill will also summon 1 additional spirit blade.

qiqi.name: Ascetics of Frost
qiqi.description: When the Herald of Frost hits an opponent marked by a Fortune-Preserving Talisman, Qiqi regenerates 2 Energy.

qiqi.name: Frozen to the Bone
qiqi.description: Qiqi's Normal and Charged Attack DMG against opponents affected by <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> is increased by 15%.

qiqi.name: Ascendant Praise
qiqi.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

qiqi.name: Divine Suppression
qiqi.description: Targets marked by the Fortune-Preserving Talisman have their ATK decreased by 20%.

qiqi.name: Crimson Lotus Bloom
qiqi.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

qiqi.name: Rite of Resurrection
qiqi.description:
Using <color=#FFD780FF>Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune</color> revives all fallen party members nearby and regenerates 50% of their HP.
This effect can only occur once every 15 mins.

keqing.name: Thundering Might
keqing.description: Recasting <color=#FFD780FF>Stellar Restoration</color> while a Lightning Stiletto is present causes Keqing to deal 50% of her ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> at the start point and terminus of her Blink.

keqing.name: Keen Extraction
keqing.description:
When Keqing's Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents affected by <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, they have a 50% chance of producing an Elemental Particle.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

keqing.name: Foreseen Reformation
keqing.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Starward Sword</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

keqing.name: Attunement
keqing.description: For 10s after Keqing triggers an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related Elemental Reaction</color>, her ATK is increased by 25%.

keqing.name: Beckoning Stars
keqing.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Stellar Restoration</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

keqing.name: Tenacious Star
keqing.description:
When initiating a Normal Attack, a Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Keqing gains a 6% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> for 8s.
Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.

xinyan.name: Fatal Acceleration
xinyan.description:
Upon scoring a CRIT Hit, increases ATK SPD of Xinyan's Normal and Charged Attacks by 12% for 5s.
Can only occur once every 5s.

xinyan.name: Impromptu Opening
xinyan.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Riff Revolution</color>'s Physical DMG has its CRIT Rate increased by 100%, and will form a shield at Shield Level 3: Rave when cast.

xinyan.name: Double-Stop
xinyan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sweeping Fervor</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xinyan.name: Wildfire Rhythm
xinyan.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Sweeping Fervor</color>'s swing DMG decreases opponent's Physical RES by 15% for 12s.

xinyan.name: Screamin' for an Encore
xinyan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Riff Revolution</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xinyan.name: Rockin' in a Flaming World
xinyan.description: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Xinyan's Charged Attacks by 30%. Additionally, Xinyan's Charged Attacks gain an ATK Bonus equal to 50% of her DEF.

sucrose.name: Beth: Unbound Form
sucrose.description: The duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II</color> is increased by 2s.

sucrose.name: Flawless Alchemistress
sucrose.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sucrose.name: Alchemania
sucrose.description:
Sucrose will reduce the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308</color> by 1-7s for every 7 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores against opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.

sucrose.name: Caution: Standard Flask
sucrose.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sucrose.name: Chaotic Entropy
sucrose.description: If <color=#FFD780FF>Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II</color> triggers an Elemental Absorption, all party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus for the corresponding absorbed element during its duration.

mona.name: Prophecy of Submersion
mona.description:
When any of your own party members hits an opponent affected by an Omen, the effects of <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro-related Elemental Reactions</color> are enhanced for 8s:
· Electro-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Vaporize DMG increases by 15%, Hydro Swirl DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Crystallize DMG increases by 15%.
· Frozen duration is extended by 15%.

mona.name: Lunar Chain
mona.description:
When a Normal Attack hits, there is a 20% chance that it will be automatically followed by a Charged Attack.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

mona.name: Restless Revolution
mona.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Stellaris Phantasm</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

mona.name: Prophecy of Oblivion
mona.description: When any party member attacks an opponent affected by an Omen, their CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

mona.name: Mockery of Fortuna
mona.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Mirror Reflection of Doom</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

mona.name: Rhetorics of Calamitas
mona.description:
Upon entering <color=#FFD780FF>Illusory Torrent</color>, Mona gains a 60% increase to the DMG of her next Charged Attack per second of movement.
A maximum DMG Bonus of 180% can be achieved in this manner. The effect lasts for no more than 8s.

rosaria.name: Unholy Revelation
rosaria.description: When Rosaria deals a CRIT Hit, her ATK SPD increases by 10% and her Normal Attack DMG increases by 10% for 4s.

rosaria.name: Land Without Promise
rosaria.description: The duration of the Ice Lance created by <color=#FFD780FF>Rites of Termination</color> is increased by 4s.

rosaria.name: The Wages of Sin
rosaria.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Ravaging Confession</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

rosaria.name: Painful Grace
rosaria.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Ravaging Confession</color>'s CRIT Hits regenerate 5 Energy for Rosaria.
Can only be triggered once each time Ravaging Confession is cast.

rosaria.name: Last Rites
rosaria.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Rites of Termination</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

rosaria.name: Divine Retribution
rosaria.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Rites of Termination</color>'s attack decreases opponents' Physical RES by 20% for 10s.

hutao.name: Crimson Bouquet
hutao.description: While in a <color=#FFD780FF>Paramita Papilio</color> state activated by <color=#FFD780FF>Guide to Afterlife</color>, Hu Tao's Charged Attacks do not consume Stamina.

hutao.name: Ominous Rainfall
hutao.description:
Increases the <color=#FFD780FF>Blood Blossom</color> DMG by an amount equal to 10% of Hu Tao's Max HP at the time the effect is applied.
Additionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Soother</color> will also apply the <color=#FFD780FF>Blood Blossom</color> effect.

hutao.name: Lingering Carmine
hutao.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Guide to Afterlife</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

hutao.name: Garden of Eternal Rest
hutao.description: Upon defeating an enemy affected by a <color=#FFD780FF>Blood Blossom</color> that Hu Tao applied herself, all nearby allies in the party (excluding Hu Tao herself) will have their CRIT Rate increased by 12% for 15s.

hutao.name: Floral Incense
hutao.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Soother</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

hutao.name: Butterfly's Embrace
hutao.description:
Triggers when Hu Tao's HP drops below 25%, or when she suffers a lethal strike:
Hu Tao will not fall as a result of the DMG sustained. Additionally, for the next 10s, her All Elemental and Physical RES is increased by 200%, her CRIT Rate is increased by 100%, and her resistance to interruption is greatly increased.
This effect triggers automatically when Hu Tao has 1 HP left.
Can only occur once every 60s.

yanfei.name: The Law Knows No Kindness
yanfei.description: When Yanfei uses her Charged Attack, each existing Scarlet Seal additionally reduces the stamina cost of this Charged Attack by 10% and increases resistance against interruption during its release.

yanfei.name: Right of Final Interpretation
yanfei.description: Increases Yanfei's Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 20% against enemies below 50% HP.

yanfei.name: Samadhi Fire-Forged
yanfei.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Signed Edict</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yanfei.name: Supreme Amnesty
yanfei.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Done Deal</color> is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 45% of Yanfei's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> 250% more effectively.

yanfei.name: Abiding Affidavit
yanfei.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Done Deal</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yanfei.name: Extra Clause
yanfei.description: Increases the maximum number of Scarlet Seals by 1.

kaedeharakazuha.name: Scarlet Hills
kaedeharakazuha.description:
Decreases <color=#FFD780FF>Chihayaburu</color>'s CD by 10%.
Using <color=#FFD780FF>Kazuha Slash</color> resets the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Chihayaburu</color>.

kaedeharakazuha.name: Yamaarashi Tailwind
kaedeharakazuha.description:
The Autumn Whirlwind field created by <color=#FFD780FF>Kazuha Slash</color> has the following effects:
· Increases Kaedehara Kazuha's own Elemental Mastery by 200 for its duration.
· Increases the Elemental Mastery of characters within the field by 200.

The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.

kaedeharakazuha.name: Maple Monogatari
kaedeharakazuha.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Chihayaburu</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kaedeharakazuha.name: Oozora Genpou
kaedeharakazuha.description:
#When Kaedehara Kazuha's Energy is lower than 45, he obtains the following effects:
·{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tapping}{LAYOUT_PC#Pressing}{LAYOUT_PS#Pressing} or Holding <color=#FFD780FF>Chihayaburu</color> regenerates 3 or 4 Energy for Kaedehara Kazuha, respectively.
·When gliding, Kaedehara Kazuha regenerates 2 Energy per second.

kaedeharakazuha.name: Wisdom of Bansei
kaedeharakazuha.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kazuha Slash</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kaedeharakazuha.name: Crimson Momiji
kaedeharakazuha.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Chihayaburu</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Kazuha Slash</color>, Kaedehara Kazuha gains an <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo Infusion</color> for 5s. Additionally, each point of Elemental Mastery will increase the DMG dealt by Kaedehara Kazuha's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks by 0.2%.

yoimiya.name: Agate Ryuukin
yoimiya.description:
The Aurous Blaze created by <color=#FFD780FF>Ryuukin Saxifrage</color> lasts for an extra 4s.
Additionally, when an opponent affected by Aurous Blaze is defeated within its duration, Yoimiya's ATK is increased by 20% for 20s.

yoimiya.name: A Procession of Bonfires
yoimiya.description:
When Yoimiya's <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> scores a CRIT Hit, Yoimiya will gain a 25% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color> for 6s.
This effect can be triggered even when Yoimiya is not the active character.

yoimiya.name: Trickster's Flare
yoimiya.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Niwabi Fire-Dance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yoimiya.name: Pyrotechnic Professional
yoimiya.description: When Yoimiya's own Aurous Blaze triggers an explosion, <color=#FFD780FF>Niwabi Fire-Dance</color>'s CD is decreased by 1.2s.

yoimiya.name: A Summer Festival's Eve
yoimiya.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Ryuukin Saxifrage</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yoimiya.name: Naganohara Meteor Swarm
yoimiya.description: During <color=#FFD780FF>Niwabi Fire-Dance</color>, Yoimiya's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance of firing an extra Blazing Arrow that deals 60% of its original DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.

thoma.name: A Comrade's Duty
thoma.description:
When a character protected by Thoma's own <color=#FFD780FF>Blazing Barrier</color> (Thoma excluded) is attacked, Thoma's own <color=#FFD780FF>Blazing Blessing</color> CD is decreased by 3s, while his own <color=#FFD780FF>Crimson Ooyoroi</color>'s CD is decreased by 3s.
This effect can be triggered once every 20s.

thoma.name: Fortified Resolve
thoma.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Blazing Blessing</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

thoma.name: Long-Term Planning
thoma.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Crimson Ooyoroi</color>, 15 Energy will be restored to Thoma.

thoma.name: Raging Wildfire
thoma.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Crimson Ooyoroi</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

thoma.name: Burning Heart
thoma.description: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Blazing Barrier</color> is obtained or refreshed, the DMG dealt by all party members' Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks is increased by 15% for 6s.

gorou.name: Rushing Hound: Swift as the Wind
gorou.description:
When characters (other than Gorou) within the AoE of Gorou's <color=#FFD780FF>General's War Banner</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>General's Glory</color> deal Geo DMG to opponents, the CD of Gorou's <color=#FFD780FF>Inuzaka All-Round Defense</color> is decreased by 2s.
This effect can occur once every 10s.

gorou.name: Sitting Hound: Steady as a Clock
gorou.description:
While <color=#FFD780FF>General's Glory</color> is in effect, its duration is extended by 1s when a nearby active character obtains an Elemental Shard from a Crystallize reaction, or triggers a Lunar-Crystallize reaction. 
This effect can occur once every 0.1s. Max extension is 3s.

gorou.name: Mauling Hound: Fierce as Fire
gorou.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Inuzaka All-Round Defense</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

gorou.name: Lapping Hound: Warm as Water
gorou.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>General's Glory</color> is in the "Impregnable" or "Crunch" states, it will also heal active characters within its AoE by 50% of Gorou's own DEF every 1.5s.

gorou.name: Striking Hound: Thunderous Force
gorou.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Juuga: Forward Unto Victory</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

gorou.name: Valiant Hound: Mountainous Fealty
gorou.description:
For 12s after using <color=#FFD780FF>Inuzaka All-Round Defense</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Juuga: Forward Unto Victory</color>, increases the CRIT DMG of all nearby party members' <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> based on the buff level of the skill's field at the time of use:
· "Standing Firm": +10%
· "Impregnable": +20%
· "Crunch": +40%

This effect cannot stack and will take reference from the last instance of the effect that is triggered.

raidenshogun.name: Ominous Inscription
raidenshogun.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Chakra Desiderata</color> will gather Resolve even faster. When <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> characters use their Elemental Bursts, the Resolve gained is increased by 80%. When characters of other Elemental Types use their Elemental Bursts, the Resolve gained is increased by 20%.

raidenshogun.name: Steelbreaker
raidenshogun.description: While using Musou no Hitotachi and in the Musou Isshin state applied by <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu</color>, the Raiden Shogun's attacks ignore 60% of opponents' DEF.

raidenshogun.name: Shinkage Bygones
raidenshogun.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

raidenshogun.name: Pledge of Propriety
raidenshogun.description: When the <color=#FFD780FF>Musou Isshin</color> state applied by <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu</color> expires, all nearby party members (excluding the Raiden Shogun) gain 30% bonus ATK for 10s.

raidenshogun.name: Shogun's Descent
raidenshogun.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Transcendence: Baleful Omen</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

raidenshogun.name: Wishbearer
raidenshogun.description:
While in the <color=#FFD780FF>Musou Isshin</color> state applied by <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu</color>, attacks by the Raiden Shogun that are considered part of her Elemental Burst will decrease all nearby party members' (not including the Raiden Shogun herself) Elemental Burst CD by 1s when they hit opponents.
This effect can trigger once every 1s and can trigger a total of 5 times during Musou Isshin's duration.

eula.name: Tidal Illusion
eula.description:
Every time <color=#FFD780FF>Icetide Vortex</color>'s Grimheart stacks are consumed, Eula's Physical DMG is increased by 30% for 6s.
Each stack consumed will increase the duration of this effect by 6s up to a maximum of 18s.

eula.name: Lady of Seafoam
eula.description: #Decreases the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Icetide Vortex</color>'s Holding Mode, rendering it identical to {LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tapping}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press} CD.

eula.name: Lawrence Pedigree
eula.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Glacial Illumination</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

eula.name: The Obstinacy of One's Inferiors
eula.description: Lightfall Swords deal 25% increased DMG against opponents with less than 50% HP.

eula.name: Chivalric Quality
eula.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Icetide Vortex</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

eula.name: Noble Obligation
eula.description: Lightfall Swords created by <color=#FFD780FF>Glacial Illumination</color> start with 5 stacks of energy. Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts have a 50% chance to grant the Lightfall Sword an additional stack of energy.

sangonomiyakokomi.name: At Water's Edge
sangonomiyakokomi.description:
While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by <color=#FFD780FF>Nereid's Ascension</color>, the final Normal Attack in Sangonomiya Kokomi's combo will unleash a swimming fish to deal 30% of her Max HP as <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.
This DMG is not considered Normal Attack DMG.

sangonomiyakokomi.name: The Clouds Like Waves Rippling
sangonomiyakokomi.description:
Sangonomiya Kokomi gains the following Healing Bonuses with regard to characters with 50% or less HP via the following methods:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Kurage's Oath</color> Bake-Kurage: 4.5% of Kokomi's Max HP.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Nereid's Ascension</color> Normal and Charged Attacks: 0.6% of Kokomi's Max HP.

sangonomiyakokomi.name: The Moon, A Ship O'er the Seas
sangonomiyakokomi.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Nereid's Ascension</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sangonomiyakokomi.name: The Moon Overlooks the Waters
sangonomiyakokomi.description:
While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by <color=#FFD780FF>Nereid's Ascension</color>, Sangonomiya Kokomi's Normal Attack SPD is increased by 10%, and Normal Attacks that hit opponents will restore 0.8 Energy for her.
This effect can occur once every 0.2s.

sangonomiyakokomi.name: All Streams Flow to the Sea
sangonomiyakokomi.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kurage's Oath</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sangonomiyakokomi.name: Sango Isshin
sangonomiyakokomi.description: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by <color=#FFD780FF>Nereid's Ascension</color>, Sangonomiya Kokomi gains a 40% <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG Bonus</color> for 4s when her Normal and Charged Attacks heal, or would heal, any party member with 80% or more HP.

sayu.name: Multi-Task no Jutsu
sayu.description: The Muji-Muji Daruma created by <color=#FFD780FF>Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry</color> will ignore HP limits and can simultaneously attack nearby opponents and heal characters.

sayu.name: Egress Prep
sayu.description:
#<color=#FFD780FF>Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash</color> gains the following effects:
·DMG of Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick in {LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tapping}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press} Mode increased by 3.3%.
·Every 0.5s in the Fuufuu Windwheel state will increase the DMG of this Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick by 3.3%. The maximum DMG increase possible through this method is 66%.

sayu.name: Eh, the Bunshin Can Handle It
sayu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sayu.name: Skiving: New and Improved
sayu.description:
Sayu recovers 1.2 Energy when she triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while on-field.
This effect occurs once every 2s.

sayu.name: Speed Comes First
sayu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sayu.name: Sleep O'Clock
sayu.description:
The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Sayu's <color=#FFD780FF>Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry</color> will now also benefit from her Elemental Mastery. Each point of Sayu's Elemental Mastery will produce the following effects:
·Increases the damage dealt by the Muji-Muji Daruma's attacks by 0.2% ATK. A maximum DMG increase of 400% ATK can be gained via this method.
·Increases the HP restored by the Muji-Muji Daruma by 3. A maximum of 6,000 additional HP can be restored in this manner.

kujousara.name: Crow's Eye
kujousara.description:
When Tengu Juurai grants characters ATK Bonuses or hits opponents, the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Tengu Stormcall</color> is decreased by 1s.
This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

kujousara.name: Dark Wings
kujousara.description: Unleashing <color=#FFD780FF>Tengu Stormcall</color> will leave a weaker Crowfeather at Kujou Sara's original position that will deal 30% of its original DMG.

kujousara.name: The War Within
kujousara.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Subjugation: Koukou Sendou</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kujousara.name: Conclusive Proof
kujousara.description: The number of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster released by <color=#FFD780FF>Subjugation: Koukou Sendou</color> is increased to 6.

kujousara.name: Spellsinger
kujousara.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Tengu Stormcall</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kujousara.name: Sin of Pride
kujousara.description: The <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> of characters who have had their ATK increased by Tengu Juurai has its CRIT DMG increased by 60%.

aratakiitto.name: Stay a While and Listen Up
aratakiitto.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!</color>, Arataki Itto gains 2 stacks of Superlative Superstrength. After 1s, Itto will gain 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength every 0.5s for 1.5s.

aratakiitto.name: Gather 'Round, It's a Brawl!
aratakiitto.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!</color>, each party member whose Element is <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> will decrease that skill's CD by 1.5s and restore 6 Energy to Arataki Itto.
CD can be decreased by up to 4.5s in this manner. Max 18 Energy can be restored in this manner.

aratakiitto.name: Horns Lowered, Coming Through
aratakiitto.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

aratakiitto.name: Jailhouse Bread and Butter
aratakiitto.description: When the Raging Oni King state caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!</color> ends, all nearby party members gain 20% DEF and 20% ATK for 10s.

aratakiitto.name: 10 Years of Hanamizaka Fame
aratakiitto.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

aratakiitto.name: Arataki Itto, Present!
aratakiitto.description: Arataki Itto's Charged Attacks deal +70% CRIT DMG. Additionally, when he uses Arataki Kesagiri, he has a 50% chance to not consume stacks of Superlative Superstrength.

shikanoinheizou.name: Named Juvenile Casebook
shikanoinheizou.description: For 5s after Shikanoin Heizou takes the field, his Normal Attack SPD is increased by 15%. He also gains 1 Declension stack for <color=#FFD780FF>Heartstopper Strike</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.

shikanoinheizou.name: Investigative Collection
shikanoinheizou.description: The pull effect of the Arresting Windtunnel created by <color=#FFD780FF>Windmuster Kick</color> is enhanced, and its duration is increased to 1s.

shikanoinheizou.name: Esoteric Puzzle Book
shikanoinheizou.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Heartstopper Strike</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

shikanoinheizou.name: Tome of Lies
shikanoinheizou.description:
The first Windmuster Iris explosion in each <color=#FFD780FF>Windmuster Kick</color> will regenerate 9 Elemental Energy for Shikanoin Heizou. Every subsequent explosion in that Windmuster Kick will each regenerate an additional 1.5 Energy for Heizou.
One <color=#FFD780FF>Windmuster Kick</color> can regenerate a total of 13.5 Energy for Heizou in this manner.

shikanoinheizou.name: Secret Archive
shikanoinheizou.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Windmuster Kick</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

shikanoinheizou.name: Curious Casefiles
shikanoinheizou.description: Each Declension stack will increase the CRIT Rate of the <color=#FFD780FF>Heartstopper Strike</color> unleashed by 4%. When Heizou possesses Conviction, this Heartstopper Strike's CRIT DMG is increased by 32%.

yaemiko.name: Yakan Offering
yaemiko.description: Each time <color=#FFD780FF>Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin</color> activates a Tenko Thunderbolt, Yae Miko will restore 8 Elemental Energy for herself.

yaemiko.name: Fox's Mooncall
yaemiko.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Sesshou Sakura</color> start at Level 2 when created, their max level is increased to 4, and their attack range is increased by 60%.

yaemiko.name: The Seven Glamours
yaemiko.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yaemiko.name: Sakura Channeling
yaemiko.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Sesshou Sakura</color> lightning hits opponents, the <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> of all nearby party members is increased by 20% for 5s.

yaemiko.name: Mischievous Teasing
yaemiko.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yaemiko.name: Forbidden Art: Daisesshou
yaemiko.description: <color=#FFD780FF>The Sesshou Sakura's</color> attacks will ignore 60% of the opponents' DEF.

yelan.name: Taking All Comers
yelan.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Exquisite Throw</color> conducts a coordinated attack, it will fire an additional water arrow that will deal 14% of Yelan's Max HP as Hydro DMG.
This effect can trigger once every 1.8s.

yelan.name: Beware the Trickster's Dice
yelan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Depth-Clarion Dice</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yelan.name: Bait-and-Switch
yelan.description: Increases all party members' Max HP by 10% for 25s for every opponent marked by <color=#FFD780FF>Lifeline</color> when the Lifeline explodes. A maximum increase of 40% Max HP can be attained in this manner.

yelan.name: Dealer's Sleight
yelan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lingering Lifeline</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yelan.name: Winner Takes All
yelan.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Depth-Clarion Dice</color>, Yelan will enter the Mastermind state.
In this state, all of Yelan's Normal Attacks will be special Breakthrough Barbs. These Breakthrough Barbs will have similar abilities to normal ones and the DMG dealt will be considered Charged Attack DMG, dealing 156% of a normal Breakthrough Barb's DMG.

The Mastermind state lasts 20s and will be cleared after Yelan fires 5 arrows.

shenhe.name: Clarity of Heart
shenhe.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Spring Spirit Summoning</color> can be used 1 more time.

shenhe.name: Centered Spirit
shenhe.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Divine Maiden's Deliverance</color> lasts for 6 seconds longer. Active characters within the skill's field deal 15% increased <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> CRIT DMG.

shenhe.name: Seclusion
shenhe.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spring Spirit Summoning</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

shenhe.name: Insight
shenhe.description:
When characters under the effect of <color=#FFD780FF>Icy Quill</color> applied by Shenhe trigger its DMG Bonus effects, Shenhe will gain a Skyfrost Mantra stack:
· When Shenhe uses <color=#FFD780FF>Spring Spirit Summoning</color>, she will consume all stacks of Skyfrost Mantra, increasing the DMG of that Spring Spirit Summoning by 5% for each stack consumed.
· Max 50 stacks. Stacks last for 60s.

shenhe.name: Divine Attainment
shenhe.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Divine Maiden's Deliverance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

shenhe.name: Mystical Abandon
shenhe.description: When characters trigger <color=#FFD780FF>Icy Quill</color>'s effects using Normal and Charged Attack DMG, it does not count toward the Trigger Quota.

aloy.name: Star of Another World
aloy.description: The time has not yet come for this person's corner of the night sky to light up.

aloy.name: Star of Another World
aloy.description: The time has not yet come for this person's corner of the night sky to light up.

aloy.description: The time has not yet come for this person's corner of the night sky to light up.

aloy.description: The time has not yet come for this person's corner of the night sky to light up.

aloy.name: Star of Another World
aloy.description: The time has not yet come for this person's corner of the night sky to light up.

kukishinobu.name: To Cloister Compassion
kukishinobu.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite</color>'s AoE is increased by 50%.

kukishinobu.name: To Forsake Fortune
kukishinobu.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Grass Ring of Sanctification</color>'s duration is increased by 3s.

kukishinobu.name: To Sequester Sorrow
kukishinobu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sanctifying Ring</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kukishinobu.name: To Sever Sealing
kukishinobu.description:
When the Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks of the character affected by Shinobu's <color=#FFD780FF>Grass Ring of Sanctification</color> hit opponents, a Thundergrass Mark will land on the opponent's position and deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> based on 9.7% of Shinobu's Max HP.
This effect can occur once every 5s.

kukishinobu.name: To Cease Courtesies
kukishinobu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kukishinobu.name: To Ward Weakness
kukishinobu.description:
When Kuki Shinobu takes lethal DMG, this instance of DMG will not take her down. This effect will automatically trigger when her HP reaches 1 and will trigger once every 60s.
When Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she will gain 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s. This effect will trigger once every 60s.

kirara.name: Material Circulation
kirara.description: Every 8,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will cause her to create 1 extra <color=#FFD780FF>Cat Grass Cardamom</color> when she uses <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch</color>. A maximum of 4 extra can be created this way.

kirara.name: Perfectly Packaged
kirara.description:
When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of <color=#FFD780FF>Meow-teor Kick</color>, she will grant other party members she crashes into Critical Transport Shields.
The DMG absorption of Critical Transport Shield is 40% of the maximum absorption <color=#FFD780FF>Meow-teor Kick</color>'s normal Shields of Safe Transport are capable of, and will absorb <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness.
Critical Transport Shields last 12s and can be triggered once on each character every 10s.

kirara.name: Universal Recognition
kirara.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Meow-teor Kick</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kirara.name: Steed of Skanda
kirara.description: After active character(s) protected by <color=#FFD780FF>Shields of Safe Transport</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Critical Transport Shields</color> hit opponents with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, Kirara will perform a coordinated attack with them using <color=#FFD780FF>Small Cat Grass Cardamoms</color>, dealing 200% of her ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color>. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3.8s. This CD is shared between all party members.

kirara.name: A Thousand Miles in a Day
kirara.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kirara.name: Countless Sights to See
kirara.description: All nearby party members gain a 12% All Elemental DMG Bonus for 15s after Kirara uses her Elemental Skill or Burst.

yunjin.name: Myriad Mise-En-Scène
yunjin.description: After <color=#FFD780FF>Cliffbreaker's Banner</color> is unleashed, all nearby party members' Normal Attack DMG is increased by 15% for 12s.

yunjin.name: Seafaring General
yunjin.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Cliffbreaker's Banner</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yunjin.name: Flower and a Fighter
yunjin.description: When Yun Jin triggers Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize reactions, her DEF is increased by 20% for 12s.

yunjin.name: Famed Throughout the Land
yunjin.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Opening Flourish</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yunjin.name: Decorous Harmony
yunjin.description: Characters under the effects of the <color=#FFD780FF>Flying Cloud Flag Formation</color> have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 12%.

kamisatoayato.name: Kyouka Fuushi
kamisatoayato.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Shunsuiken</color> DMG is increased by 40% against opponents with 50% HP or less.

kamisatoayato.name: World Source
kamisatoayato.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Namisen</color>'s maximum stack count is increased to 5. When Kamisato Ayato has at least 3 Namisen stacks, his Max HP is increased by 50%.

kamisatoayato.name: To Admire the Flowers
kamisatoayato.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Kyouka</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kamisatoayato.name: Endless Flow
kamisatoayato.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Suiyuu</color>, all nearby party members will have 15% increased Normal Attack SPD for 15s.

kamisatoayato.name: Bansui Ichiro
kamisatoayato.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Suiyuu</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kamisatoayato.name: Boundless Origin
kamisatoayato.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Kyouka</color>, Ayato's next Shunsuiken attack will create 2 extra Shunsuiken strikes when they hit opponents, each one dealing 450% of Ayato's ATK as DMG.
Both these Shunsuiken attacks will not be affected by Namisen.

collei.name: Deepwood Patrol
collei.description: When in the party and not on the field, Collei's Energy Recharge is increased by 20%.

collei.name: Through Hill and Copse
collei.description:
The Ascension Talent Floral Sidewinder is changed to this:
The <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Ring</color> will grant the character the Sprout effect from Floral Sidewinder upon return, dealing 40% of Collei's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> to nearby opponents for 3s.
From the moment of using <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Brush</color> to the moment when this instance of Sprout effect ends, if any of your party members triggers Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon reactions, the Sprout effect will be extended by 3s.
The Sprout effect can only be extended this way once. If another Sprout effect is triggered during its initial duration, the initial effect will be removed. DMG dealt by Sprout is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Floral Sidewinder."

collei.name: Scent of Summer
collei.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Brush</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

collei.name: Gift of the Woods
collei.description: Using <color=#FFD780FF>Trump-Card Kitty</color> will increase all nearby characters' Elemental Mastery by 60 for 12s (not including Collei herself).

collei.name: All Embers
collei.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Trump-Card Kitty</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

collei.name: Forest of Falling Arrows
collei.description:
When the <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Ring</color> hits, it will create a miniature Cuilein-Anbar that will deal 200% of Collei's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color>.
Each <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Brush</color> can only create one such miniature Cuilein-Anbar.

tighnari.name: Beginnings Determined at the Roots
tighnari.description: Tighnari's Charged Attack CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

tighnari.name: Origins Known From the Stem
tighnari.description:
When there are opponents within the Vijnana-Khanda Field created by <color=#FFD780FF>Vijnana-Phala Mine</color>, Tighnari gains 20% <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG Bonus</color>.
The effect will last up to 6s if the field's duration ends or if it no longer has opponents within it.

tighnari.name: Fortunes Read Amongst the Branches
tighnari.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

tighnari.name: Withering Glimpsed in the Leaves
tighnari.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft</color> is unleashed, all nearby party members gain 60 Elemental Mastery for 8s. If the Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft triggers a Burning, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Quicken, or Spread reaction, their Elemental Mastery will be further increased by 60. This latter case will also refresh the buff state's duration.

tighnari.name: Comprehension Amidst the Flowers
tighnari.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Vijnana-Phala Mine</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

tighnari.name: Karma Adjudged From the Leaden Fruit
tighnari.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Wreath Arrow</color>'s charging time is decreased by 0.9s, and will produce 1 additional Clusterbloom Arrow upon hit. This arrow deals 150% of Tighnari's ATK as DMG.

dori.name: Additional Investment
dori.description: The number of After-Sales Service Rounds created by <color=#FFD780FF>Troubleshooter Shots</color> is increased by 1.

dori.name: Special Franchise
dori.description: When you are in combat and the <color=#FFD780FF>Jinni</color> heals the character it is connected to, it will fire a Jinni Toop from that character's position that deals 50% of Dori's ATK DMG.

dori.name: Wonders Never Cease
dori.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Alcazarzaray's Exactitude</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

dori.name: Discretionary Supplement
dori.description:
The character connected to the <color=#FFD780FF>Jinni</color> will obtain the following buffs based on their current HP and Energy:
·When their HP is lower than 50%, they gain 50% Incoming Healing Bonus.
·When their Energy is less than 50%, they gain 30% Energy Recharge.

dori.name: Value for Mora
dori.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

dori.name: Sprinkling Weight
dori.description:
Dori gains the following effects for 3s after using <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon</color>:
·<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro Infusion</color>.
·When Normal Attacks hit opponents, all nearby party members will heal HP equivalent to 4% of Dori's Max HP. This type of healing can occur once every 0.1s.

nilou.name: Dance of the Waning Moon
nilou.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Haftkarsvar</color> will be enhanced as follows:
·Luminous Illusion DMG is increased by 65%.
·The Tranquility Aura's duration is extended by 6s.

nilou.name: The Starry Skies Their Flowers Rain
nilou.description:
After characters affected by the Golden Chalice's Bounty deal <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> to an opponent, that opponent's <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> will be decreased by 35% for 10s. After dealing Bloom or Lunar-Bloom DMG to opponents, their <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> will be decreased by 35% for 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Court of Dancing Petals."

nilou.name: Beguiling Shadowstep
nilou.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

nilou.name: Fricative Pulse
nilou.description: After the third dance step of <color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Haftkarsvar</color>'s Pirouette hits opponents, Nilou will gain 15 Elemental Energy, and DMG from her <color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring</color> will be increased by 50% for 8s.

nilou.name: Twirling Light
nilou.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Haftkarsvar</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

nilou.name: Frostbreaker's Melody
nilou.description:
For every 1,000 points of Max HP, Nilou's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 0.6% and 1.2% respectively.
The maximum increase in CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG via this method is 30% and 60% respectively.

cyno.name: Ordinance: Unceasing Vigil
cyno.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color>, Cyno's Normal Attack SPD will be increased by 20% for 10s. If the Judication effect of his Ascension Talent Featherfall Judgment is triggered during <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer</color>, the duration of this increase will be refreshed.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."

cyno.name: Ceremony: Homecoming of Spirits
cyno.description: When Cyno's Normal Attacks hit opponents, his <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> will increase by 10% for 4s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 5 stacks.

cyno.name: Precept: Lawful Enforcer
cyno.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

cyno.name: Austerity: Forbidding Guard
cyno.description:
When Cyno is in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color>, after he triggers an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, or Electro Swirl reaction, he will restore 3 Elemental Energy for all nearby party members (except himself.)
This effect can occur 5 times within one use of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color>.

cyno.name: Funerary Rite: The Passing of Starlight
cyno.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

cyno.name: Raiment: Just Scales
cyno.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color> or triggering the Judication effect of the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment," Cyno will gain 4 stacks of the "Day of the Jackal" effect. When he hits opponents with Normal Attacks, he will consume 1 stack of "Day of the Jackal" to fire off one Duststalker Bolt.
"Day of the Jackal" lasts for 8s. Max 8 stacks. It will be canceled once Pactsworn Pathclearer ends.
A maximum of 1 Duststalker Bolt can be unleashed this way every 0.4s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."

layla.name: Fortress of Fantasy
layla.description:
The Shield Absorption of the Curtain of Slumber generated by <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> is increased by 20%.
Additionally, when unleashing Nights of Formal Focus, she will generate a shield for any nearby party members who are not being protected by a Curtain of Slumber. This shield will have 35% of the absorption of a Curtain of Slumber, will last for 12s, and will absorb <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness.

layla.name: Light's Remit
layla.description: When Shooting Stars from <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> strike opponents, they will each restore 1 Energy to Layla. Each Shooting Star can restore Energy to her in this manner once.

layla.name: Secrets of the Night
layla.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

layla.name: Starry Illumination
layla.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> starts to fire off Shooting Stars, it will grant all nearby party members the Dawn Star effect, causing their Normal and Charged Attack DMG to increase based on 5% of Layla's Max HP.
Dawn Star can last up to 3s and will be removed 0.05s after dealing Normal or Charged Attack DMG.

layla.name: Stream of Consciousness
layla.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

layla.name: Radiant Soulfire
layla.description:
Shooting Stars from <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> deal 40% increased DMG, and Starlight Slugs from <color=#FFD780FF>Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker</color> deal 40% increased DMG.
Additionally, the interval between the creation of Night Stars via Nights of Formal Focus is decreased by 20%.

wanderer.name: Shoban: Ostentatious Plumage
wanderer.description:
When in the <color=#FFD780FF>Windfavored</color> state, the Attack SPD of the Wanderer's Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai is increased by 10%.
Additionally, the wind arrows fired by the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie" will deal an additional 25% of his ATK as DMG. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie."

wanderer.name: Niban: Isle Amidst White Waves
wanderer.description:
When in the <color=#FFD780FF>Windfavored</color> state, <color=#FFD780FF>Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays</color> will see its DMG increased by 4% per point of difference between the max amount of Kuugoryoku Points contrasted with Kuugoryoku's present capacity when using this skill.
Through this method, you can increase Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays's DMG by a maximum of 200%.

wanderer.name: Sanban: Moonflower Kusemai
wanderer.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

wanderer.name: Yonban: Set Adrift into Spring
wanderer.description:
When casting <color=#FFD780FF>Hanega: Song of the Wind</color>, should the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower" be triggered, the character will gain buffs in correspondence to the contacted Elemental Type(s), and also obtain a random untriggered buff. A maximum of 3 such corresponding elemental buffs can exist simultaneously.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower."

wanderer.name: Matsuban: Ancient Illuminator From Abroad
wanderer.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hanega: Song of the Wind</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

wanderer.name: Shugen: The Curtains' Melancholic Sway
wanderer.description:
When the Wanderer actively hits an opponent with Kuugo: Fushoudan while in the <color=#FFD780FF>Windfavored</color> state, the following effects will occur:
·Deals an additional instance of Kuugo: Fushoudan at the position hit, dealing 40% of the attack's original DMG. This DMG will be considered Normal Attack DMG.
·When the Wanderer falls below 40 Kuugoryoku Points, restores 4 Points to him. Kuugoryoku Points can be restored in this manner once every 0.2s. This restoration can occur up to 5 times within one Windfavored duration.

nahida.name: The Seed of Stored Knowledge
nahida.description: When the <color=#FFD780FF>Shrine of Maya</color> is unleashed and the Elemental Types of the party members are being tabulated, the count will add 1 to the number of Pyro, Electro, and Hydro characters respectively.

nahida.name: The Root of All Fullness
nahida.description:
Opponents that are marked by <color=#FFD780FF>Seeds of Skandha</color> applied by Nahida herself will be affected by the following effects:
· Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon Reaction DMG they receive can score CRIT Hits. CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG are fixed at 20% and 100% respectively. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.
· Within 8s of being affected by Quicken, Aggravate, or Spread, DEF is decreased by 30%.
· The CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of Lunar-Bloom DMG received are increased by 10% and 20% respectively.

nahida.name: The Shoot of Conscious Attainment
nahida.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>All Schemes to Know</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

nahida.name: The Stem of Manifest Inference
