nahida.description: When 1/2/3/4 (or more) nearby opponents are affected by <color=#FFD780FF>All Schemes to Know</color>'s Seeds of Skandha, Nahida's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100/120/140/160.

nahida.name: The Leaves of Enlightening Speech
nahida.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Illusory Heart</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

nahida.name: The Fruit of Reason's Culmination
nahida.description:
When Nahida hits an opponent affected by <color=#FFD780FF>All Schemes to Know</color>'s Seeds of Skandha with Normal or Charged Attacks after unleashing <color=#FFD780FF>Illusory Heart</color>, she will use Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion on this opponent and all connected opponents, dealing <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> based on 200% of Nahida's ATK and 400% of her Elemental Mastery.
DMG dealt by Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion is considered Elemental Skill DMG and can be triggered once every 0.2s.
This effect can last up to 10s and will be removed after Nahida has unleashed 6 instances of Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion.

candace.name: Returning Heiress of the Scarlet Sands
candace.description: The duration of Prayer of the Crimson Crown effect triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide</color> is increased by 3s.

candace.name: Moon-Piercing Brilliance
candace.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum</color> hits opponents, Candace's Max HP will be increased by 20% for 15s.

candace.name: Hunter's Supplication
candace.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

candace.name: Sentinel Oath
candace.description: Shortens the Hold CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum</color> to be the same as that of the Tapping CD.

candace.name: Heterochromatic Gaze
candace.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

candace.name: The Overflow
candace.description:
When characters (excluding Candace herself) affected by the Prayer of the Crimson Crown caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide</color> deal Elemental DMG to opponents using Normal Attacks, an attack wave will be unleashed that deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> equal to 15% of Candace's Max HP.
This effect can trigger once every 2.3s and is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

faruzan.name: Truth by Any Means
faruzan.description: Faruzan can fire off a maximum of 2 Hurricane Arrows using fully charged Aimed Shots while under the effect of a single Manifest Gale created by <color=#FFD780FF>Wind Realm of Nasamjnin</color>.

faruzan.name: Overzealous Intellect
faruzan.description: The duration of the Dazzling Polyhedron created by <color=#FFD780FF>The Wind's Secret Ways</color> is increased by 6s.

faruzan.name: Spirit-Orchard Stroll
faruzan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Wind Realm of Nasamjnin</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

faruzan.name: Divine Comprehension
faruzan.description:
The vortex created by <color=#FFD780FF>Pressurized Collapses</color> will restore Energy to Faruzan based on the number of opponents hit: If it hits 1 opponent, it will restore 2 Energy for Faruzan. Each additional opponent hit will restore 0.5 more Energy for Faruzan.
A maximum of 4 Energy can be restored to her per vortex.

faruzan.name: Wonderland of Rumination
faruzan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>The Wind's Secret Ways</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

faruzan.name: The Wondrous Path of Truth
faruzan.description: Characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>The Wind's Secret Ways</color>' Prayerful Wind's Benefit have 40% increased CRIT DMG when they deal <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>. When the active character deals DMG while affected by Prayerful Wind's Benefit, they will apply Pressurized Collapse to the opponent damaged. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. This CD is shared between all party members.

alhaitham.name: Intuition
alhaitham.description: When a Projection Attack hits an opponent, <color=#FFD780FF>Universality: An Elaboration on Form</color>'s CD is decreased by 1.2s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

alhaitham.name: Debate
alhaitham.description: When Alhaitham generates a Chisel-Light Mirror, his Elemental Mastery will be increased by 50 for 8 seconds, max 4 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently. This effect can be triggered even when the maximum number of Chisel-Light Mirrors has been reached.

alhaitham.name: Negation
alhaitham.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Universality: An Elaboration on Form</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

alhaitham.name: Elucidation
alhaitham.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena</color> is unleashed, the following effects will become active based on the number of Chisel-Light Mirrors consumed and created this time around:
·Each Mirror consumed will increase the Elemental Mastery of all other nearby party members by 30 for 15s.
·Each Mirror generated will grant Alhaitham a 10% <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG Bonus</color> for 15s.

The pre-existing duration of the aforementioned effects will be cleared if you use Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena again while they are in effect.

alhaitham.name: Sagacity
alhaitham.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

alhaitham.name: Structuration
alhaitham.description:
Alhaitham gains the following effects:
· 2 seconds after <color=#FFD780FF>Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena</color> is unleashed, he will generate 3 Chisel-Light Mirrors regardless of the number of mirrors consumed.
· If Alhaitham generates Chisel-Light Mirrors when their numbers have already maxed out, his CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 10% and 70% respectively for 6s. If this effect is triggered again during its initial duration, the duration remaining will be increased by 6s.

mika.name: Factor Confluence
mika.description: The Soulwind state of <color=#FFD780FF>Starfrost Swirl</color> can decrease the healing interval between instances caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Skyfeather Song</color>'s Eagleplume state. This decrease percentage is equal to the ATK SPD increase provided by Soulwind.

mika.name: Companion's Ingress
mika.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Starfrost Swirl</color>'s Flowfrost Arrow first hits an opponent, or its Rimestar Flare hits an opponent, 1 Detector stack from the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage" will be generated.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage."

mika.name: Reconnaissance Experience
mika.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Skyfeather Song</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

mika.name: Sunfrost Encomium
mika.description: When Mika's own <color=#FFD780FF>Skyfeather Song</color>'s Eagleplume state heals party members, this will restore 3 Energy to Mika. This form of Energy restoration can occur 5 times during the Eagleplume state created by 1 use of Skyfeather Song.

mika.name: Signal Arrow
mika.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Starfrost Swirl</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

mika.name: Companion's Counsel
mika.description:
The maximum number of Detector stacks that <color=#FFD780FF>Starfrost Swirl</color>'s Soulwind can gain is increased by 1. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage.".
Additionally, active characters affected by Soulwind will deal 60% more Physical CRIT DMG.

yaoyao.name: Adeptus' Tutelage
yaoyao.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>White Jade Radishes</color> explode, active characters within their AoE will gain 15% <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG Bonus</color> for 8s and have 15 Stamina restored to them. This form of Stamina Restoration can only be triggered every 5s.

yaoyao.name: Innocent
yaoyao.description: While affected by the Adeptal Legacy state caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Moonjade Descent</color>, if White Jade Radish explosions hit opponents, 3 Energy will be restored to Yaoyao. This form of Energy regeneration can occur once every 0.8s.

yaoyao.name: Loyal and Kind
yaoyao.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Raphanus Sky Cluster</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yaoyao.name: Winsome
yaoyao.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Raphanus Sky Cluster</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Moonjade Descent</color>, Yaoyao's Elemental Mastery will be increased based on 0.3% of her Max HP for 8s. The maximum Elemental Mastery she can gain this way is 120.

yaoyao.name: Compassionate
yaoyao.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Moonjade Descent</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yaoyao.name: Beneficent
yaoyao.description:
For every 2 White Jade Radishes <color=#FFD780FF>Yuegui: Throwing Mode</color> throws out, the next throw will also release a Mega Radish that will have a larger AoE than the standard White Jade Radish and have the following effects upon exploding:
·Deals <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> based on 75% of Yaoyao's ATK.
·Restores HP for the active character based on 7.5% of Yaoyao's Max HP.

Every Yuegui: Throwing Mode can throw out a maximum of 2 Mega Radishes.

dehya.name: The Flame Incandescent
dehya.description:
Dehya's Max HP is increased by 20%, and she deals bonus DMG based on her Max HP when using the following attacks:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Molten Inferno</color>'s DMG will be increased by 3.6% of her Max HP.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Leonine Bite</color>'s DMG will be increased by 6% of her Max HP.

dehya.name: The Sand-Blades Glittering
dehya.description:
When Dehya uses <color=#FFD780FF>Molten Inferno: Ranging Flame</color>, the duration of the recreated Fiery Sanctum field will be increased by 6s.
Additionally, when a Fiery Sanctum exists on the field, DMG dealt by its next coordinated attack will be increased by 50% when active character(s) within the Fiery Sanctum field are attacked.

dehya.name: A Rage Swift as Fire
dehya.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Leonine Bite</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

dehya.name: An Oath Abiding
dehya.description: When Flame-Mane's Fist and Incineration Drive attacks unleashed during <color=#FFD780FF>Leonine Bite</color> hit opponents, they will restore 1.5 Energy for Dehya and 2.5% of her Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s.

dehya.name: The Alpha Unleashed
dehya.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Molten Inferno</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

dehya.name: The Burning Claws Cleaving
dehya.description:
The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFD780FF>Leonine Bite</color> is increased by 10%.
Additionally, after a Flame-Mane's Fist attack hits an opponent and deals CRIT Hits during a single Blazing Lioness state, it will cause the CRIT DMG of Leonine Bite to increase by 15% for the rest of Blazing Lioness's duration and extend that duration by 0.5s. This effect can be triggered every 0.2s. The duration can be extended for a maximum of 2s and CRIT DMG can be increased by a maximum of 60% this way.

lyney.name: Whimsical Wonders
lyney.description:
Lyney can have 2 <color=#FFD780FF>Grin-Malkin Hats</color> present at once.
Additionally, Prop Arrows will summon 2 Grin-Malkin Hats and grant Lyney 1 extra stack of Prop Surplus. This effect can occur once every 15s.

lyney.name: Loquacious Cajoling
lyney.description: When Lyney is on the field, he will gain a stack of Crisp Focus every 2s. Each stack will increase his CRIT DMG by 20%. Max 3 stacks. This effect will be canceled when Lyney leaves the field.

lyney.name: Prestidigitation
lyney.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Card Force Translocation</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

lyney.name: Well-Versed, Well-Rehearsed
lyney.description: After an opponent is hit by Lyney's <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color> Charged Attack, this opponent's <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro RES</color> will be decreased by 20% for 6s.

lyney.name: To Pierce Enigmas
lyney.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Wondrous Trick: Miracle Parade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

lyney.name: Guarded Smile
lyney.description: When Lyney fires a <color=#FFD780FF>Prop Arrow</color>, he will fire a Pyrotechnic Strike: Reprised that will deal 80% of a Pyrotechnic Strike's DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.

lynette.name: A Cold Blade Like a Shadow
lynette.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Enigmatic Feint</color>'s Enigma Thrust hits an opponent with Shadowsign, a vortex will be created at that opponent's position that will pull nearby opponents in.

lynette.name: Endless Mysteries
lynette.description: Whenever the Bogglecat Box summoned by <color=#FFD780FF>Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift</color> fires a Vivid Shot, it will fire an extra Vivid Shot.

lynette.name: Cognition-Inverting Gaze
lynette.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

lynette.name: Obscuring Ambiguity
lynette.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Enigmatic Feint</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

lynette.name: Watchful Eye
lynette.description: When Lynette uses <color=#FFD780FF>Enigmatic Feint</color>'s Enigma Thrust, she will gain an <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo Infusion</color> and 20% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> for 6s.

freminet.name: Dreams of the Foamy Deep
freminet.description: The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFD780FF>Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure</color> will be increased by 15%.

freminet.name: Penguins and the Land of Plenty
freminet.description: Unleashing <color=#FFD780FF>Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure</color> will restore 2 Energy to Freminet. If a Pressure Level 4 Shattering Pressure is unleashed, this will restore 3 Energy.

freminet.name: Song of the Eddies and Bleached Sands
freminet.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

freminet.name: Dance of the Snowy Moon and Flute
freminet.description: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his ATK will be increased by 9% for 6s. Max 2 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.

freminet.name: Nights of Hearth and Happiness
freminet.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Pressurized Floe</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

freminet.name: Moment of Waking and Resolve
freminet.description: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his CRIT DMG will be increased by 12% for 6s. Max 3 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.

kaveh.name: Sublime Salutations
kaveh.description: Within 3s after using <color=#FFD780FF>Artistic Ingenuity</color>, Kaveh's <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> and Incoming Healing Bonus will be increased by 50% and 25% respectively.

kaveh.name: Grace of Royal Roads
kaveh.description: Kaveh's Normal Attack SPD increases by 15% during <color=#FFD780FF>Painted Dome</color>.

kaveh.name: Profferings of Dur Untash
kaveh.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Painted Dome</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kaveh.name: Feast of Apadana
kaveh.description: Dendro Cores created from Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions Kaveh triggers will deal 60% more DMG when they burst.

kaveh.name: Treasures of Bonkhanak
kaveh.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Artistic Ingenuity</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kaveh.name: Pairidaeza's Dreams
kaveh.description: When Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents during <color=#FFD780FF>Painted Dome</color>, they will unleash Pairidaeza's Light upon the opponent's position, dealing 61.8% of Kaveh's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> and causing all Dendro Cores within that AoE to burst. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

baizhu.name: Incisive Discernment
baizhu.description:
When your own active character hits a nearby opponent with their attacks, Baizhu will unleash a Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
Gossamer Sprite: Splice will initiate 1 attack before returning, dealing 250% of Baizhu's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> and healing for 20% of <color=#FFD780FF>Universal Diagnosis</color>'s Gossamer Sprite's normal healing.
DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

baizhu.name: All Aspects Stabilized
baizhu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Holistic Revivification</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

baizhu.name: Ancient Art of Perception
baizhu.description: For 15s after <color=#FFD780FF>Holistic Revivification</color> is used, Baizhu will increase all nearby party members' Elemental Mastery by 80.

baizhu.name: The Hidden Ebb and Flow
baizhu.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Universal Diagnosis</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

baizhu.name: Elimination of Malicious Qi
baizhu.description:
Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Holistic Revivification</color>'s Spiritveins by 8% of Baizhu's Max HP.
Additionally, when a <color=#FFD780FF>Gossamer Sprite</color> or Gossamer Sprite: Splice hits opponents, there is a 100% chance of generating one of <color=#FFD780FF>Holistic Revivification</color>'s Seamless Shields. This effect can only be triggered once by each Gossamer Sprite or Gossamer Sprite: Splice.

neuvillette.name: Venerable Institution
neuvillette.description:
When Neuvillette takes the field, he will obtain 1 stack of Past Draconic Glories from the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."
Additionally, his interruption resistance will be increased while using the Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation and the Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment.

neuvillette.name: Juridical Exhortation
neuvillette.description:
The Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" will be enhanced: Each stack of Past Draconic Glories will increase the CRIT DMG of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 14%. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 42%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."

neuvillette.name: Ancient Postulation
neuvillette.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: As Water Seeks Equilibrium</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

neuvillette.name: Crown of Commiseration
neuvillette.description: When Neuvillette is on the field and is healed, 1 Sourcewater Droplet will be generated. This effect can occur once every 4s.

neuvillette.name: Axiomatic Judgment
neuvillette.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>O Tides, I Have Returned</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

neuvillette.name: Wrathful Recompense
neuvillette.description:
When using Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, Neuvillette can absorb nearby Sourcewater Droplets in an AoE. Each absorbed Droplet will increase the duration of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 1s.
Additionally, when Equitable Judgment hits opponents, it will fire off 2 additional currents every 2s, each of which will deal 10% of Neuvillette's Max HP as <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>. DMG dealt this way will count as DMG dealt by Equitable Judgment.

furina.name: "Love Is a Rebellious Bird That None Can Tame"
furina.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Let the People Rejoice</color>, Furina will gain 150 Fanfare.
Additionally, Furina's Fanfare limit is increased by 100.

furina.name: "A Woman Adapts Like Duckweed in Water"
furina.description: While <color=#FFD780FF>Let the People Rejoice</color> lasts, Furina's Fanfare gain from increases or decreases in nearby characters' HP is increased by 250%. Each point of Fanfare above the limit will increase Furina's Max HP by 0.35%. Her maximum Max HP increase is 140%.

furina.name: "My Secret Is Hidden Within Me, No One Will Know My Name"
furina.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Let the People Rejoice</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

furina.name: "They Know Not Life, Who Dwelt in the Netherworld Not!"
furina.description: When the Salon Members from <color=#FFD780FF>Salon Solitaire</color> hit an opponent, or the Singer of Many Waters restores HP to nearby active characters, Furina will restore 4 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

furina.name: "His Name I Now Know, It Is...!"
furina.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Salon Solitaire</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

furina.name: "Hear Me — Let Us Raise the Chalice of Love!"
furina.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Salon Solitaire</color>, Furina gains "Center of Attention" for 10s.
Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted into <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion. DMG is also increased by an amount equivalent to 18% of Furina's max HP.
Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attacks, and the impact of Plunging Attacks will cause different effects up to every 0.1s after hitting opponents depending on her current Arkhe alignment:

Arkhe: Ousia
Every 1s, all nearby characters in the party will be healed by 4% of Furina's max HP, for a duration of 2.9s. Triggering this effect again will extend its duration.
Arkhe: Pneuma
This Normal Attack (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack ground impact DMG will be further increased by an amount equivalent to 25% of Furina's max HP. When any of the attacks mentioned previously hit an opponent, all nearby characters in the party will consume 1% of their current HP.

During the duration of each instance of "Center of Attention," the above effects can be triggered up to 6 times. "Center of Attention" will end when its effects have triggered 6 times or when the duration expires.

wriothesley.name: Terror for the Evildoers
wriothesley.description:
The Gracious Rebuke from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" is changed to this:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60% or while he is in the Chilling Penalty state caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Icefang Rush</color>, when the fifth attack of Repelling Fists hits, it will create a Gracious Rebuke. 1 Gracious Rebuke effect can be obtained every 2.5s.

Additionally, Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will obtain the following enhancement:
· The DMG Bonus gained will be further increased to 200%.
· When it hits while Wriothesley is in the Chilling Penalty state, that state's duration is extended by 4s. 1 such extension can occur per 1 Chilling Penalty duration.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."

wriothesley.name: Shackles for the Arrogant
wriothesley.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Darkgold Wolfbite</color>, each Prosecution Edict stack from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin" will increase said ability's DMG dealt by 40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin."

wriothesley.name: Punishment for the Frauds
wriothesley.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

wriothesley.name: Redemption for the Suffering
wriothesley.description:
The HP restored to Wriothesley through Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased to 50% of his Max HP. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
Additionally, when Wriothesley is healed, if the amount of healing overflows, the following effects will occur depending on whether he is on the field or not. If he is on the field, his ATK SPD will be increased by 20% for 4s. If he is off-field, all of your own party members' ATK SPD will be increased by 10% for 6s. These two methods of increasing ATK SPD cannot stack.

wriothesley.name: Mercy for the Wronged
wriothesley.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Darkgold Wolfbite</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

wriothesley.name: Esteem for the Innocent
wriothesley.description:
The CRIT Rate of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased by 10%, and its CRIT DMG by 80%. When unleashed, it will also create an additional icicle that deals 100% of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist's Base DMG as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. DMG dealt this way is regarded as Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."

charlotte.name: A Need to Verify Facts
charlotte.description: After <color=#FFD780FF>Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation</color> heals a character, it will mark them with Verification, which will heal them once every 2s for 80% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect lasts 6s.

charlotte.name: A Duty to Pursue Truth
charlotte.description: When using <color=#FFD780FF>Framing: Freezing Point Composition</color>, when Monsieur Verite hits 1/2/3 (or more) opponents, Charlotte's own ATK will be increased by 10%/20%/30% for 12s.

charlotte.name: An Imperative to Independence
charlotte.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

charlotte.name: A Responsibility to Oversee
charlotte.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation</color> hits an opponent marked by Snappy Silhouette or Focused Impression, it will deal 10% more DMG and restore 2 Energy to Charlotte. This restoration can be triggered 5 times every 20s.

charlotte.name: A Principle of Conscience
charlotte.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Framing: Freezing Point Composition</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

charlotte.name: A Summation of Interest
charlotte.description: When the active character's Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent marked by <color=#FFD780FF>Framing: Freezing Point Composition</color>'s Focused Impression, Monsieur Verite will initiate a coordinated attack that deals 180% of Charlotte's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> and heals active character(s) within the AoE for 42% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 6s and both DMG and healing dealt in this way will be considered as having been done by Charlotte's Elemental Burst.

chevreuse.name: Stable Front Line's Resolve
chevreuse.description:
When the active character with the "Coordinated Tactics" status (not including Chevreuse herself) triggers the Overloaded reaction, they will recover 6 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics."

chevreuse.name: Sniper Induced Explosion
chevreuse.description: After Holding <color=#FFD780FF>Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire</color> and hitting a target, 2 chain explosions will be triggered near the location where said target is hit. Each explosion deals <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> equal to 120% of Chevreuse's ATK. This effect can be triggered up to once every 10s, and DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

chevreuse.name: Practiced Field Stripping Technique
chevreuse.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

chevreuse.name: The Secret to Rapid-Fire Multishots
chevreuse.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Ring of Bursting Grenades</color>, the Hold mode of <color=#FFD780FF>Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire</color> will not go on cooldown when Chevreuse uses it. This effect is removed after Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire has been fired twice using Hold or after 6s.

chevreuse.name: Enhanced Incendiary Firepower
chevreuse.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Ring of Bursting Grenades</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

chevreuse.name: In Pursuit of Ending Evil
chevreuse.description:
After 12s of the healing effect from <color=#FFD780FF>Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire</color>, all nearby party members recover HP equivalent to 10% of Chevreuse's Max HP once.
After a party member is healed by Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, they gain a 20% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> for 8s. Max 3 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

navia.name: A Lady's Rules for Keeping a Courteous Distance
navia.description: Each stack of Crystal Shrapnel consumed when Navia uses <color=#FFD780FF>Ceremonial Crystalshot</color> will restore 3 Energy to her and decrease the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute</color> by 1s. Up to 9 Energy can be gained this way, and the CD of "As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute" can be decreased by up to 3s.

navia.name: The President's Pursuit of Victory
navia.description:
Each stack of Crystal Shrapnel consumed will increase the CRIT Rate of this <color=#FFD780FF>Ceremonial Crystalshot</color> instance by 12%. CRIT Rate can be increased by up to 36% in this way.
In addition, when Ceremonial Crystalshot hits an opponent, one Cannon Fire Support shot from <color=#FFD780FF>As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute</color> will strike near the location of the hit. Up to one instance of Cannon Fire Support can be triggered each time Ceremonial Crystalshot is used, and DMG dealt by said Cannon Fire Support this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

navia.name: Businesswoman's Broad Vision
navia.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Ceremonial Crystalshot</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

navia.name: The Oathsworn Never Capitulate
navia.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute</color> hits an opponent, that opponent's <color=#FFE699FF>Geo RES</color> will be decreased by 20% for 8s.

navia.name: Negotiator's Resolute Negotiations
navia.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

navia.name: The Flexible Finesse of the Spina's President
navia.description: If more than 3 stacks of Crystal Shrapnel are consumed when using <color=#FFD780FF>Ceremonial Crystalshot</color>, each stack consumed beyond the first 3 increases the CRIT DMG of that Ceremonial Crystalshot by 45%, and any stacks consumed beyond the first 3 are returned to Navia.

chiori.name: Six Paths of Sage Silkcraft
chiori.description:
The AoE of the automaton doll "Tamoto" summoned by <color=#FFD780FF>Fluttering Hasode</color> is increased by 50%.
Additionally, if there is a <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party member other than Chiori, Fluttering Hasode will trigger the following after the dash is completed:
· Summon an additional Tamoto. Only one additional Tamoto can exist at the same time, whether summoned by Chiori this way or through the presence of a Geo Construct.
· Triggers the Ascension Talent "The Finishing Touch." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Finishing Touch."

chiori.name: In Five Colors Dyed
chiori.description:
For 10s after using <color=#FFD780FF>Hiyoku: Twin Blades</color>, a simplified automaton doll, "Kinu," will be summoned next to your active character every 3s. Kinu will attack nearby opponents, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color> equivalent to 170% of Tamoto's DMG. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Kinu will leave the field after 1 attack or after lasting 3s.

chiori.name: Four Brocade Embellishments
chiori.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Fluttering Hasode</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

chiori.name: A Tailor's Three Courtesies
chiori.description:
For 8s after triggering either follow-up effect of the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made," when your current active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit a nearby opponent, a simplified automaton doll, "Kinu," will be summoned near this opponent. You can summon 1 Kinu every 1s in this way, and up to 3 Kinu may be summoned this way during each instance of "Tailor-Made"'s Seize the Moment or Tailoring effect. The above effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made."

chiori.name: Two Silken Plumules
chiori.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hiyoku: Twin Blades</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

chiori.name: Sole Principle Pursuit
chiori.description:
After triggering a follow-up effect of the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made," Chiori's own <color=#FFD780FF>Fluttering Hasode</color>'s CD is decreased by 12s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made.".
In addition, the DMG dealt by Chiori's own Normal Attacks is increased by an amount equal to 235% of her own DEF.

xianyun.name: Purifying Wind
xianyun.description: <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color> gains 1 additional charge.

xianyun.name: Aloof From the World
xianyun.description:
After using a Skyladder from <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color>, Xianyun's ATK will be increased by 20% for 15s.
Additionally, the effects of the Ascension Talent "Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm" will be enhanced: When the Starwicker created by <color=#FFD780FF>Stars Gather at Dusk</color> has Adeptal Assistance stacks, nearby active characters' Plunging Attack shockwave DMG will be increased by 400% of Xianyun's ATK. The maximum DMG increase that can be achieved this way is 18,000.
Each Plunging Attack shockwave DMG instance can only apply this increased DMG effect to a single opponent. Each character can trigger this effect once every 0.4s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm."

xianyun.name: Creations of Star and Moon
xianyun.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Stars Gather at Dusk</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xianyun.name: Mystery Millet Gourmet
xianyun.description: After using Skyladder 1/2/3 times during one <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color> Cloud Transmogrification state, when a Driftcloud Wave unleashed during that instance hits an opponent, it will heal all nearby party members for 50%/80%/150% of Xianyun's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

xianyun.name: Astride Rose-Colored Clouds
xianyun.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xianyun.name: They Call Her Cloud Retainer
xianyun.description:
After Xianyun uses 1/2/3 Skyladders within one Cloud Transmogrification caused by <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color>, the CRIT DMG of a Driftcloud Wave created in this instance of Cloud Transmogrification will be increased by 15%/35%/70%.
Within 16s after Xianyun has used <color=#FFD780FF>Stars Gather at Dusk</color>, White Clouds at Dawn will not enter CD. This effect will be canceled once she has used White Clouds at Dawn 8 times.

gaming.name: Bringer of Blessing
gaming.description: When the Suanni Man Chai from <color=#FFD780FF>Suanni's Gilded Dance</color> meets back up with Gaming, it will heal 15% of Gaming's HP.

gaming.name: Plum Blossoms Underfoot
gaming.description: When Gaming receives healing and this instance of healing overflows, his ATK will be increased by 20% for 5s.

gaming.name: Awakening Spirit
gaming.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Bestial Ascent</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

gaming.name: Soar Across Mountains
gaming.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Bestial Ascent</color>'s Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider hits an opponent, it will restore 2 Energy to Gaming. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s.

gaming.name: Evil-Daunting Roar
gaming.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Suanni's Gilded Dance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

gaming.name: To Tame All Beasts
gaming.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Bestial Ascent</color>'s Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider CRIT Rate increased by 20% and CRIT DMG increased by 40%, and its attack radius will be increased.

sigewinne.name: "Can the Happiest of Spirits Understand Anxiety?"
sigewinne.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Rebound Hydrotherapy</color>'s Bolstering Bubblebalm can bounce 3 extra times, and the first 3 bounces will not cause big Bubblebalms to become smaller.
The Ascension Talent "Requires Appropriate Rest" is enhanced: Each Bubblebalm bounce adds 1 stack to her Convalescence tally, and the values for the Convalescence stacks' DMG bonus will be modified to: Every 1,000 max HP Sigewinne has above 30,000 increases the DMG by 100. The maximum DMG increase for Elemental Skills that can be gained in this way is 3,500. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Requires Appropriate Rest."

sigewinne.name: "Can the Most Merciful of Spirits Defeat Its Foes?"
sigewinne.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Rebound Hydrotherapy</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Super Saturated Syringing</color>, Sigewinne can create a Bubbly Shield worth 30% of her Max HP that absorbs <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> with 250% efficiency. The Bubbly Shield will persist until Sigewinne finishes using relevant skills.
Additionally, after Rebound Hydrotherapy's Bolstering Bubblebalm or Super Saturated Syringing hits an opponent, that opponent's <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> will be decreased by 35% for 8s.

sigewinne.name: "Can the Healthiest of Spirits Cure Fevers?"
sigewinne.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Rebound Hydrotherapy</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sigewinne.name: "Can the Loveliest of Spirits Keep Decay at Bay?"
sigewinne.description: The duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Super Saturated Syringing</color> is extended by 3s.

sigewinne.name: "Can the Most Joyful of Spirits Alleviate Agony?"
sigewinne.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Super Saturated Syringing</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sigewinne.name: "Can the Most Radiant of Spirits Pray For Me?"
sigewinne.description: When Sigewinne performs healing, she will increase the CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of her <color=#FFD780FF>Super Saturated Syringing</color> based on her Max HP. Every 1,000 Max HP she has will increase CRIT Rate by 0.4% and CRIT DMG by 2.2% for 15s. The maximum increase achievable this way is 20% CRIT Rate and 110% CRIT DMG.

clorinde.name: "From This Day, I Pass the Candle's Shadow-Veil"
clorinde.description:
While <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Vigil</color>'s Night Vigil state is active, when <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> from Clorinde's Normal Attacks hit opponents, they will trigger 2 coordinated attacks from a Nightvigil Shade summoned near the hit opponent, each dealing 30% of Clorinde's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.
This effect can occur once every 1.2s. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.

clorinde.name: "Now, As We Face the Perils of the Long Night"
clorinde.description:
Enhance the Ascension Talent "Dark-Shattering Flame": After a nearby party member triggers an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related reaction</color> against an opponent, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> dealt by Clorinde's Normal Attacks and <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> will be increased by 30% of Clorinde's ATK for 15s. Max 3 stacks. Each stack is counted independently. When you have 3 stacks, Clorinde's interruption resistance will be increased. The Maximum DMG increase achievable this way for the above attacks is 2,700.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Dark-Shattering Flame."

clorinde.name: "I Pledge to Remember the Oath of Daylight"
clorinde.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Vigil</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

clorinde.name: "To Enshrine Tears, Life, and Love"
clorinde.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> deals DMG to opponent(s), DMG dealt is increased based on Clorinde's Bond of Life percentage. Every 1% of her current Bond of Life will increase <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> DMG by 2%. The maximum <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> DMG increase achievable this way is 200%.

clorinde.name: "Holding Dawn's Coming as My Votive"
clorinde.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

clorinde.name: "And So Shall I Never Despair"
clorinde.description:
For 12s after <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Vigil</color> is used, Clorinde's CRIT Rate will be increased by 10%, and her CRIT DMG by 70%.
Additionally, while Night Vigil is active, a Glimbright Shade will appear under specific circumstances, executing an attack that deals 200% of Clorinde's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
The Glimbright Shade will appear under the following circumstances:
· When Clorinde is about to be hit by an attack.
· When Clorinde uses Impale the Night: Pact.
1 Glimbright Shade can be summoned in the aforementioned ways every 1s. 6 Shades can be summoned per single Night Vigil duration.
In addition, while Night Vigil is active, the DMG Clorinde receives is decreased by 80% and her interruption resistance is increased. This effect will disappear after the Night Vigil state ends or 1s after she summons 6 Glimbright Shades.

kachina.name: Shards Are Gems Too
kachina.description:
When Kachina mounts or dismounts <color=#FFD780FF>Turbo Twirly</color>, she will absorb nearby Elemental Shards created by Crystallize.
Additionally, when a party member picks up such a Shard, or triggers Lunar-Crystallize reactions, 3 Energy will be restored to Kachina. Energy can be restored this way once every 5s.

kachina.name: Never Leave Home Without... Turbo Twirly
kachina.description: When Kachina uses <color=#FFD780FF>"Time to Get Serious!"</color>, she will regain 20 Nightsoul points. If there is no <color=#FFD780FF>Turbo Twirly</color> belonging to her on the field, she will enter Nightsoul's Blessing and summon one.

kachina.name: Improved Stabilizer
kachina.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Go, Go Turbo Twirly!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kachina.name: More Foes, More Caution
kachina.description: When there are 1/2/3/4 (or more) opponents within the Turbo Drill Field created by <color=#FFD780FF>"Time to Get Serious!"</color>, the active character within the field gains 8%/12%/16%/20% increased DEF.

kachina.name: All I've Collected Till Now
kachina.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Time to Get Serious!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kachina.name: This Time, I've Gotta Win
kachina.description: When your active character's Shield is replaced or destroyed for any reason, Kachina will deal 200% of her DEF as <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

emilie.name: Light Fragrance Leaching
emilie.description:
Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Fragrance Extraction</color> and her Ascension Talent's Cleardew Cologne "Lingering Fragrance" by 20%. The latter requires unlocking said Ascension Talent first.
Additionally, when nearby party members trigger the Burning reaction on opponents or deal <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> to Burning opponents, they will generate an additional <color=#FFD780FF>Scent</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 2.9s.

emilie.name: Lakelight Top Note
emilie.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Fragrance Extraction</color>, <color=#FFD780FF>Aromatic Explication</color>, or Cleardew Cologne produced by the Ascension Talent "Lingering Fragrance" (the last of which requires Ascension Talent activation) hits opponents, those opponents' <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> is decreased by 30% for 10s.

emilie.name: Exquisite Essence
emilie.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Fragrance Extraction</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

emilie.name: Lumidouce Heart Note
emilie.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Aromatic Explication</color>'s duration is increased by 2s. The interval between opponents being selected as the target for Scented Dew is decreased by 0.3s.

emilie.name: Puredew Aroma
emilie.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Aromatic Explication</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

emilie.name: Marcotte Sillage
emilie.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Fragrance Extraction</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Aromatic Explication</color>, Emilie will gain Abiding Fragrance for 5s.
While this is active, after Emilie uses Normal or Charged Attacks, she will generate 1 Scent, and her Normal and Charged Attack DMG will be converted into <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> that cannot be overridden, and the DMG dealt will be increased by 300% of Emilie's ATK.

The Abiding Fragrance effect will be removed after 4 Scents are created this way or after its duration expires. Abiding Fragrance can be triggered once every 12s.

sethos.name: Sealed Shrine's Spiritsong
sethos.description: The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowpiercing Shot</color> is increased by 15%.

sethos.name: Papyrus Scripture of Silent Secrets
sethos.description:
When any of the following conditions are met, Sethos gains a 15% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> for 10s that may stack twice, with each stack duration counted independently:
· Consuming Elemental Energy through Aimed Shots. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" to trigger this condition.
· Regaining Elemental Energy by triggering Elemental Reactions using <color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Rite: The Thundering Sands</color>.
· Using <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer</color>.

sethos.name: Ode to the Moonrise Sage
sethos.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Royal Reed Archery</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sethos.name: Beneficent Plumage
sethos.description: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowpiercing Shot</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Dusk Bolt</color> strikes 2 or more opponents, all nearby party members gain 80 Elemental Mastery for 10s.

sethos.name: Record of the Desolate God's Burning Sands
sethos.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sethos.name: Pylon of the Sojourning Sun Temple
sethos.description: After <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowpiercing Shot</color> strikes an opponent, the Elemental Energy consumed by the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" will be returned. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma."

arlecchino.name: "All Reprisals and Arrears, Mine to Bear..."
arlecchino.description: Masque of the Red Death is further enhanced, the value of the increase is 100%. Additionally, Arlecchino's interruption resistance is increased when she performs Normal or Charged Attacks while affected by the Masque of the Red Death.

arlecchino.name: "All Rewards and Retribution, Mine to Bestow..."
arlecchino.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Blood-Debt Directives</color> are now already Blood-Debt Due when first applied.
When Arlecchino absorbs such a Due, she unleashes Balemoon Bloodfire in front of her, dealing 900% of her ATK as <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> and increasing her All Elemental RES and Physical RES by 20% for 15s. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Agony Alone May Be Repaid."

arlecchino.name: "You Shall Become a New Member of Our Family..."
arlecchino.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

arlecchino.name: "You Shall Love and Protect Each Other Henceforth..."
arlecchino.description: When Arlecchino successfully absorbs a Blood-Debt Directive, <color=#FFD780FF>Balemoon Rising</color>'s CD will decrease by 2s and 15 Elemental Energy will be restored to her. This effect can occur once every 10s.

arlecchino.name: "For Alone, We Are as Good as Dead..."
arlecchino.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Balemoon Rising</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

arlecchino.name: "From This Day On, We Shall Delight in New Life Together."
arlecchino.description:
The DMG of <color=#FFD780FF>Balemoon Rising</color> is increased by Arlecchino's ATK multiplied by 700% of Arlecchino's current Bond of Life percentage.
For 20s after Arlecchino uses <color=#FFD780FF>All Is Ash</color>, both her Normal Attacks and Elemental Burst gain 10% increased CRIT Rate and 70% increased CRIT DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.

kinich.name: Parrot's Beak
kinich.description:
After Kinich lands from <color=#FFD780FF>Canopy Hunter: Riding High</color>'s mid-air swing, his Movement SPD will increase by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, Scalespiker Cannon's CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.

kinich.name: Tiger Beetle's Palm
kinich.description:
When Kinich's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, it will decrease their <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, the first Scalespiker Cannon Kinich fires after entering Nightsoul's Blessing has increased AoE, and its DMG increases by 100%.

kinich.name: Protosuchian's Claw
kinich.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Canopy Hunter: Riding High</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kinich.name: Hummingbird's Feather
kinich.description:
When in Nightsoul's Blessing, Kinich will restore 5 Energy after using his Loop Shots or after unleashing the Scalespiker Cannon. Energy can be regenerated this way once every 2.8s.
Additionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord</color> deals 70% more DMG.

kinich.name: Howler Monkey's Tail
kinich.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

kinich.name: Auspicious Beast's Shape
kinich.description:
After Scalespiker Cannon hits an opponent, it will bounce between opponents once, dealing 700% of Kinich's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color>.
If this Scalespiker Cannon triggers the buffs that Ascension Talent "Flame Spirit Pact" or the Constellation "Tiger Beetle's Palm" grant to the Cannon, the bouncing attack will also obtain the relevant buffs.

chasca.name: Cylinder, the Restless Roulette
chasca.description:
When triggering the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick"'s "Spiritbinding Conversion," the 2nd <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowhunt Shell</color> loaded into the cylinder will be additionally converted into a <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Shadowhunt Shell</color>.
The chance to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" is increased: If there are party members who meet the Elemental Conversion Type requirements, the chance to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" is increased by 33.3%, up to a maximum of 100%.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick."
In addition, Chasca's Nightsoul point and Phlogiston consumption in her Nightsoul's Blessing state is decreased by 30% while out of combat.

chasca.name: Muzzle, the Searing Smoke
chasca.description:
When Chasca takes the field, she will obtain 1 stack of "Spirit of the Radiant Shadow" from the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick" for this effect.
In addition, when the <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Shadowhunt Shells</color> from <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt</color>'s <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color> hit opponents, they will deal AoE Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type of the <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Shadowhunt Shells</color> equal to 400% of Chasca's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once each time Chasca uses <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color>.

chasca.name: Reins, Her Careful Control
chasca.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

chasca.name: Sparks, the Sudden Shot
chasca.description:
When the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiant Soulseeker Shells</color> from <color=#FFD780FF>Soul Reaper's Fatal Round</color> hit opponents, they will restore 1.5 Elemental Energy to Chasca, and deal AoE Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type of the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiant Soulseeker Shells</color> equal to 400% of Chasca's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
The aforementioned corresponding elemental AoE DMG effect can be triggered once each time Chasca uses <color=#FFD780FF>Soul Reaper's Fatal Round</color>.

chasca.name: Brim, the Sandshadow's Silhouette
chasca.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Soul Reaper's Fatal Round</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

chasca.name: Showdown, the Glory of Battle
chasca.description:
Chasca's <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color> charge time is decreased, and after the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick"'s "Spiritbinding Conversion" is triggered, Chasca will gain the "Fatal Rounds" state: For the next 3s, the next time Chasca uses <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt</color>'s <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color>, the shots will finish charging instantly, and the CRIT DMG of that instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color>'s <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowhunt Shells</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Shadowhunt Shells</color> increases by 120%. 1 "Fatal Rounds" effect can be gained once every 3s.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick" to gain access to the above effect.

mualani.name: The Leisurely "Meztli"...
mualani.description:
The DMG dealt by the first Sharky's Surging Bite after Mualani enters Nightsoul's Blessing and the Shark Missiles it triggers is increased by 66% of Mualani's Max HP. This instance of increased DMG is subject to the diminishing DMG rules of <color=#FFD780FF>Surfshark Wavebreaker</color>.
In addition, while out of combat, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing state consumes 30% less Phlogiston and Nightsoul points.

mualani.name: Mualani, Going All Out!
mualani.description:
Mualani gains 2 of <color=#FFD780FF>Surfshark Wavebreaker</color>'s Wave Momentum stacks when she enters Nightsoul's Blessing state. She will gain 1 stack when obtaining a Puffer.
In addition, whenever Mualani obtains 2 Puffers within a single instance of the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will recover an additional 12 Nightsoul points over 2s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."

mualani.name: Surfing Atop Joyous Seas
mualani.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Surfshark Wavebreaker</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

mualani.name: Sharky Eats Puffies
mualani.description:
Mualani regenerates 8 Energy when obtaining a Puffer. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."
Additionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Boomsharka-laka</color> deals 75% increased DMG.

mualani.name: Same Style of Surfboard on Sale!
mualani.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Boomsharka-laka</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

mualani.name: Spirit of the Springs' People
mualani.description: The DMG increase from the Constellation "The Leisurely 'Meztli'..." is no longer limited to being triggered once every Nightsoul's Blessing.

xilonen.name: Sabbatical Phrase
xilonen.description:
Xilonen's Nightsoul point and Phlogiston consumption in her Nightsoul's Blessing state is decreased by 30%, and her Nightsoul point time limit is extended by 45%.
Additionally, when Xilonen's Source Samples are active, she can also increase nearby active characters' interruption resistance.

xilonen.name: Chiucue Mix
xilonen.description:
Xilonen's <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> Source Samples will always remain active. Additionally, when her Source Samples activate, all nearby party members will gain effects corresponding to the active Source Sample that matches their Elemental Type:
·<color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color>: DMG dealt +50%.
·<color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>: ATK +45%.
·<color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>: Max HP +45%.
·<color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>: CRIT DMG +60%.
·<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>: Restore 25 Energy, decrease Elemental Burst CD by 6s.

xilonen.name: Tonalpohualli's Loop
xilonen.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Yohual's Scratch</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xilonen.name: Suchitl's Trance
xilonen.description:
After Xilonen uses <color=#FFD780FF>Yohual's Scratch</color>, she will grant all nearby party members the Blooming Blessing effect for 15s.
Characters with Blooming Blessing deal 65% of Xilonen's DEF as increased Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG. This effect will be removed after triggering 6 times or when the duration ends.
When you hit more than one opponent, trigger counts will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit. The counts for each party member with Blooming Blessing are counted independently.

xilonen.name: Tlaltecuhtli's Crossfade
xilonen.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Ocelotlicue Point!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

xilonen.name: Imperishable Night Carnival
xilonen.description:
When Xilonen is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, when she sprints, leaps, or uses Normal or Plunging Attacks, she will gain Imperishable Night's Blessing, ignoring the limitations of her Nightsoul's Blessing state and increasing the DMG dealt by her Normal and Plunging Attacks for 5s.
During this time:
·Her Nightsoul's Blessing time limit countdown will be paused. Xilonen's Nightsoul points, Phlogiston, and Stamina will not decrease, and when her Nightsoul points reach the maximum, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will not end either.
·Xilonen deals 300% of her DEF as increased Normal and Plunging Attack DMG while in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
·She heals nearby party members for 120% of her DEF every 1.5s.
She can gain 1 Imperishable Night's Blessing once every 15s.

ororon.name: Trails Amidst the Forest Fog
ororon.description:
The Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Night's Sling</color>'s <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Orb</color> can bounce 2 additional times.
Additionally, after the <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Orb</color> hits an opponent, it will apply the Nighttide effect to them for 12s. Opponents affected by Nighttide take 50% increased DMG from Hypersense triggered by the Ascension Talent, "Nightshade Synesthesia." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."

ororon.name: King Bee of the Hidden Honeyed Wine
ororon.description:
After using his Elemental Burst, <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color>, Ororon will obtain the Spiritual Supersense effect for 9s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Spiritual Supersense</color>
Gain 8% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color>.
Additionally, during this time, every additional opponent hit by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Supersonic Oculus</color> will grant Ororon a further 8% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color>. The maximum that can be gained this way is 32% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color>.

ororon.name: Roosting Bat's Spiritcage
ororon.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

ororon.name: As the Mysteries of the Night Wind
ororon.description:
The <color=#FFD780FF>Supersonic Oculus</color> summoned by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color> rotates 25% faster.
Additionally, Ororon will restore 8 Energy to himself after using <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color>.

ororon.name: A Gift For the Soul
ororon.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Night's Sling</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

ororon.name: Ode to Deep Springs
ororon.description:
After triggering Hypersense through the Ascension Talent, Nightshade Synesthesia, your current active character's ATK is increased by 10% for 9s. Max 3 stacks, each stack is counted independently.
Additionally, when you use the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color>, you will trigger one instance of an effect equivalent to Hypersense, dealing 200% of its original DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."

mavuika.name: The Night-Lord's Explication
mavuika.description:
Mavuika's maximum Nightsoul points are increased to 120, and she gains Fighting Spirit 25% more efficiently.
Additionally, she gains 40% ATK for 8s after gaining Fighting Spirit.

mavuika.name: The Ashen Price
mavuika.description:
When in the Nightsoul's Blessing State, Mavuika's Base ATK is increased by 200, and she obtains the following effects based on All-Fire Armaments' form:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: Nearby opponents' DEF is decreased by 20%.
· Flamestrider: Mavuika's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and her Sunfell Slice from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color> deal 60%, 90%, and 120% of her ATK as increased DMG respectively.

mavuika.name: The Burning Sun
mavuika.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

mavuika.name: The Leader's Resolve
mavuika.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent "Kiongozi":
The DMG increase gained after using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color> will not decay over time, and an additional 10% DMG Bonus will be gained.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Kiongozi."

mavuika.name: The Meaning of Truth
mavuika.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>The Named Moment</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

mavuika.name: "Humanity's Name" Unfettered
mavuika.description:
The All-Fire Armaments from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>The Named Moment</color> receive all-round improvements:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: When the Ring's attacks hit opponents, a Flamestrider will crash into the struck opponent, dealing 200% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color>.
· Flamestrider: When Mavuika is riding the Flamestrider, she will also summon a Scorching Ring of Searing Radiance to follow her, which will decrease nearby opponents' DEF by 20% and deal 500% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> to nearby opponents once every 3s. Mavuika's terrain-crossing abilities will also be further improved.

Additionally, when Mavuika is riding her Flamestrider and is not in combat, when her Nightsoul points drop to 5, she will gain 80 Nightsoul points. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

citlali.name: Radiant Blades of Centzon Mimixcoah
citlali.description:
When she uses the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color>, Citlali gains the "Opalstar Vestments" effect until Itzpapa leaves the field. During this time, she will obtain 10 stacks of Stellar Blade. When a nearby active character other than Citlali deals DMG using Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts, 1 stack of Stellar Blade will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
After nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, Citlali will gain another 3 stacks of Stellar Blade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.

Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> will reset Stellar Blade stacks.
Additionally, when Citlali is using her leap, or is Aiming or using her Charged Attack in mid-air, her Phlogiston consumption is decreased by 45%.

citlali.name: Heart Devourer's Travail
citlali.description:
Citlali gains 125 Elemental Mastery, and other characters shielded by her Opal Shield, or who have Itzpapa following them, gain 250 Elemental Mastery.
Additionally, when the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is used, nearby active characters will also be granted an Opal Shield.

Also, the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" has its effects enhanced:
While Itzpapa is on the field, after nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, the opponent(s) affected by this reaction will have their <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color> and <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> RES additionally decreased by 20% for 12s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" to gain access to the above effect.

citlali.name: Cloud Serpent's Feathered Crown
citlali.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

citlali.name: Death Defier's Spirit Skull
citlali.description: While the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is active, when Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm hits opponents, an additional <color=#FFD780FF>Obsidian Spiritvessel Skull</color> will be summoned. When a Spiritvessel Skull summoned this way explodes, it deals 1800% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> and restores 16 Nightsoul points and 8 Energy for Citlali. This effect can trigger once every 8s. This DMG is not considered Elemental Burst DMG.

citlali.name: Nemontemi's Hex
citlali.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Edict of Entwined Splendor</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

citlali.name: Teoiztac's Secret Pact
citlali.description:
After being summoned with the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color>, Itzpapa will always be in the Opal Fire state, and when Nightsoul points are exhausted, this state will not end.
Additionally, when <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is used, Itzpapa will consume all Nightsoul points, and while it is on the field, it will continuously consume Nightsoul points. Each Nightsoul point consumed in this way will grant Citlali 1 "Cifra of the Secret Law" point.
A maximum of 40 such points can be gained, and each point Citlali possesses will grant all nearby party members a 1.5% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color> and <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> DMG Bonus, and increase the DMG Citlali deals by 2.5%.
When Itzpapa leaves the field, or upon using Citlali's Elemental Skill again, all "Cifra of the Secret Law" points she has will be removed.

lanyan.name: "As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds"
lanyan.description:
After triggering the Elemental Absorption from the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms," this instance of Lan Yan's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> will produce another Feathermoon Ring when they are thrown at opponents.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms."

lanyan.name: "Dance Vestments Billow Like Rainbow Jade"
lanyan.description: While the <color=#FFD780FF>Swallow-Wisp Shield</color> is active, when your active party member's Normal Attacks deal DMG, 40% of the Shield's DMG absorption will be restored, up to its original maximum absorption. This effect can occur once every 2s.

lanyan.name: "On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog"
lanyan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

lanyan.name: "With Drakefalcon's Blood-Pearls Adorned"
lanyan.description: After Lan Yan uses her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Lustrous Moonrise</color>, the Elemental Mastery of all nearby party members increases by 60 for 12s.

lanyan.name: "Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened"
lanyan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lustrous Moonrise</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

lanyan.name: "Let Us Away on Sylphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"

iansan.name: Starting's Never Easy
iansan.description: When Iansan is in combat and is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will restore 15 Elemental Energy for every 6 Nightsoul points she consumes. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

iansan.name: Laziness is the Enemy!
iansan.description: When using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>The Three Principles of Power</color>, Iansan will also gain the Precise Movement effect from her Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" for 15s. Additionally, if Iansan is off-field while Precise Movement is active, she will also increase your current active character's ATK by 30%. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" to access the above effect.

iansan.name: Scientific Diet Planning
iansan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderbolt Rush</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

iansan.name: Slow and Steady Wins the Race
iansan.description:
When the Kinetic Energy Scale is present, Iansan will gain 2 stacks of Surging Force after your current active character (excluding herself) uses their Elemental Burst. The stacks last until the Scale leaves the field, and Surging Force can be gained once per Scale summoning. Whenever Iansan restores Nightsoul points via the Scale, she will consume 1 Surging Force stack and restore 4 additional Nightsoul points.
Additionally, if her Nightsoul restoration from the Scale overflows, Iansan will gain 50% of the overflow the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale.

iansan.name: We Can Push It Further!
iansan.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>The Three Principles of Power</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

iansan.name: Teachings of the Collective of Plenty
iansan.description:
The Kinetic Energy Scale's duration is increased by 3s.
Additionally, when Iansan triggers Nightsoul point restoration, if there is any overflow, she will gain the Extreme Force effect, which increases the DMG dealt by your current active character by 25% for 3s.

yumemizukimizuki.name: In Mist-Like Waters
yumemizukimizuki.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to nearby opponents for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent has a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction triggered against them by Anemo DMG while the aforementioned effect is active, the effect will be canceled, and this Swirl or Stellar Swirl instance deals DMG against this opponent increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, respectively.

yumemizukimizuki.name: Your Echo I Meet in Dreams
yumemizukimizuki.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki enters the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point she has will increase all nearby party members' <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>, and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> DMG Bonuses by 0.04% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.

yumemizukimizuki.name: Till Dawn's Moon Ends Night
yumemizukimizuki.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yumemizukimizuki.name: Buds Warm Lucid Springs
yumemizukimizuki.description: Picking up a <color=#FFD780FF>Yumemi Style Special Snack</color> from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Anraku Secret Spring Therapy</color> will both deal DMG and heal, and will restore 5 Energy to Yumemizuki Mizuki. Energy can be restored this way 4 times per <color=#FFD780FF>Anraku Secret Spring Therapy</color> duration.

yumemizukimizuki.name: As Setting Moon Brings Year's End
yumemizukimizuki.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Anraku Secret Spring Therapy</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

yumemizukimizuki.name: The Heart Lingers Long
yumemizukimizuki.description: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. Any Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by these characters will also have its CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG increased by 10% and 20%, respectively.

escoffier.name: Pre-Dinner Dance for Your Taste Buds
escoffier.description:
When 4 party members are <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>, all nearby party members will have their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> CRIT DMG increased by 60% for 15s after Escoffier uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11122}Low-Temperature Cooking{/LINK}</color> or Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11125}Scoring Cuts{/LINK}</color>.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning."

escoffier.name: Fresh, Fragrant Stew Is an Art
escoffier.description:
When Escoffier activates her Cooking Mek in its {LINK#N11120001}<color=#FFD780FF>Cold Storage Mode</color>{/LINK}, she will gain the "Freshly-Prepped Delicacy" effect for 15s. During this time, Escoffier will gain 5 Cold Dish stacks. When nearby active characters apart from Escoffier deal <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> with a Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attack, or an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they will expend 1 Cold Dish stack to increase their DMG dealt by 240% of Escoffier's ATK.
If you hit multiple opponents with a single instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>, Cold Dish stacks will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit.

escoffier.name: The Bakery Magic of Caramel Browning
escoffier.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11122}Low-Temperature Cooking{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

escoffier.name: Secret Rosemary Recipe
escoffier.description:
{LINK#P1122101}<color=#FFD780FF>Rehab Diet</color>{/LINK} lasts 6 more seconds. While it is active, you have a chance of healing 100% extra HP and restoring 2 Energy to Escoffier when you trigger healing through <color=#FFD780FF>Rehab Diet</color>. This chance corresponds to Escoffier's CRIT Rate. You can trigger this effect 7 times during any one <color=#FFD780FF>Rehab Diet</color>'s duration.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Better to Salivate Than Medicate."

escoffier.name: Symphony of a Thousand Sauces
escoffier.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11125}Scoring Cuts{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

escoffier.name: Tea Parties Bursting With Color
escoffier.description:
{LINK#N11120001}<color=#FFD780FF>Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode</color>{/LINK} is enhanced:
· When your party's active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode will fire off another Special-Grade Frosty Parfait, dealing 500% of Escoffier's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, and this effect can be triggered 6 times within the duration of one Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode.

skirk.name: Far to Fall
skirk.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130007}<color=#FFD780FF>Reason Beyond Reason</color>{/LINK}: Every Void Rift absorbed will summon a crystal blade to attack nearby opponents, dealing 500% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason.

skirk.name: Into the Abyss
skirk.description:
After unleashing her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Warp</color>, Skirk will gain 10 additional {LINK#N11130005}<color=#FFD780FF>Serpent's Subtlety</color>{/LINK} points.
When using her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Ruin</color>, the DMG of this Elemental Burst instance will be increased by taking up to 10 more Serpent's Subtlety points into account.
Additionally, within 12.5s after Skirk unleashes the special Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Extinction</color> while in her {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode, her ATK is increased by 70%. This effect will be canceled when she leaves the Seven-Phase Flash mode.

skirk.name: Serendipitous Sin
skirk.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11145}<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Ruin</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

skirk.name: Fractured Flow
skirk.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130008}<color=#FFD780FF>Return to Oblivion</color>{/LINK}: Each Death's Crossing stack also increases Skirk's ATK by 10%/20%/40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Return to Oblivion.

skirk.name: End of Wishes
skirk.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11142}<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Warp</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

skirk.name: To the Source
skirk.description:
Each Void Rift Skirk absorbs via the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130007}<color=#FFD780FF>Reason Beyond Reason</color>{/LINK} will grant her 1 Havoc: Sever stack. She can consume such stacks to initiate coordinated attacks and decrease the DMG she takes while in {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode. These stacks last for 15s, and each stack's duration is counted independently (max 3 stacks).
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Reason Beyond Reason."

<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color>
· When Skirk uses the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Ruin</color>, she will consume all <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stacks to initiate a coordinated attack in which each <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will deal 750% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
· When she uses Normal Attacks while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will be consumed when her third or fifth sequenced attacks hit an opponent to launch 3 coordinated attacks. Each coordinated attack deals 180% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This damage is considered Normal Attack DMG.
· When Skirk takes DMG while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will be consumed to decrease this DMG instance by 80% and attack nearby opponents 3 times, with each attack dealing 180% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.

dahlia.name: Infallible Procession
dahlia.description: Each time Dahlia gains 1 of his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Benison stacks, he will regain 2.5 Elemental Energy.

dahlia.name: Revelation of Mercy
dahlia.description: After Dahlia consumes his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Benison stacks to summon a Shield of Sacred Favor, the character protected by said Shield will gain 25% increased Shield Strength for 12s.

dahlia.name: Windblume Offertory
dahlia.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

dahlia.name: Collect of the Assembly
dahlia.description: The Favonian Favor from Dahlia's Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color> lasts 3 more seconds.

dahlia.name: Let It Be Subtly So
dahlia.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11152}Immersive Ordinance{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

dahlia.name: You Shall Go Out With Joy
dahlia.description:
The current active character affected by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Favonian Favor has their ATK SPD increased by 10%.
Additionally, when an active character affected by Favonian Favor falls, immediately:
· Revive them.
· Restore their HP to 100%.
This effect can trigger once every 15 minutes.

ifa.name: Vitiferous Elixir's Concoction
