constellations.name: The War Within
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Subjugation: Koukou Sendou</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Conclusive Proof
constellations.description: The number of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster released by <color=#FFD780FF>Subjugation: Koukou Sendou</color> is increased to 6.

constellations.name: Spellsinger
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Tengu Stormcall</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sin of Pride
constellations.description: The <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> of characters who have had their ATK increased by Tengu Juurai has its CRIT DMG increased by 60%.

constellations.name: Stay a While and Listen Up
constellations.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!</color>, Arataki Itto gains 2 stacks of Superlative Superstrength. After 1s, Itto will gain 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength every 0.5s for 1.5s.

constellations.name: Gather 'Round, It's a Brawl!
constellations.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!</color>, each party member whose Element is <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> will decrease that skill's CD by 1.5s and restore 6 Energy to Arataki Itto.
CD can be decreased by up to 4.5s in this manner. Max 18 Energy can be restored in this manner.

constellations.name: Horns Lowered, Coming Through
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Jailhouse Bread and Butter
constellations.description: When the Raging Oni King state caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!</color> ends, all nearby party members gain 20% DEF and 20% ATK for 10s.

constellations.name: 10 Years of Hanamizaka Fame
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Arataki Itto, Present!
constellations.description: Arataki Itto's Charged Attacks deal +70% CRIT DMG. Additionally, when he uses Arataki Kesagiri, he has a 50% chance to not consume stacks of Superlative Superstrength.

constellations.name: Yakan Offering
constellations.description: Each time <color=#FFD780FF>Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin</color> activates a Tenko Thunderbolt, Yae Miko will restore 8 Elemental Energy for herself.

constellations.name: Fox's Mooncall
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Sesshou Sakura</color> start at Level 2 when created, their max level is increased to 4, and their attack range is increased by 60%.

constellations.name: The Seven Glamours
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sakura Channeling
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Sesshou Sakura</color> lightning hits opponents, the <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> of all nearby party members is increased by 20% for 5s.

constellations.name: Mischievous Teasing
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Forbidden Art: Daisesshou
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>The Sesshou Sakura's</color> attacks will ignore 60% of the opponents' DEF.

constellations.name: Named Juvenile Casebook
constellations.description: For 5s after Shikanoin Heizou takes the field, his Normal Attack SPD is increased by 15%. He also gains 1 Declension stack for <color=#FFD780FF>Heartstopper Strike</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.

constellations.name: Investigative Collection
constellations.description: The pull effect of the Arresting Windtunnel created by <color=#FFD780FF>Windmuster Kick</color> is enhanced, and its duration is increased to 1s.

constellations.name: Esoteric Puzzle Book
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Heartstopper Strike</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Tome of Lies
constellations.description:
The first Windmuster Iris explosion in each <color=#FFD780FF>Windmuster Kick</color> will regenerate 9 Elemental Energy for Shikanoin Heizou. Every subsequent explosion in that Windmuster Kick will each regenerate an additional 1.5 Energy for Heizou.
One <color=#FFD780FF>Windmuster Kick</color> can regenerate a total of 13.5 Energy for Heizou in this manner.

constellations.name: Secret Archive
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Windmuster Kick</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Curious Casefiles
constellations.description: Each Declension stack will increase the CRIT Rate of the <color=#FFD780FF>Heartstopper Strike</color> unleashed by 4%. When Heizou possesses Conviction, this Heartstopper Strike's CRIT DMG is increased by 32%.

constellations.name: Enter the Plotters
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Lingering Lifeline</color> gains 1 additional charge.

constellations.name: Taking All Comers
constellations.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Exquisite Throw</color> conducts a coordinated attack, it will fire an additional water arrow that will deal 14% of Yelan's Max HP as Hydro DMG.
This effect can trigger once every 1.8s.

constellations.name: Beware the Trickster's Dice
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Depth-Clarion Dice</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Bait-and-Switch
constellations.description: Increases all party members' Max HP by 10% for 25s for every opponent marked by <color=#FFD780FF>Lifeline</color> when the Lifeline explodes. A maximum increase of 40% Max HP can be attained in this manner.

constellations.name: Dealer's Sleight
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lingering Lifeline</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Winner Takes All
constellations.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Depth-Clarion Dice</color>, Yelan will enter the Mastermind state.
In this state, all of Yelan's Normal Attacks will be special Breakthrough Barbs. These Breakthrough Barbs will have similar abilities to normal ones and the DMG dealt will be considered Charged Attack DMG, dealing 156% of a normal Breakthrough Barb's DMG.

The Mastermind state lasts 20s and will be cleared after Yelan fires 5 arrows.

constellations.name: Material Circulation
constellations.description: Every 8,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will cause her to create 1 extra <color=#FFD780FF>Cat Grass Cardamom</color> when she uses <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch</color>. A maximum of 4 extra can be created this way.

constellations.name: Perfectly Packaged
constellations.description:
When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of <color=#FFD780FF>Meow-teor Kick</color>, she will grant other party members she crashes into Critical Transport Shields.
The DMG absorption of Critical Transport Shield is 40% of the maximum absorption <color=#FFD780FF>Meow-teor Kick</color>'s normal Shields of Safe Transport are capable of, and will absorb <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness.
Critical Transport Shields last 12s and can be triggered once on each character every 10s.

constellations.name: Universal Recognition
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Meow-teor Kick</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Steed of Skanda
constellations.description: After active character(s) protected by <color=#FFD780FF>Shields of Safe Transport</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Critical Transport Shields</color> hit opponents with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, Kirara will perform a coordinated attack with them using <color=#FFD780FF>Small Cat Grass Cardamoms</color>, dealing 200% of her ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color>. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3.8s. This CD is shared between all party members.

constellations.name: A Thousand Miles in a Day
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Countless Sights to See
constellations.description: All nearby party members gain a 12% All Elemental DMG Bonus for 15s after Kirara uses her Elemental Skill or Burst.

constellations.name: Star of Another World
constellations.description: The time has not yet come for this person's corner of the night sky to light up.

constellations.name: Clarity of Heart
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Spring Spirit Summoning</color> can be used 1 more time.

constellations.name: Centered Spirit
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Divine Maiden's Deliverance</color> lasts for 6 seconds longer. Active characters within the skill's field deal 15% increased <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> CRIT DMG.

constellations.name: Seclusion
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spring Spirit Summoning</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Insight
constellations.description:
When characters under the effect of <color=#FFD780FF>Icy Quill</color> applied by Shenhe trigger its DMG Bonus effects, Shenhe will gain a Skyfrost Mantra stack:
· When Shenhe uses <color=#FFD780FF>Spring Spirit Summoning</color>, she will consume all stacks of Skyfrost Mantra, increasing the DMG of that Spring Spirit Summoning by 5% for each stack consumed.
· Max 50 stacks. Stacks last for 60s.

constellations.name: Divine Attainment
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Divine Maiden's Deliverance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Mystical Abandon
constellations.description: When characters trigger <color=#FFD780FF>Icy Quill</color>'s effects using Normal and Charged Attack DMG, it does not count toward the Trigger Quota.

constellations.name: Thespian Gallop
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Opening Flourish's</color> CD is decreased by 18%.

constellations.name: Myriad Mise-En-Scène
constellations.description: After <color=#FFD780FF>Cliffbreaker's Banner</color> is unleashed, all nearby party members' Normal Attack DMG is increased by 15% for 12s.

constellations.name: Seafaring General
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Cliffbreaker's Banner</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Flower and a Fighter
constellations.description: When Yun Jin triggers Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize reactions, her DEF is increased by 20% for 12s.

constellations.name: Famed Throughout the Land
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Opening Flourish</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Decorous Harmony
constellations.description: Characters under the effects of the <color=#FFD780FF>Flying Cloud Flag Formation</color> have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 12%.

constellations.name: To Cloister Compassion
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite</color>'s AoE is increased by 50%.

constellations.name: To Forsake Fortune
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Grass Ring of Sanctification</color>'s duration is increased by 3s.

constellations.name: To Sequester Sorrow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sanctifying Ring</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Sever Sealing
constellations.description:
When the Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks of the character affected by Shinobu's <color=#FFD780FF>Grass Ring of Sanctification</color> hit opponents, a Thundergrass Mark will land on the opponent's position and deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> based on 9.7% of Shinobu's Max HP.
This effect can occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: To Cease Courtesies
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Ward Weakness
constellations.description:
When Kuki Shinobu takes lethal DMG, this instance of DMG will not take her down. This effect will automatically trigger when her HP reaches 1 and will trigger once every 60s.
When Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she will gain 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s. This effect will trigger once every 60s.

constellations.name: Kyouka Fuushi
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Shunsuiken</color> DMG is increased by 40% against opponents with 50% HP or less.

constellations.name: World Source
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Namisen</color>'s maximum stack count is increased to 5. When Kamisato Ayato has at least 3 Namisen stacks, his Max HP is increased by 50%.

constellations.name: To Admire the Flowers
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Kyouka</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Endless Flow
constellations.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Suiyuu</color>, all nearby party members will have 15% increased Normal Attack SPD for 15s.

constellations.name: Bansui Ichiro
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Suiyuu</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Boundless Origin
constellations.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Kamisato Art: Kyouka</color>, Ayato's next Shunsuiken attack will create 2 extra Shunsuiken strikes when they hit opponents, each one dealing 450% of Ayato's ATK as DMG.
Both these Shunsuiken attacks will not be affected by Namisen.

constellations.name: Deepwood Patrol
constellations.description: When in the party and not on the field, Collei's Energy Recharge is increased by 20%.

constellations.name: Through Hill and Copse
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent Floral Sidewinder is changed to this:
The <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Ring</color> will grant the character the Sprout effect from Floral Sidewinder upon return, dealing 40% of Collei's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> to nearby opponents for 3s.
From the moment of using <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Brush</color> to the moment when this instance of Sprout effect ends, if any of your party members triggers Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon reactions, the Sprout effect will be extended by 3s.
The Sprout effect can only be extended this way once. If another Sprout effect is triggered during its initial duration, the initial effect will be removed. DMG dealt by Sprout is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Floral Sidewinder."

constellations.name: Scent of Summer
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Brush</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Gift of the Woods
constellations.description: Using <color=#FFD780FF>Trump-Card Kitty</color> will increase all nearby characters' Elemental Mastery by 60 for 12s (not including Collei herself).

constellations.name: All Embers
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Trump-Card Kitty</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Forest of Falling Arrows
constellations.description:
When the <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Ring</color> hits, it will create a miniature Cuilein-Anbar that will deal 200% of Collei's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color>.
Each <color=#FFD780FF>Floral Brush</color> can only create one such miniature Cuilein-Anbar.

constellations.name: Additional Investment
constellations.description: The number of After-Sales Service Rounds created by <color=#FFD780FF>Troubleshooter Shots</color> is increased by 1.

constellations.name: Special Franchise
constellations.description: When you are in combat and the <color=#FFD780FF>Jinni</color> heals the character it is connected to, it will fire a Jinni Toop from that character's position that deals 50% of Dori's ATK DMG.

constellations.name: Wonders Never Cease
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Alcazarzaray's Exactitude</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Discretionary Supplement
constellations.description:
The character connected to the <color=#FFD780FF>Jinni</color> will obtain the following buffs based on their current HP and Energy:
·When their HP is lower than 50%, they gain 50% Incoming Healing Bonus.
·When their Energy is less than 50%, they gain 30% Energy Recharge.

constellations.name: Value for Mora
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sprinkling Weight
constellations.description:
Dori gains the following effects for 3s after using <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon</color>:
·<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro Infusion</color>.
·When Normal Attacks hit opponents, all nearby party members will heal HP equivalent to 4% of Dori's Max HP. This type of healing can occur once every 0.1s.

constellations.name: Beginnings Determined at the Roots
constellations.description: Tighnari's Charged Attack CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

constellations.name: Origins Known From the Stem
constellations.description:
When there are opponents within the Vijnana-Khanda Field created by <color=#FFD780FF>Vijnana-Phala Mine</color>, Tighnari gains 20% <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG Bonus</color>.
The effect will last up to 6s if the field's duration ends or if it no longer has opponents within it.

constellations.name: Fortunes Read Amongst the Branches
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Withering Glimpsed in the Leaves
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft</color> is unleashed, all nearby party members gain 60 Elemental Mastery for 8s. If the Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft triggers a Burning, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Quicken, or Spread reaction, their Elemental Mastery will be further increased by 60. This latter case will also refresh the buff state's duration.

constellations.name: Comprehension Amidst the Flowers
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Vijnana-Phala Mine</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Karma Adjudged From the Leaden Fruit
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Wreath Arrow</color>'s charging time is decreased by 0.9s, and will produce 1 additional Clusterbloom Arrow upon hit. This arrow deals 150% of Tighnari's ATK as DMG.

constellations.name: Dance of the Waning Moon
constellations.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Haftkarsvar</color> will be enhanced as follows:
·Luminous Illusion DMG is increased by 65%.
·The Tranquility Aura's duration is extended by 6s.

constellations.name: The Starry Skies Their Flowers Rain
constellations.description:
After characters affected by the Golden Chalice's Bounty deal <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> to an opponent, that opponent's <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> will be decreased by 35% for 10s. After dealing Bloom or Lunar-Bloom DMG to opponents, their <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> will be decreased by 35% for 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Court of Dancing Petals."

constellations.name: Beguiling Shadowstep
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Fricative Pulse
constellations.description: After the third dance step of <color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Haftkarsvar</color>'s Pirouette hits opponents, Nilou will gain 15 Elemental Energy, and DMG from her <color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring</color> will be increased by 50% for 8s.

constellations.name: Twirling Light
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dance of Haftkarsvar</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Frostbreaker's Melody
constellations.description:
For every 1,000 points of Max HP, Nilou's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 0.6% and 1.2% respectively.
The maximum increase in CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG via this method is 30% and 60% respectively.

constellations.name: Ordinance: Unceasing Vigil
constellations.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color>, Cyno's Normal Attack SPD will be increased by 20% for 10s. If the Judication effect of his Ascension Talent Featherfall Judgment is triggered during <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer</color>, the duration of this increase will be refreshed.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."

constellations.name: Ceremony: Homecoming of Spirits
constellations.description: When Cyno's Normal Attacks hit opponents, his <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> will increase by 10% for 4s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 5 stacks.

constellations.name: Precept: Lawful Enforcer
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Austerity: Forbidding Guard
constellations.description:
When Cyno is in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color>, after he triggers an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, or Electro Swirl reaction, he will restore 3 Elemental Energy for all nearby party members (except himself.)
This effect can occur 5 times within one use of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color>.

constellations.name: Funerary Rite: The Passing of Starlight
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Raiment: Just Scales
constellations.description:
After using <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness</color> or triggering the Judication effect of the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment," Cyno will gain 4 stacks of the "Day of the Jackal" effect. When he hits opponents with Normal Attacks, he will consume 1 stack of "Day of the Jackal" to fire off one Duststalker Bolt.
"Day of the Jackal" lasts for 8s. Max 8 stacks. It will be canceled once Pactsworn Pathclearer ends.
A maximum of 1 Duststalker Bolt can be unleashed this way every 0.4s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."

constellations.name: Returning Heiress of the Scarlet Sands
constellations.description: The duration of Prayer of the Crimson Crown effect triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide</color> is increased by 3s.

constellations.name: Moon-Piercing Brilliance
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum</color> hits opponents, Candace's Max HP will be increased by 20% for 15s.

constellations.name: Hunter's Supplication
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sentinel Oath
constellations.description: Shortens the Hold CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum</color> to be the same as that of the Tapping CD.

constellations.name: Heterochromatic Gaze
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Overflow
constellations.description:
When characters (excluding Candace herself) affected by the Prayer of the Crimson Crown caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide</color> deal Elemental DMG to opponents using Normal Attacks, an attack wave will be unleashed that deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> equal to 15% of Candace's Max HP.
This effect can trigger once every 2.3s and is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

constellations.name: The Seed of Stored Knowledge
constellations.description: When the <color=#FFD780FF>Shrine of Maya</color> is unleashed and the Elemental Types of the party members are being tabulated, the count will add 1 to the number of Pyro, Electro, and Hydro characters respectively.

constellations.name: The Root of All Fullness
constellations.description:
Opponents that are marked by <color=#FFD780FF>Seeds of Skandha</color> applied by Nahida herself will be affected by the following effects:
· Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon Reaction DMG they receive can score CRIT Hits. CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG are fixed at 20% and 100% respectively. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.
· Within 8s of being affected by Quicken, Aggravate, or Spread, DEF is decreased by 30%.
· The CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of Lunar-Bloom DMG received are increased by 10% and 20% respectively.

constellations.name: The Shoot of Conscious Attainment
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>All Schemes to Know</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Stem of Manifest Inference
constellations.description: When 1/2/3/4 (or more) nearby opponents are affected by <color=#FFD780FF>All Schemes to Know</color>'s Seeds of Skandha, Nahida's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100/120/140/160.

constellations.name: The Leaves of Enlightening Speech
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Illusory Heart</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Fruit of Reason's Culmination
constellations.description:
When Nahida hits an opponent affected by <color=#FFD780FF>All Schemes to Know</color>'s Seeds of Skandha with Normal or Charged Attacks after unleashing <color=#FFD780FF>Illusory Heart</color>, she will use Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion on this opponent and all connected opponents, dealing <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> based on 200% of Nahida's ATK and 400% of her Elemental Mastery.
DMG dealt by Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion is considered Elemental Skill DMG and can be triggered once every 0.2s.
This effect can last up to 10s and will be removed after Nahida has unleashed 6 instances of Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion.

constellations.name: Fortress of Fantasy
constellations.description:
The Shield Absorption of the Curtain of Slumber generated by <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> is increased by 20%.
Additionally, when unleashing Nights of Formal Focus, she will generate a shield for any nearby party members who are not being protected by a Curtain of Slumber. This shield will have 35% of the absorption of a Curtain of Slumber, will last for 12s, and will absorb <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness.

constellations.name: Light's Remit
constellations.description: When Shooting Stars from <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> strike opponents, they will each restore 1 Energy to Layla. Each Shooting Star can restore Energy to her in this manner once.

constellations.name: Secrets of the Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Starry Illumination
constellations.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> starts to fire off Shooting Stars, it will grant all nearby party members the Dawn Star effect, causing their Normal and Charged Attack DMG to increase based on 5% of Layla's Max HP.
Dawn Star can last up to 3s and will be removed 0.05s after dealing Normal or Charged Attack DMG.

constellations.name: Stream of Consciousness
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Radiant Soulfire
constellations.description:
Shooting Stars from <color=#FFD780FF>Nights of Formal Focus</color> deal 40% increased DMG, and Starlight Slugs from <color=#FFD780FF>Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker</color> deal 40% increased DMG.
Additionally, the interval between the creation of Night Stars via Nights of Formal Focus is decreased by 20%.

constellations.name: Shoban: Ostentatious Plumage
constellations.description:
When in the <color=#FFD780FF>Windfavored</color> state, the Attack SPD of the Wanderer's Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai is increased by 10%.
Additionally, the wind arrows fired by the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie" will deal an additional 25% of his ATK as DMG. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie."

constellations.name: Niban: Isle Amidst White Waves
constellations.description:
When in the <color=#FFD780FF>Windfavored</color> state, <color=#FFD780FF>Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays</color> will see its DMG increased by 4% per point of difference between the max amount of Kuugoryoku Points contrasted with Kuugoryoku's present capacity when using this skill.
Through this method, you can increase Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays's DMG by a maximum of 200%.

constellations.name: Sanban: Moonflower Kusemai
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Yonban: Set Adrift into Spring
constellations.description:
When casting <color=#FFD780FF>Hanega: Song of the Wind</color>, should the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower" be triggered, the character will gain buffs in correspondence to the contacted Elemental Type(s), and also obtain a random untriggered buff. A maximum of 3 such corresponding elemental buffs can exist simultaneously.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower."

constellations.name: Matsuban: Ancient Illuminator From Abroad
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hanega: Song of the Wind</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Shugen: The Curtains' Melancholic Sway
constellations.description:
When the Wanderer actively hits an opponent with Kuugo: Fushoudan while in the <color=#FFD780FF>Windfavored</color> state, the following effects will occur:
·Deals an additional instance of Kuugo: Fushoudan at the position hit, dealing 40% of the attack's original DMG. This DMG will be considered Normal Attack DMG.
·When the Wanderer falls below 40 Kuugoryoku Points, restores 4 Points to him. Kuugoryoku Points can be restored in this manner once every 0.2s. This restoration can occur up to 5 times within one Windfavored duration.

constellations.name: Truth by Any Means
constellations.description: Faruzan can fire off a maximum of 2 Hurricane Arrows using fully charged Aimed Shots while under the effect of a single Manifest Gale created by <color=#FFD780FF>Wind Realm of Nasamjnin</color>.

constellations.name: Overzealous Intellect
constellations.description: The duration of the Dazzling Polyhedron created by <color=#FFD780FF>The Wind's Secret Ways</color> is increased by 6s.

constellations.name: Spirit-Orchard Stroll
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Wind Realm of Nasamjnin</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Divine Comprehension
constellations.description:
The vortex created by <color=#FFD780FF>Pressurized Collapses</color> will restore Energy to Faruzan based on the number of opponents hit: If it hits 1 opponent, it will restore 2 Energy for Faruzan. Each additional opponent hit will restore 0.5 more Energy for Faruzan.
A maximum of 4 Energy can be restored to her per vortex.

constellations.name: Wonderland of Rumination
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>The Wind's Secret Ways</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Wondrous Path of Truth
constellations.description: Characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>The Wind's Secret Ways</color>' Prayerful Wind's Benefit have 40% increased CRIT DMG when they deal <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>. When the active character deals DMG while affected by Prayerful Wind's Benefit, they will apply Pressurized Collapse to the opponent damaged. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. This CD is shared between all party members.

constellations.name: Adeptus' Tutelage
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>White Jade Radishes</color> explode, active characters within their AoE will gain 15% <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG Bonus</color> for 8s and have 15 Stamina restored to them. This form of Stamina Restoration can only be triggered every 5s.

constellations.name: Innocent
constellations.description: While affected by the Adeptal Legacy state caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Moonjade Descent</color>, if White Jade Radish explosions hit opponents, 3 Energy will be restored to Yaoyao. This form of Energy regeneration can occur once every 0.8s.

constellations.name: Loyal and Kind
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Raphanus Sky Cluster</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Winsome
constellations.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Raphanus Sky Cluster</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Moonjade Descent</color>, Yaoyao's Elemental Mastery will be increased based on 0.3% of her Max HP for 8s. The maximum Elemental Mastery she can gain this way is 120.

constellations.name: Compassionate
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Moonjade Descent</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Beneficent
constellations.description:
For every 2 White Jade Radishes <color=#FFD780FF>Yuegui: Throwing Mode</color> throws out, the next throw will also release a Mega Radish that will have a larger AoE than the standard White Jade Radish and have the following effects upon exploding:
·Deals <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> based on 75% of Yaoyao's ATK.
·Restores HP for the active character based on 7.5% of Yaoyao's Max HP.

Every Yuegui: Throwing Mode can throw out a maximum of 2 Mega Radishes.

constellations.name: Intuition
constellations.description: When a Projection Attack hits an opponent, <color=#FFD780FF>Universality: An Elaboration on Form</color>'s CD is decreased by 1.2s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

constellations.name: Debate
constellations.description: When Alhaitham generates a Chisel-Light Mirror, his Elemental Mastery will be increased by 50 for 8 seconds, max 4 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently. This effect can be triggered even when the maximum number of Chisel-Light Mirrors has been reached.

constellations.name: Negation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Universality: An Elaboration on Form</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Elucidation
constellations.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena</color> is unleashed, the following effects will become active based on the number of Chisel-Light Mirrors consumed and created this time around:
·Each Mirror consumed will increase the Elemental Mastery of all other nearby party members by 30 for 15s.
·Each Mirror generated will grant Alhaitham a 10% <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG Bonus</color> for 15s.

The pre-existing duration of the aforementioned effects will be cleared if you use Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena again while they are in effect.

constellations.name: Sagacity
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Structuration
constellations.description:
Alhaitham gains the following effects:
· 2 seconds after <color=#FFD780FF>Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena</color> is unleashed, he will generate 3 Chisel-Light Mirrors regardless of the number of mirrors consumed.
· If Alhaitham generates Chisel-Light Mirrors when their numbers have already maxed out, his CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 10% and 70% respectively for 6s. If this effect is triggered again during its initial duration, the duration remaining will be increased by 6s.

constellations.name: The Flame Incandescent
constellations.description:
Dehya's Max HP is increased by 20%, and she deals bonus DMG based on her Max HP when using the following attacks:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Molten Inferno</color>'s DMG will be increased by 3.6% of her Max HP.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Leonine Bite</color>'s DMG will be increased by 6% of her Max HP.

constellations.name: The Sand-Blades Glittering
constellations.description:
When Dehya uses <color=#FFD780FF>Molten Inferno: Ranging Flame</color>, the duration of the recreated Fiery Sanctum field will be increased by 6s.
Additionally, when a Fiery Sanctum exists on the field, DMG dealt by its next coordinated attack will be increased by 50% when active character(s) within the Fiery Sanctum field are attacked.

constellations.name: A Rage Swift as Fire
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Leonine Bite</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: An Oath Abiding
constellations.description: When Flame-Mane's Fist and Incineration Drive attacks unleashed during <color=#FFD780FF>Leonine Bite</color> hit opponents, they will restore 1.5 Energy for Dehya and 2.5% of her Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s.

constellations.name: The Alpha Unleashed
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Molten Inferno</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Burning Claws Cleaving
constellations.description:
The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFD780FF>Leonine Bite</color> is increased by 10%.
Additionally, after a Flame-Mane's Fist attack hits an opponent and deals CRIT Hits during a single Blazing Lioness state, it will cause the CRIT DMG of Leonine Bite to increase by 15% for the rest of Blazing Lioness's duration and extend that duration by 0.5s. This effect can be triggered every 0.2s. The duration can be extended for a maximum of 2s and CRIT DMG can be increased by a maximum of 60% this way.

constellations.name: Factor Confluence
constellations.description: The Soulwind state of <color=#FFD780FF>Starfrost Swirl</color> can decrease the healing interval between instances caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Skyfeather Song</color>'s Eagleplume state. This decrease percentage is equal to the ATK SPD increase provided by Soulwind.

constellations.name: Companion's Ingress
constellations.description:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Starfrost Swirl</color>'s Flowfrost Arrow first hits an opponent, or its Rimestar Flare hits an opponent, 1 Detector stack from the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage" will be generated.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage."

constellations.name: Reconnaissance Experience
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Skyfeather Song</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sunfrost Encomium
constellations.description: When Mika's own <color=#FFD780FF>Skyfeather Song</color>'s Eagleplume state heals party members, this will restore 3 Energy to Mika. This form of Energy restoration can occur 5 times during the Eagleplume state created by 1 use of Skyfeather Song.

constellations.name: Signal Arrow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Starfrost Swirl</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Companion's Counsel
constellations.description:
The maximum number of Detector stacks that <color=#FFD780FF>Starfrost Swirl</color>'s Soulwind can gain is increased by 1. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage.".
Additionally, active characters affected by Soulwind will deal 60% more Physical CRIT DMG.

constellations.name: Sublime Salutations
constellations.description: Within 3s after using <color=#FFD780FF>Artistic Ingenuity</color>, Kaveh's <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> and Incoming Healing Bonus will be increased by 50% and 25% respectively.

constellations.name: Grace of Royal Roads
constellations.description: Kaveh's Normal Attack SPD increases by 15% during <color=#FFD780FF>Painted Dome</color>.

constellations.name: Profferings of Dur Untash
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Painted Dome</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Feast of Apadana
constellations.description: Dendro Cores created from Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions Kaveh triggers will deal 60% more DMG when they burst.

constellations.name: Treasures of Bonkhanak
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Artistic Ingenuity</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Pairidaeza's Dreams
constellations.description: When Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents during <color=#FFD780FF>Painted Dome</color>, they will unleash Pairidaeza's Light upon the opponent's position, dealing 61.8% of Kaveh's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> and causing all Dendro Cores within that AoE to burst. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

constellations.name: Attentive Observation
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Universal Diagnosis</color> gains 1 additional charge.

constellations.name: Incisive Discernment
constellations.description:
When your own active character hits a nearby opponent with their attacks, Baizhu will unleash a Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
Gossamer Sprite: Splice will initiate 1 attack before returning, dealing 250% of Baizhu's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> and healing for 20% of <color=#FFD780FF>Universal Diagnosis</color>'s Gossamer Sprite's normal healing.
DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellations.name: All Aspects Stabilized
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Holistic Revivification</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Ancient Art of Perception
constellations.description: For 15s after <color=#FFD780FF>Holistic Revivification</color> is used, Baizhu will increase all nearby party members' Elemental Mastery by 80.

constellations.name: The Hidden Ebb and Flow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Universal Diagnosis</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Elimination of Malicious Qi
constellations.description:
Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Holistic Revivification</color>'s Spiritveins by 8% of Baizhu's Max HP.
Additionally, when a <color=#FFD780FF>Gossamer Sprite</color> or Gossamer Sprite: Splice hits opponents, there is a 100% chance of generating one of <color=#FFD780FF>Holistic Revivification</color>'s Seamless Shields. This effect can only be triggered once by each Gossamer Sprite or Gossamer Sprite: Splice.

constellations.name: A Cold Blade Like a Shadow
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Enigmatic Feint</color>'s Enigma Thrust hits an opponent with Shadowsign, a vortex will be created at that opponent's position that will pull nearby opponents in.

constellations.name: Endless Mysteries
constellations.description: Whenever the Bogglecat Box summoned by <color=#FFD780FF>Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift</color> fires a Vivid Shot, it will fire an extra Vivid Shot.

constellations.name: Cognition-Inverting Gaze
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Tacit Coordination
constellations.description: Increases <color=#FFD780FF>Enigmatic Feint</color>'s charges by 1.

constellations.name: Obscuring Ambiguity
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Enigmatic Feint</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Watchful Eye
constellations.description: When Lynette uses <color=#FFD780FF>Enigmatic Feint</color>'s Enigma Thrust, she will gain an <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo Infusion</color> and 20% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> for 6s.

constellations.name: Whimsical Wonders
constellations.description:
Lyney can have 2 <color=#FFD780FF>Grin-Malkin Hats</color> present at once.
Additionally, Prop Arrows will summon 2 Grin-Malkin Hats and grant Lyney 1 extra stack of Prop Surplus. This effect can occur once every 15s.

constellations.name: Loquacious Cajoling
constellations.description: When Lyney is on the field, he will gain a stack of Crisp Focus every 2s. Each stack will increase his CRIT DMG by 20%. Max 3 stacks. This effect will be canceled when Lyney leaves the field.

constellations.name: Prestidigitation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Card Force Translocation</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Well-Versed, Well-Rehearsed
constellations.description: After an opponent is hit by Lyney's <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color> Charged Attack, this opponent's <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro RES</color> will be decreased by 20% for 6s.

constellations.name: To Pierce Enigmas
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Wondrous Trick: Miracle Parade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Guarded Smile
constellations.description: When Lyney fires a <color=#FFD780FF>Prop Arrow</color>, he will fire a Pyrotechnic Strike: Reprised that will deal 80% of a Pyrotechnic Strike's DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.

constellations.name: Dreams of the Foamy Deep
constellations.description: The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFD780FF>Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure</color> will be increased by 15%.

constellations.name: Penguins and the Land of Plenty
constellations.description: Unleashing <color=#FFD780FF>Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure</color> will restore 2 Energy to Freminet. If a Pressure Level 4 Shattering Pressure is unleashed, this will restore 3 Energy.

constellations.name: Song of the Eddies and Bleached Sands
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Dance of the Snowy Moon and Flute
constellations.description: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his ATK will be increased by 9% for 6s. Max 2 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.

constellations.name: Nights of Hearth and Happiness
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Pressurized Floe</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Moment of Waking and Resolve
constellations.description: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his CRIT DMG will be increased by 12% for 6s. Max 3 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.

constellations.name: Terror for the Evildoers
constellations.description:
The Gracious Rebuke from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" is changed to this:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60% or while he is in the Chilling Penalty state caused by <color=#FFD780FF>Icefang Rush</color>, when the fifth attack of Repelling Fists hits, it will create a Gracious Rebuke. 1 Gracious Rebuke effect can be obtained every 2.5s.

Additionally, Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will obtain the following enhancement:
· The DMG Bonus gained will be further increased to 200%.
· When it hits while Wriothesley is in the Chilling Penalty state, that state's duration is extended by 4s. 1 such extension can occur per 1 Chilling Penalty duration.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."

constellations.name: Shackles for the Arrogant
constellations.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Darkgold Wolfbite</color>, each Prosecution Edict stack from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin" will increase said ability's DMG dealt by 40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin."

constellations.name: Punishment for the Frauds
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Redemption for the Suffering
constellations.description:
The HP restored to Wriothesley through Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased to 50% of his Max HP. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
Additionally, when Wriothesley is healed, if the amount of healing overflows, the following effects will occur depending on whether he is on the field or not. If he is on the field, his ATK SPD will be increased by 20% for 4s. If he is off-field, all of your own party members' ATK SPD will be increased by 10% for 6s. These two methods of increasing ATK SPD cannot stack.

constellations.name: Mercy for the Wronged
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Darkgold Wolfbite</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Esteem for the Innocent
constellations.description:
The CRIT Rate of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased by 10%, and its CRIT DMG by 80%. When unleashed, it will also create an additional icicle that deals 100% of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist's Base DMG as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. DMG dealt this way is regarded as Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."

constellations.name: Venerable Institution
constellations.description:
When Neuvillette takes the field, he will obtain 1 stack of Past Draconic Glories from the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."
Additionally, his interruption resistance will be increased while using the Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation and the Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment.

constellations.name: Juridical Exhortation
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" will be enhanced: Each stack of Past Draconic Glories will increase the CRIT DMG of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 14%. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 42%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."

constellations.name: Ancient Postulation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: As Water Seeks Equilibrium</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Crown of Commiseration
constellations.description: When Neuvillette is on the field and is healed, 1 Sourcewater Droplet will be generated. This effect can occur once every 4s.

constellations.name: Axiomatic Judgment
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>O Tides, I Have Returned</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Wrathful Recompense
constellations.description:
When using Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, Neuvillette can absorb nearby Sourcewater Droplets in an AoE. Each absorbed Droplet will increase the duration of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 1s.
Additionally, when Equitable Judgment hits opponents, it will fire off 2 additional currents every 2s, each of which will deal 10% of Neuvillette's Max HP as <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>. DMG dealt this way will count as DMG dealt by Equitable Judgment.

constellations.name: A Need to Verify Facts
constellations.description: After <color=#FFD780FF>Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation</color> heals a character, it will mark them with Verification, which will heal them once every 2s for 80% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect lasts 6s.

constellations.name: A Duty to Pursue Truth
constellations.description: When using <color=#FFD780FF>Framing: Freezing Point Composition</color>, when Monsieur Verite hits 1/2/3 (or more) opponents, Charlotte's own ATK will be increased by 10%/20%/30% for 12s.

constellations.name: An Imperative to Independence
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: A Responsibility to Oversee
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation</color> hits an opponent marked by Snappy Silhouette or Focused Impression, it will deal 10% more DMG and restore 2 Energy to Charlotte. This restoration can be triggered 5 times every 20s.

constellations.name: A Principle of Conscience
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Framing: Freezing Point Composition</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: A Summation of Interest
constellations.description: When the active character's Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent marked by <color=#FFD780FF>Framing: Freezing Point Composition</color>'s Focused Impression, Monsieur Verite will initiate a coordinated attack that deals 180% of Charlotte's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> and heals active character(s) within the AoE for 42% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 6s and both DMG and healing dealt in this way will be considered as having been done by Charlotte's Elemental Burst.

constellations.name: "Love Is a Rebellious Bird That None Can Tame"
constellations.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Let the People Rejoice</color>, Furina will gain 150 Fanfare.
Additionally, Furina's Fanfare limit is increased by 100.

constellations.name: "A Woman Adapts Like Duckweed in Water"
constellations.description: While <color=#FFD780FF>Let the People Rejoice</color> lasts, Furina's Fanfare gain from increases or decreases in nearby characters' HP is increased by 250%. Each point of Fanfare above the limit will increase Furina's Max HP by 0.35%. Her maximum Max HP increase is 140%.

constellations.name: "My Secret Is Hidden Within Me, No One Will Know My Name"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Let the People Rejoice</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "They Know Not Life, Who Dwelt in the Netherworld Not!"
constellations.description: When the Salon Members from <color=#FFD780FF>Salon Solitaire</color> hit an opponent, or the Singer of Many Waters restores HP to nearby active characters, Furina will restore 4 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellations.name: "His Name I Now Know, It Is...!"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Salon Solitaire</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Hear Me — Let Us Raise the Chalice of Love!"
constellations.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Salon Solitaire</color>, Furina gains "Center of Attention" for 10s.
Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted into <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion. DMG is also increased by an amount equivalent to 18% of Furina's max HP.
Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attacks, and the impact of Plunging Attacks will cause different effects up to every 0.1s after hitting opponents depending on her current Arkhe alignment:

Arkhe: Ousia
Every 1s, all nearby characters in the party will be healed by 4% of Furina's max HP, for a duration of 2.9s. Triggering this effect again will extend its duration.
Arkhe: Pneuma
This Normal Attack (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack ground impact DMG will be further increased by an amount equivalent to 25% of Furina's max HP. When any of the attacks mentioned previously hit an opponent, all nearby characters in the party will consume 1% of their current HP.

During the duration of each instance of "Center of Attention," the above effects can be triggered up to 6 times. "Center of Attention" will end when its effects have triggered 6 times or when the duration expires.

constellations.name: Stable Front Line's Resolve
constellations.description:
When the active character with the "Coordinated Tactics" status (not including Chevreuse herself) triggers the Overloaded reaction, they will recover 6 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics."

constellations.name: Sniper Induced Explosion
constellations.description: After Holding <color=#FFD780FF>Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire</color> and hitting a target, 2 chain explosions will be triggered near the location where said target is hit. Each explosion deals <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> equal to 120% of Chevreuse's ATK. This effect can be triggered up to once every 10s, and DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

constellations.name: Practiced Field Stripping Technique
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Secret to Rapid-Fire Multishots
constellations.description: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Ring of Bursting Grenades</color>, the Hold mode of <color=#FFD780FF>Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire</color> will not go on cooldown when Chevreuse uses it. This effect is removed after Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire has been fired twice using Hold or after 6s.

constellations.name: Enhanced Incendiary Firepower
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Ring of Bursting Grenades</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: In Pursuit of Ending Evil
constellations.description:
After 12s of the healing effect from <color=#FFD780FF>Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire</color>, all nearby party members recover HP equivalent to 10% of Chevreuse's Max HP once.
After a party member is healed by Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, they gain a 20% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> for 8s. Max 3 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

constellations.name: A Lady's Rules for Keeping a Courteous Distance
constellations.description: Each stack of Crystal Shrapnel consumed when Navia uses <color=#FFD780FF>Ceremonial Crystalshot</color> will restore 3 Energy to her and decrease the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute</color> by 1s. Up to 9 Energy can be gained this way, and the CD of "As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute" can be decreased by up to 3s.

constellations.name: The President's Pursuit of Victory
constellations.description:
Each stack of Crystal Shrapnel consumed will increase the CRIT Rate of this <color=#FFD780FF>Ceremonial Crystalshot</color> instance by 12%. CRIT Rate can be increased by up to 36% in this way.
In addition, when Ceremonial Crystalshot hits an opponent, one Cannon Fire Support shot from <color=#FFD780FF>As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute</color> will strike near the location of the hit. Up to one instance of Cannon Fire Support can be triggered each time Ceremonial Crystalshot is used, and DMG dealt by said Cannon Fire Support this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

constellations.name: Businesswoman's Broad Vision
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Ceremonial Crystalshot</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Oathsworn Never Capitulate
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute</color> hits an opponent, that opponent's <color=#FFE699FF>Geo RES</color> will be decreased by 20% for 8s.

constellations.name: Negotiator's Resolute Negotiations
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>As the Sunlit Sky's Singing Salute</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Flexible Finesse of the Spina's President
constellations.description: If more than 3 stacks of Crystal Shrapnel are consumed when using <color=#FFD780FF>Ceremonial Crystalshot</color>, each stack consumed beyond the first 3 increases the CRIT DMG of that Ceremonial Crystalshot by 45%, and any stacks consumed beyond the first 3 are returned to Navia.

constellations.name: Bringer of Blessing
constellations.description: When the Suanni Man Chai from <color=#FFD780FF>Suanni's Gilded Dance</color> meets back up with Gaming, it will heal 15% of Gaming's HP.

constellations.name: Plum Blossoms Underfoot
constellations.description: When Gaming receives healing and this instance of healing overflows, his ATK will be increased by 20% for 5s.

constellations.name: Awakening Spirit
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Bestial Ascent</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Soar Across Mountains
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Bestial Ascent</color>'s Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider hits an opponent, it will restore 2 Energy to Gaming. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s.

constellations.name: Evil-Daunting Roar
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Suanni's Gilded Dance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Tame All Beasts
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Bestial Ascent</color>'s Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider CRIT Rate increased by 20% and CRIT DMG increased by 40%, and its attack radius will be increased.

constellations.name: Purifying Wind
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color> gains 1 additional charge.

constellations.name: Aloof From the World
constellations.description:
After using a Skyladder from <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color>, Xianyun's ATK will be increased by 20% for 15s.
Additionally, the effects of the Ascension Talent "Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm" will be enhanced: When the Starwicker created by <color=#FFD780FF>Stars Gather at Dusk</color> has Adeptal Assistance stacks, nearby active characters' Plunging Attack shockwave DMG will be increased by 400% of Xianyun's ATK. The maximum DMG increase that can be achieved this way is 18,000.
Each Plunging Attack shockwave DMG instance can only apply this increased DMG effect to a single opponent. Each character can trigger this effect once every 0.4s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Consider, the Adeptus in Her Realm."

constellations.name: Creations of Star and Moon
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Stars Gather at Dusk</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Mystery Millet Gourmet
constellations.description: After using Skyladder 1/2/3 times during one <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color> Cloud Transmogrification state, when a Driftcloud Wave unleashed during that instance hits an opponent, it will heal all nearby party members for 50%/80%/150% of Xianyun's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellations.name: Astride Rose-Colored Clouds
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: They Call Her Cloud Retainer
constellations.description:
After Xianyun uses 1/2/3 Skyladders within one Cloud Transmogrification caused by <color=#FFD780FF>White Clouds at Dawn</color>, the CRIT DMG of a Driftcloud Wave created in this instance of Cloud Transmogrification will be increased by 15%/35%/70%.
Within 16s after Xianyun has used <color=#FFD780FF>Stars Gather at Dusk</color>, White Clouds at Dawn will not enter CD. This effect will be canceled once she has used White Clouds at Dawn 8 times.

constellations.name: Six Paths of Sage Silkcraft
constellations.description:
The AoE of the automaton doll "Tamoto" summoned by <color=#FFD780FF>Fluttering Hasode</color> is increased by 50%.
Additionally, if there is a <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party member other than Chiori, Fluttering Hasode will trigger the following after the dash is completed:
· Summon an additional Tamoto. Only one additional Tamoto can exist at the same time, whether summoned by Chiori this way or through the presence of a Geo Construct.
· Triggers the Ascension Talent "The Finishing Touch." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Finishing Touch."

constellations.name: In Five Colors Dyed
constellations.description:
For 10s after using <color=#FFD780FF>Hiyoku: Twin Blades</color>, a simplified automaton doll, "Kinu," will be summoned next to your active character every 3s. Kinu will attack nearby opponents, dealing <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color> equivalent to 170% of Tamoto's DMG. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Kinu will leave the field after 1 attack or after lasting 3s.

constellations.name: Four Brocade Embellishments
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Fluttering Hasode</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: A Tailor's Three Courtesies
constellations.description:
For 8s after triggering either follow-up effect of the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made," when your current active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit a nearby opponent, a simplified automaton doll, "Kinu," will be summoned near this opponent. You can summon 1 Kinu every 1s in this way, and up to 3 Kinu may be summoned this way during each instance of "Tailor-Made"'s Seize the Moment or Tailoring effect. The above effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made."

constellations.name: Two Silken Plumules
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hiyoku: Twin Blades</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sole Principle Pursuit
constellations.description:
After triggering a follow-up effect of the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made," Chiori's own <color=#FFD780FF>Fluttering Hasode</color>'s CD is decreased by 12s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tailor-Made.".
In addition, the DMG dealt by Chiori's own Normal Attacks is increased by an amount equal to 235% of her own DEF.

constellations.name: "Can the Happiest of Spirits Understand Anxiety?"
constellations.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Rebound Hydrotherapy</color>'s Bolstering Bubblebalm can bounce 3 extra times, and the first 3 bounces will not cause big Bubblebalms to become smaller.
The Ascension Talent "Requires Appropriate Rest" is enhanced: Each Bubblebalm bounce adds 1 stack to her Convalescence tally, and the values for the Convalescence stacks' DMG bonus will be modified to: Every 1,000 max HP Sigewinne has above 30,000 increases the DMG by 100. The maximum DMG increase for Elemental Skills that can be gained in this way is 3,500. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Requires Appropriate Rest."

constellations.name: "Can the Most Merciful of Spirits Defeat Its Foes?"
constellations.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Rebound Hydrotherapy</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Super Saturated Syringing</color>, Sigewinne can create a Bubbly Shield worth 30% of her Max HP that absorbs <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> with 250% efficiency. The Bubbly Shield will persist until Sigewinne finishes using relevant skills.
Additionally, after Rebound Hydrotherapy's Bolstering Bubblebalm or Super Saturated Syringing hits an opponent, that opponent's <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> will be decreased by 35% for 8s.

constellations.name: "Can the Healthiest of Spirits Cure Fevers?"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Rebound Hydrotherapy</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Can the Loveliest of Spirits Keep Decay at Bay?"
constellations.description: The duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Super Saturated Syringing</color> is extended by 3s.

constellations.name: "Can the Most Joyful of Spirits Alleviate Agony?"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Super Saturated Syringing</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Can the Most Radiant of Spirits Pray For Me?"
constellations.description: When Sigewinne performs healing, she will increase the CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of her <color=#FFD780FF>Super Saturated Syringing</color> based on her Max HP. Every 1,000 Max HP she has will increase CRIT Rate by 0.4% and CRIT DMG by 2.2% for 15s. The maximum increase achievable this way is 20% CRIT Rate and 110% CRIT DMG.

constellations.name: "All Reprisals and Arrears, Mine to Bear..."
constellations.description: Masque of the Red Death is further enhanced, the value of the increase is 100%. Additionally, Arlecchino's interruption resistance is increased when she performs Normal or Charged Attacks while affected by the Masque of the Red Death.

constellations.name: "All Rewards and Retribution, Mine to Bestow..."
constellations.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Blood-Debt Directives</color> are now already Blood-Debt Due when first applied.
When Arlecchino absorbs such a Due, she unleashes Balemoon Bloodfire in front of her, dealing 900% of her ATK as <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> and increasing her All Elemental RES and Physical RES by 20% for 15s. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Agony Alone May Be Repaid."

constellations.name: "You Shall Become a New Member of Our Family..."
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "You Shall Love and Protect Each Other Henceforth..."
constellations.description: When Arlecchino successfully absorbs a Blood-Debt Directive, <color=#FFD780FF>Balemoon Rising</color>'s CD will decrease by 2s and 15 Elemental Energy will be restored to her. This effect can occur once every 10s.

constellations.name: "For Alone, We Are as Good as Dead..."
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Balemoon Rising</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "From This Day On, We Shall Delight in New Life Together."
constellations.description:
The DMG of <color=#FFD780FF>Balemoon Rising</color> is increased by Arlecchino's ATK multiplied by 700% of Arlecchino's current Bond of Life percentage.
For 20s after Arlecchino uses <color=#FFD780FF>All Is Ash</color>, both her Normal Attacks and Elemental Burst gain 10% increased CRIT Rate and 70% increased CRIT DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.

constellations.name: Sealed Shrine's Spiritsong
constellations.description: The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowpiercing Shot</color> is increased by 15%.

constellations.name: Papyrus Scripture of Silent Secrets
constellations.description:
When any of the following conditions are met, Sethos gains a 15% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color> for 10s that may stack twice, with each stack duration counted independently:
· Consuming Elemental Energy through Aimed Shots. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" to trigger this condition.
· Regaining Elemental Energy by triggering Elemental Reactions using <color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Rite: The Thundering Sands</color>.
· Using <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer</color>.

constellations.name: Ode to the Moonrise Sage
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: Royal Reed Archery</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Beneficent Plumage
constellations.description: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowpiercing Shot</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Dusk Bolt</color> strikes 2 or more opponents, all nearby party members gain 80 Elemental Mastery for 10s.

constellations.name: Record of the Desolate God's Burning Sands
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Pylon of the Sojourning Sun Temple
constellations.description: After <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowpiercing Shot</color> strikes an opponent, the Elemental Energy consumed by the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" will be returned. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma."

constellations.name: "From This Day, I Pass the Candle's Shadow-Veil"
constellations.description:
While <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Vigil</color>'s Night Vigil state is active, when <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> from Clorinde's Normal Attacks hit opponents, they will trigger 2 coordinated attacks from a Nightvigil Shade summoned near the hit opponent, each dealing 30% of Clorinde's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.
This effect can occur once every 1.2s. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.

constellations.name: "Now, As We Face the Perils of the Long Night"
constellations.description:
Enhance the Ascension Talent "Dark-Shattering Flame": After a nearby party member triggers an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related reaction</color> against an opponent, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> dealt by Clorinde's Normal Attacks and <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> will be increased by 30% of Clorinde's ATK for 15s. Max 3 stacks. Each stack is counted independently. When you have 3 stacks, Clorinde's interruption resistance will be increased. The Maximum DMG increase achievable this way for the above attacks is 2,700.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Dark-Shattering Flame."

constellations.name: "I Pledge to Remember the Oath of Daylight"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Vigil</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "To Enshrine Tears, Life, and Love"
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> deals DMG to opponent(s), DMG dealt is increased based on Clorinde's Bond of Life percentage. Every 1% of her current Bond of Life will increase <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> DMG by 2%. The maximum <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> DMG increase achievable this way is 200%.

constellations.name: "Holding Dawn's Coming as My Votive"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Last Lightfall</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "And So Shall I Never Despair"
constellations.description:
For 12s after <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Vigil</color> is used, Clorinde's CRIT Rate will be increased by 10%, and her CRIT DMG by 70%.
Additionally, while Night Vigil is active, a Glimbright Shade will appear under specific circumstances, executing an attack that deals 200% of Clorinde's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
The Glimbright Shade will appear under the following circumstances:
· When Clorinde is about to be hit by an attack.
· When Clorinde uses Impale the Night: Pact.
1 Glimbright Shade can be summoned in the aforementioned ways every 1s. 6 Shades can be summoned per single Night Vigil duration.
In addition, while Night Vigil is active, the DMG Clorinde receives is decreased by 80% and her interruption resistance is increased. This effect will disappear after the Night Vigil state ends or 1s after she summons 6 Glimbright Shades.

constellations.name: Light Fragrance Leaching
constellations.description:
Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Fragrance Extraction</color> and her Ascension Talent's Cleardew Cologne "Lingering Fragrance" by 20%. The latter requires unlocking said Ascension Talent first.
Additionally, when nearby party members trigger the Burning reaction on opponents or deal <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> to Burning opponents, they will generate an additional <color=#FFD780FF>Scent</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 2.9s.

constellations.name: Lakelight Top Note
constellations.description: When <color=#FFD780FF>Fragrance Extraction</color>, <color=#FFD780FF>Aromatic Explication</color>, or Cleardew Cologne produced by the Ascension Talent "Lingering Fragrance" (the last of which requires Ascension Talent activation) hits opponents, those opponents' <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> is decreased by 30% for 10s.

constellations.name: Exquisite Essence
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Fragrance Extraction</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Lumidouce Heart Note
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Aromatic Explication</color>'s duration is increased by 2s. The interval between opponents being selected as the target for Scented Dew is decreased by 0.3s.

constellations.name: Puredew Aroma
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Aromatic Explication</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Marcotte Sillage
constellations.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Fragrance Extraction</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Aromatic Explication</color>, Emilie will gain Abiding Fragrance for 5s.
While this is active, after Emilie uses Normal or Charged Attacks, she will generate 1 Scent, and her Normal and Charged Attack DMG will be converted into <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> that cannot be overridden, and the DMG dealt will be increased by 300% of Emilie's ATK.

The Abiding Fragrance effect will be removed after 4 Scents are created this way or after its duration expires. Abiding Fragrance can be triggered once every 12s.

constellations.name: Shards Are Gems Too
constellations.description:
When Kachina mounts or dismounts <color=#FFD780FF>Turbo Twirly</color>, she will absorb nearby Elemental Shards created by Crystallize.
Additionally, when a party member picks up such a Shard, or triggers Lunar-Crystallize reactions, 3 Energy will be restored to Kachina. Energy can be restored this way once every 5s.

constellations.name: Never Leave Home Without... Turbo Twirly
constellations.description: When Kachina uses <color=#FFD780FF>"Time to Get Serious!"</color>, she will regain 20 Nightsoul points. If there is no <color=#FFD780FF>Turbo Twirly</color> belonging to her on the field, she will enter Nightsoul's Blessing and summon one.

constellations.name: Improved Stabilizer
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Go, Go Turbo Twirly!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: More Foes, More Caution
constellations.description: When there are 1/2/3/4 (or more) opponents within the Turbo Drill Field created by <color=#FFD780FF>"Time to Get Serious!"</color>, the active character within the field gains 8%/12%/16%/20% increased DEF.

constellations.name: All I've Collected Till Now
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Time to Get Serious!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: This Time, I've Gotta Win
constellations.description: When your active character's Shield is replaced or destroyed for any reason, Kachina will deal 200% of her DEF as <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
