constellations.name: Parrot's Beak
constellations.description:
After Kinich lands from <color=#FFD780FF>Canopy Hunter: Riding High</color>'s mid-air swing, his Movement SPD will increase by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, Scalespiker Cannon's CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.

constellations.name: Tiger Beetle's Palm
constellations.description:
When Kinich's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, it will decrease their <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, the first Scalespiker Cannon Kinich fires after entering Nightsoul's Blessing has increased AoE, and its DMG increases by 100%.

constellations.name: Protosuchian's Claw
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Canopy Hunter: Riding High</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Hummingbird's Feather
constellations.description:
When in Nightsoul's Blessing, Kinich will restore 5 Energy after using his Loop Shots or after unleashing the Scalespiker Cannon. Energy can be regenerated this way once every 2.8s.
Additionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord</color> deals 70% more DMG.

constellations.name: Howler Monkey's Tail
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Auspicious Beast's Shape
constellations.description:
After Scalespiker Cannon hits an opponent, it will bounce between opponents once, dealing 700% of Kinich's ATK as <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color>.
If this Scalespiker Cannon triggers the buffs that Ascension Talent "Flame Spirit Pact" or the Constellation "Tiger Beetle's Palm" grant to the Cannon, the bouncing attack will also obtain the relevant buffs.

constellations.name: The Leisurely "Meztli"...
constellations.description:
The DMG dealt by the first Sharky's Surging Bite after Mualani enters Nightsoul's Blessing and the Shark Missiles it triggers is increased by 66% of Mualani's Max HP. This instance of increased DMG is subject to the diminishing DMG rules of <color=#FFD780FF>Surfshark Wavebreaker</color>.
In addition, while out of combat, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing state consumes 30% less Phlogiston and Nightsoul points.

constellations.name: Mualani, Going All Out!
constellations.description:
Mualani gains 2 of <color=#FFD780FF>Surfshark Wavebreaker</color>'s Wave Momentum stacks when she enters Nightsoul's Blessing state. She will gain 1 stack when obtaining a Puffer.
In addition, whenever Mualani obtains 2 Puffers within a single instance of the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will recover an additional 12 Nightsoul points over 2s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."

constellations.name: Surfing Atop Joyous Seas
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Surfshark Wavebreaker</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sharky Eats Puffies
constellations.description:
Mualani regenerates 8 Energy when obtaining a Puffer. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."
Additionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Boomsharka-laka</color> deals 75% increased DMG.

constellations.name: Same Style of Surfboard on Sale!
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Boomsharka-laka</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Spirit of the Springs' People
constellations.description: The DMG increase from the Constellation "The Leisurely 'Meztli'..." is no longer limited to being triggered once every Nightsoul's Blessing.

constellations.name: Sabbatical Phrase
constellations.description:
Xilonen's Nightsoul point and Phlogiston consumption in her Nightsoul's Blessing state is decreased by 30%, and her Nightsoul point time limit is extended by 45%.
Additionally, when Xilonen's Source Samples are active, she can also increase nearby active characters' interruption resistance.

constellations.name: Chiucue Mix
constellations.description:
Xilonen's <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> Source Samples will always remain active. Additionally, when her Source Samples activate, all nearby party members will gain effects corresponding to the active Source Sample that matches their Elemental Type:
·<color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color>: DMG dealt +50%.
·<color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>: ATK +45%.
·<color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>: Max HP +45%.
·<color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>: CRIT DMG +60%.
·<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>: Restore 25 Energy, decrease Elemental Burst CD by 6s.

constellations.name: Tonalpohualli's Loop
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Yohual's Scratch</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Suchitl's Trance
constellations.description:
After Xilonen uses <color=#FFD780FF>Yohual's Scratch</color>, she will grant all nearby party members the Blooming Blessing effect for 15s.
Characters with Blooming Blessing deal 65% of Xilonen's DEF as increased Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG. This effect will be removed after triggering 6 times or when the duration ends.
When you hit more than one opponent, trigger counts will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit. The counts for each party member with Blooming Blessing are counted independently.

constellations.name: Tlaltecuhtli's Crossfade
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Ocelotlicue Point!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Imperishable Night Carnival
constellations.description:
When Xilonen is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, when she sprints, leaps, or uses Normal or Plunging Attacks, she will gain Imperishable Night's Blessing, ignoring the limitations of her Nightsoul's Blessing state and increasing the DMG dealt by her Normal and Plunging Attacks for 5s.
During this time:
·Her Nightsoul's Blessing time limit countdown will be paused. Xilonen's Nightsoul points, Phlogiston, and Stamina will not decrease, and when her Nightsoul points reach the maximum, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will not end either.
·Xilonen deals 300% of her DEF as increased Normal and Plunging Attack DMG while in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
·She heals nearby party members for 120% of her DEF every 1.5s.
She can gain 1 Imperishable Night's Blessing once every 15s.

constellations.name: Cylinder, the Restless Roulette
constellations.description:
When triggering the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick"'s "Spiritbinding Conversion," the 2nd <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowhunt Shell</color> loaded into the cylinder will be additionally converted into a <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Shadowhunt Shell</color>.
The chance to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" is increased: If there are party members who meet the Elemental Conversion Type requirements, the chance to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" is increased by 33.3%, up to a maximum of 100%.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick."
In addition, Chasca's Nightsoul point and Phlogiston consumption in her Nightsoul's Blessing state is decreased by 30% while out of combat.

constellations.name: Muzzle, the Searing Smoke
constellations.description:
When Chasca takes the field, she will obtain 1 stack of "Spirit of the Radiant Shadow" from the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick" for this effect.
In addition, when the <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Shadowhunt Shells</color> from <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt</color>'s <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color> hit opponents, they will deal AoE Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type of the <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Shadowhunt Shells</color> equal to 400% of Chasca's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once each time Chasca uses <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color>.

constellations.name: Reins, Her Careful Control
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sparks, the Sudden Shot
constellations.description:
When the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiant Soulseeker Shells</color> from <color=#FFD780FF>Soul Reaper's Fatal Round</color> hit opponents, they will restore 1.5 Elemental Energy to Chasca, and deal AoE Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type of the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiant Soulseeker Shells</color> equal to 400% of Chasca's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
The aforementioned corresponding elemental AoE DMG effect can be triggered once each time Chasca uses <color=#FFD780FF>Soul Reaper's Fatal Round</color>.

constellations.name: Brim, the Sandshadow's Silhouette
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Soul Reaper's Fatal Round</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Showdown, the Glory of Battle
constellations.description:
Chasca's <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color> charge time is decreased, and after the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick"'s "Spiritbinding Conversion" is triggered, Chasca will gain the "Fatal Rounds" state: For the next 3s, the next time Chasca uses <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt</color>'s <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color>, the shots will finish charging instantly, and the CRIT DMG of that instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Multitarget Fire</color>'s <color=#FFD780FF>Shadowhunt Shells</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Shining Shadowhunt Shells</color> increases by 120%. 1 "Fatal Rounds" effect can be gained once every 3s.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick" to gain access to the above effect.

constellations.name: Trails Amidst the Forest Fog
constellations.description:
The Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Night's Sling</color>'s <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Orb</color> can bounce 2 additional times.
Additionally, after the <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Orb</color> hits an opponent, it will apply the Nighttide effect to them for 12s. Opponents affected by Nighttide take 50% increased DMG from Hypersense triggered by the Ascension Talent, "Nightshade Synesthesia." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."

constellations.name: King Bee of the Hidden Honeyed Wine
constellations.description:
After using his Elemental Burst, <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color>, Ororon will obtain the Spiritual Supersense effect for 9s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Spiritual Supersense</color>
Gain 8% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color>.
Additionally, during this time, every additional opponent hit by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Supersonic Oculus</color> will grant Ororon a further 8% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color>. The maximum that can be gained this way is 32% <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG Bonus</color>.

constellations.name: Roosting Bat's Spiritcage
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: As the Mysteries of the Night Wind
constellations.description:
The <color=#FFD780FF>Supersonic Oculus</color> summoned by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color> rotates 25% faster.
Additionally, Ororon will restore 8 Energy to himself after using <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color>.

constellations.name: A Gift For the Soul
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Night's Sling</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Ode to Deep Springs
constellations.description:
After triggering Hypersense through the Ascension Talent, Nightshade Synesthesia, your current active character's ATK is increased by 10% for 9s. Max 3 stacks, each stack is counted independently.
Additionally, when you use the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Dark Voices Echo</color>, you will trigger one instance of an effect equivalent to Hypersense, dealing 200% of its original DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."

constellations.name: The Night-Lord's Explication
constellations.description:
Mavuika's maximum Nightsoul points are increased to 120, and she gains Fighting Spirit 25% more efficiently.
Additionally, she gains 40% ATK for 8s after gaining Fighting Spirit.

constellations.name: The Ashen Price
constellations.description:
When in the Nightsoul's Blessing State, Mavuika's Base ATK is increased by 200, and she obtains the following effects based on All-Fire Armaments' form:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: Nearby opponents' DEF is decreased by 20%.
· Flamestrider: Mavuika's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and her Sunfell Slice from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color> deal 60%, 90%, and 120% of her ATK as increased DMG respectively.

constellations.name: The Burning Sun
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Leader's Resolve
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent "Kiongozi":
The DMG increase gained after using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hour of Burning Skies</color> will not decay over time, and an additional 10% DMG Bonus will be gained.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Kiongozi."

constellations.name: The Meaning of Truth
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>The Named Moment</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Humanity's Name" Unfettered
constellations.description:
The All-Fire Armaments from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>The Named Moment</color> receive all-round improvements:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: When the Ring's attacks hit opponents, a Flamestrider will crash into the struck opponent, dealing 200% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color>.
· Flamestrider: When Mavuika is riding the Flamestrider, she will also summon a Scorching Ring of Searing Radiance to follow her, which will decrease nearby opponents' DEF by 20% and deal 500% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> to nearby opponents once every 3s. Mavuika's terrain-crossing abilities will also be further improved.

Additionally, when Mavuika is riding her Flamestrider and is not in combat, when her Nightsoul points drop to 5, she will gain 80 Nightsoul points. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

constellations.name: Radiant Blades of Centzon Mimixcoah
constellations.description:
When she uses the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color>, Citlali gains the "Opalstar Vestments" effect until Itzpapa leaves the field. During this time, she will obtain 10 stacks of Stellar Blade. When a nearby active character other than Citlali deals DMG using Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts, 1 stack of Stellar Blade will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
After nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, Citlali will gain another 3 stacks of Stellar Blade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.

Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> will reset Stellar Blade stacks.
Additionally, when Citlali is using her leap, or is Aiming or using her Charged Attack in mid-air, her Phlogiston consumption is decreased by 45%.

constellations.name: Heart Devourer's Travail
constellations.description:
Citlali gains 125 Elemental Mastery, and other characters shielded by her Opal Shield, or who have Itzpapa following them, gain 250 Elemental Mastery.
Additionally, when the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is used, nearby active characters will also be granted an Opal Shield.

Also, the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" has its effects enhanced:
While Itzpapa is on the field, after nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, the opponent(s) affected by this reaction will have their <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color> and <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> RES additionally decreased by 20% for 12s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" to gain access to the above effect.

constellations.name: Cloud Serpent's Feathered Crown
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Death Defier's Spirit Skull
constellations.description: While the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is active, when Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm hits opponents, an additional <color=#FFD780FF>Obsidian Spiritvessel Skull</color> will be summoned. When a Spiritvessel Skull summoned this way explodes, it deals 1800% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery as Nightsoul-aligned <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> and restores 16 Nightsoul points and 8 Energy for Citlali. This effect can trigger once every 8s. This DMG is not considered Elemental Burst DMG.

constellations.name: Nemontemi's Hex
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Edict of Entwined Splendor</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Teoiztac's Secret Pact
constellations.description:
After being summoned with the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color>, Itzpapa will always be in the Opal Fire state, and when Nightsoul points are exhausted, this state will not end.
Additionally, when <color=#FFD780FF>Dawnfrost Darkstar</color> is used, Itzpapa will consume all Nightsoul points, and while it is on the field, it will continuously consume Nightsoul points. Each Nightsoul point consumed in this way will grant Citlali 1 "Cifra of the Secret Law" point.
A maximum of 40 such points can be gained, and each point Citlali possesses will grant all nearby party members a 1.5% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color> and <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> DMG Bonus, and increase the DMG Citlali deals by 2.5%.
When Itzpapa leaves the field, or upon using Citlali's Elemental Skill again, all "Cifra of the Secret Law" points she has will be removed.

constellations.name: "As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds"
constellations.description:
After triggering the Elemental Absorption from the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms," this instance of Lan Yan's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> will produce another Feathermoon Ring when they are thrown at opponents.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms."

constellations.name: "Dance Vestments Billow Like Rainbow Jade"
constellations.description: While the <color=#FFD780FF>Swallow-Wisp Shield</color> is active, when your active party member's Normal Attacks deal DMG, 40% of the Shield's DMG absorption will be restored, up to its original maximum absorption. This effect can occur once every 2s.

constellations.name: "On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "With Drakefalcon's Blood-Pearls Adorned"
constellations.description: After Lan Yan uses her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Lustrous Moonrise</color>, the Elemental Mastery of all nearby party members increases by 60 for 12s.

constellations.name: "Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lustrous Moonrise</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Let Us Away on Sylphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> gains 1 additional charge.

constellations.name: In Mist-Like Waters
constellations.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to nearby opponents for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent has a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction triggered against them by Anemo DMG while the aforementioned effect is active, the effect will be canceled, and this Swirl or Stellar Swirl instance deals DMG against this opponent increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, respectively.

constellations.name: Your Echo I Meet in Dreams
constellations.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki enters the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point she has will increase all nearby party members' <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>, and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> DMG Bonuses by 0.04% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.

constellations.name: Till Dawn's Moon Ends Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Buds Warm Lucid Springs
constellations.description: Picking up a <color=#FFD780FF>Yumemi Style Special Snack</color> from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Anraku Secret Spring Therapy</color> will both deal DMG and heal, and will restore 5 Energy to Yumemizuki Mizuki. Energy can be restored this way 4 times per <color=#FFD780FF>Anraku Secret Spring Therapy</color> duration.

constellations.name: As Setting Moon Brings Year's End
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Anraku Secret Spring Therapy</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Heart Lingers Long
constellations.description: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. Any Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by these characters will also have its CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG increased by 10% and 20%, respectively.

constellations.name: Starting's Never Easy
constellations.description: When Iansan is in combat and is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will restore 15 Elemental Energy for every 6 Nightsoul points she consumes. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

constellations.name: Laziness is the Enemy!
constellations.description: When using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>The Three Principles of Power</color>, Iansan will also gain the Precise Movement effect from her Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" for 15s. Additionally, if Iansan is off-field while Precise Movement is active, she will also increase your current active character's ATK by 30%. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" to access the above effect.

constellations.name: Scientific Diet Planning
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderbolt Rush</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Slow and Steady Wins the Race
constellations.description:
When the Kinetic Energy Scale is present, Iansan will gain 2 stacks of Surging Force after your current active character (excluding herself) uses their Elemental Burst. The stacks last until the Scale leaves the field, and Surging Force can be gained once per Scale summoning. Whenever Iansan restores Nightsoul points via the Scale, she will consume 1 Surging Force stack and restore 4 additional Nightsoul points.
Additionally, if her Nightsoul restoration from the Scale overflows, Iansan will gain 50% of the overflow the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale.

constellations.name: We Can Push It Further!
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>The Three Principles of Power</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Teachings of the Collective of Plenty
constellations.description:
The Kinetic Energy Scale's duration is increased by 3s.
Additionally, when Iansan triggers Nightsoul point restoration, if there is any overflow, she will gain the Extreme Force effect, which increases the DMG dealt by your current active character by 25% for 3s.

constellations.name: Undying Passion
constellations.description:
The effects of the Ascension Talent "Tag-Team Triple Jump!" are enhanced:
When performing the Special Plunging Attack "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," Varesa will also gain "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
When "Rainbow Crash" is in effect, Varesa's Plunging Attack ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK, whether she is in the Fiery Passion state or not. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tag-Team Triple Jump!" to access the above effect.

Additionally, when Varesa is in the Sudden Onrush mode of her Nightsoul's Blessing, she consumes 30% less Nightsoul points or Phlogiston.

constellations.name: Beyond the Edge of Light
constellations.description:
Varesa will enter Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack, regardless of whether she is in the Fiery Passion state or not.
When Apex Drive is active, Varesa's interruption resistance will also further increase.
Additionally, Varesa will restore 11.5 Energy when her Plunging Attack ground impact hits an opponent.

constellations.name: Unbowed Resolve
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Guardian Vent!</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Courage to Press On
constellations.description:
Varesa will receive various buffs based on her state when using her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Guardian Vent!</color> If Varesa:
· Has neither Fiery Passion nor Apex Drive active, she will gain Diligent Refinement for 15s, which will increase her Plunging Attack ground impact DMG by 500% of her ATK, with a maximum increase of 20,000 DMG. This effect will be canceled once the ground impact hits an opponent, or if its duration ends.
· If she has either Fiery Passion or Apex Drive active, this instance of her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Guardian Vent!</color> deals 100% increased DMG.

constellations.name: Thoughts Floating on the Warm Breeze
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack: By the Horns</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: A Hero of Justice's Triumph
constellations.description:
Varesa restores 30 Energy when she enters Apex Drive.
Her Plunging Attacks and Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Guardian Vent!</color> gain 10% CRIT Rate and 100% CRIT DMG.
Additionally, when Varesa uses the Hold version of her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Riding the Night-Rainbow</color>, or Taps her Elemental Skill while in the Sudden Onrush mode, she will restore Nightsoul points up to her maximum.

constellations.name: Pre-Dinner Dance for Your Taste Buds
constellations.description:
When 4 party members are <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>, all nearby party members will have their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> CRIT DMG increased by 60% for 15s after Escoffier uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11122}Low-Temperature Cooking{/LINK}</color> or Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11125}Scoring Cuts{/LINK}</color>.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning."

constellations.name: Fresh, Fragrant Stew Is an Art
constellations.description:
When Escoffier activates her Cooking Mek in its {LINK#N11120001}<color=#FFD780FF>Cold Storage Mode</color>{/LINK}, she will gain the "Freshly-Prepped Delicacy" effect for 15s. During this time, Escoffier will gain 5 Cold Dish stacks. When nearby active characters apart from Escoffier deal <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> with a Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attack, or an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they will expend 1 Cold Dish stack to increase their DMG dealt by 240% of Escoffier's ATK.
If you hit multiple opponents with a single instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>, Cold Dish stacks will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit.

constellations.name: The Bakery Magic of Caramel Browning
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11122}Low-Temperature Cooking{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Secret Rosemary Recipe
constellations.description:
{LINK#P1122101}<color=#FFD780FF>Rehab Diet</color>{/LINK} lasts 6 more seconds. While it is active, you have a chance of healing 100% extra HP and restoring 2 Energy to Escoffier when you trigger healing through <color=#FFD780FF>Rehab Diet</color>. This chance corresponds to Escoffier's CRIT Rate. You can trigger this effect 7 times during any one <color=#FFD780FF>Rehab Diet</color>'s duration.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Better to Salivate Than Medicate."

constellations.name: Symphony of a Thousand Sauces
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11125}Scoring Cuts{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Tea Parties Bursting With Color
constellations.description:
{LINK#N11120001}<color=#FFD780FF>Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode</color>{/LINK} is enhanced:
· When your party's active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode will fire off another Special-Grade Frosty Parfait, dealing 500% of Escoffier's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, and this effect can be triggered 6 times within the duration of one Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode.

constellations.name: Vitiferous Elixir's Concoction
constellations.description: When {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent, it will restore 6 Energy for Ifa. One such Energy restoration can be triggered once every 8s.

constellations.name: Guiding Spirit of Ballistic Prayer
constellations.description:
When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every Nightsoul point the party has above a total of 60 will grant Ifa 4 additional {LINK#N11130002}<color=#FFD780FF>Rescue Essentials</color>{/LINK} points.
Additionally, Ifa's Rescue Essentials limit is increased by 50.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent {LINK#P1132101}<color=#FFD780FF>Field Medic's Vision</color>{/LINK}.

constellations.name: Rebuttal in Negotiations With the Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11132}Airborne Disease Prevention{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Decayed Vessel's Permutation
constellations.description:
The restraining wind current created by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}Compound Sedation Field{/LINK}</color> has its duration extended to 3s.
Additionally, Ifa gains 100 Elemental Mastery for 15s after using his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Compound Sedation Field</color>.

constellations.name: Vow of Universal Coexistence
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11135}Compound Sedation Field{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Oath on a Feathered Knot
constellations.description:
When Ifa uses the Hold version of his {LINK#N11130001}<color=#FFD780FF>Supporting Fire</color>{/LINK}, there is a 50% chance that he will fire an additional Tonicshot that deals 120% of Ifa's ATK as Anemo DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
Additionally, when he is not in combat, Ifa will consume 20% less Nightsoul points and Phlogiston in his Nightsoul's Blessing state.

constellations.name: Far to Fall
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130007}<color=#FFD780FF>Reason Beyond Reason</color>{/LINK}: Every Void Rift absorbed will summon a crystal blade to attack nearby opponents, dealing 500% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason.

constellations.name: Into the Abyss
constellations.description:
After unleashing her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Warp</color>, Skirk will gain 10 additional {LINK#N11130005}<color=#FFD780FF>Serpent's Subtlety</color>{/LINK} points.
When using her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Ruin</color>, the DMG of this Elemental Burst instance will be increased by taking up to 10 more Serpent's Subtlety points into account.
Additionally, within 12.5s after Skirk unleashes the special Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Extinction</color> while in her {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode, her ATK is increased by 70%. This effect will be canceled when she leaves the Seven-Phase Flash mode.

constellations.name: Serendipitous Sin
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11145}<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Ruin</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Fractured Flow
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130008}<color=#FFD780FF>Return to Oblivion</color>{/LINK}: Each Death's Crossing stack also increases Skirk's ATK by 10%/20%/40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Return to Oblivion.

constellations.name: End of Wishes
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11142}<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Warp</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To the Source
constellations.description:
Each Void Rift Skirk absorbs via the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#N11130007}<color=#FFD780FF>Reason Beyond Reason</color>{/LINK} will grant her 1 Havoc: Sever stack. She can consume such stacks to initiate coordinated attacks and decrease the DMG she takes while in {LINK#N11130006}<color=#FFD780FF>Seven-Phase Flash</color>{/LINK} mode. These stacks last for 15s, and each stack's duration is counted independently (max 3 stacks).
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Reason Beyond Reason."

<color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color>
· When Skirk uses the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Ruin</color>, she will consume all <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stacks to initiate a coordinated attack in which each <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will deal 750% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
· When she uses Normal Attacks while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will be consumed when her third or fifth sequenced attacks hit an opponent to launch 3 coordinated attacks. Each coordinated attack deals 180% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This damage is considered Normal Attack DMG.
· When Skirk takes DMG while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Havoc: Sever</color> stack will be consumed to decrease this DMG instance by 80% and attack nearby opponents 3 times, with each attack dealing 180% of Skirk's ATK as <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.

constellations.name: Infallible Procession
constellations.description: Each time Dahlia gains 1 of his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Benison stacks, he will regain 2.5 Elemental Energy.

constellations.name: Revelation of Mercy
constellations.description: After Dahlia consumes his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Benison stacks to summon a Shield of Sacred Favor, the character protected by said Shield will gain 25% increased Shield Strength for 12s.

constellations.name: Windblume Offertory
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Collect of the Assembly
constellations.description: The Favonian Favor from Dahlia's Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color> lasts 3 more seconds.

constellations.name: Let It Be Subtly So
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11152}Immersive Ordinance{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: You Shall Go Out With Joy
constellations.description:
The current active character affected by the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11155}Radiant Psalter{/LINK}</color>'s Favonian Favor has their ATK SPD increased by 10%.
Additionally, when an active character affected by Favonian Favor falls, immediately:
· Revive them.
· Restore their HP to 100%.
This effect can trigger once every 15 minutes.

constellations.name: Rectifying Processor
constellations.description: When Ineffa activates her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, all nearby party members will gain the Carrier Flow Composite effect for 20s: Increases Lunar-Charged DMG by 2.5% for every 100 ATK that Ineffa has, up to a maximum of 50%.

constellations.name: Support Cleaning Module
constellations.description:
After the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11165}Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator{/LINK}</color> hits opponents, it will inflict the Punishment Edict status on one of those hit opponents: After a brief delay, or when this opponent is defeated, nearby opponents will take <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 300% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Additionally, when the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator</color> is unleashed, nearby party members will gain Optical Flow Shield Barriers.

constellations.name: Enhanced Emotion Emulator
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11162}Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Edictless Path
constellations.description: When your own party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, recover 5 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 4s.

constellations.name: Mirror's Dream Transcension
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11165}Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: A Dawning Morn for You
constellations.description: When Ineffa is affected by the Carrier Flow Composite effect, she will deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 135% of her ATK to opponents in the current active character's vicinity after nearby thunderclouds release bursts of lightning at opponents. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 3.5s.

constellations.name: "O Lips, Weave Me Songs and Psalms"
constellations.description:
After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color> or her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11195}Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon{/LINK}</color>, she will gain Threads of Life for 20s.
During this time, when nearby party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, nearby active characters will recover HP equal to 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 1.9s.
Additionally, the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form will be reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration will be extended by 5s.

constellations.name: "Twine Warnings and Tales From the North"
constellations.description:
The Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11195}Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon{/LINK}</color> is enhanced:
· {LINK#N11190003}<color=#FFD780FF>Pale Hymn</color>{/LINK} effects are increased: All nearby party members' Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG is further increased by 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery, and their Lunar-Bloom DMG is further increased by 400% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is increased by 40%.

constellations.name: "Seek Not to Tread the Sly Fox's Path"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11195}Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Nor Yearn for the Great Bear's Might"
constellations.description: When attacks from the {LINK#N11190001}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostgrove Sanctuary</color>{/LINK} summoned by her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color> hit opponents, Lauma will regain 4 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellations.name: "If Truth May Be Subject to Witness"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight"
constellations.description:
When the {LINK#N11190001}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostgrove Sanctuary</color>{/LINK} attacks opponents, it will deal 1 additional instance of <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> equal to 185% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. This instance of DMG will not consume any {LINK#N11190003}<color=#FFD780FF>Pale Hymn</color>{/LINK} stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner.
This effect can occur up to 8 times during each Frostgrove Sanctuary. When using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11192}Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko{/LINK}</color>, all Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner will be removed.

Additionally, when Lauma uses a Normal Attack while she has Pale Hymn stacks, she will consume 1 stack to convert this to deal <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> equal to 150% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%.

constellations.name: Part the Veil of Snow
constellations.description:
The basic cooldown of the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color> is reduced to 4s.
Additionally, when party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, Flins will recover 8 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 5.5s.

constellations.name: The Devil's Wall
constellations.description:
For the next 6s after using the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Northland Spearstorm</color>, when Flins's next Normal Attack hits an opponent, it will deal an additional 50% of Flins's ATK as <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: While Flins is on the field, after his <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> attacks hit an opponent, that opponent's <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> will be decreased by 25% for 7s.

constellations.name: Stranger in the Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11205}<color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Night on Bald Mountain
constellations.description:
Flins's ATK is increased by 20%.
Additionally, his Ascension Talent {LINK#P1202201}<color=#FFD780FF>Whispering Flame</color>{/LINK} is enhanced: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 10% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 220.

constellations.name: Exile's Shadow
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11202}<color=#FFD780FF>Ancient Rite: Arcane Light</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Songs and Dances of Death
constellations.description:
The DMG dealt to opponents by Flins's Lunar-Charged reactions is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 35%.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: All nearby party members' Lunar-Charged DMG is <color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color> by 10%.

constellations.name: The Theory of Ash—Field Equilibrium
constellations.description:
After Aino uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11212}Musecatcher{/LINK}</color> or her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color>, her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s.

The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.

constellations.name: The Principle of Transference in Gear Differentials
constellations.description: If Aino is off-field while the <color=#FFD780FF>Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone</color> of her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color> is active, when your active party member hits a nearby opponent with an attack, the <color=#FFD780FF>Cool Your Jets Ducky</color> will fire an additional water ball at that opponent, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> equal to 25% of Aino's ATK and 100% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellations.name: Cake and the Art of Mechanism Repair
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Butter and Cats and the Law of Energy Supply
constellations.description: When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11212}Musecatcher{/LINK}</color> hits an opponent, it will restore 10 Elemental Energy for Aino. Energy can be restored to her in this manner once every 10s.

constellations.name: Perpetual Turbine of Metal and Light
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11212}Musecatcher{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Burden of Creative Genius
constellations.description:
For the next 15s after using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11215}Precision Hydronic Cooler{/LINK}</color>, DMG from nearby active characters' Electro-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize reactions is increased by 15%.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: DMG from the aforementioned reactions will be further increased by 20%.

constellations.name: Planning Breeds Success
constellations.description: The Base DMG for Lunar-Bloom reactions caused by Nefer's {LINK#N11220002}<color=#FFD780FF>Phantasm Performance</color>{/LINK} is increased by 60% of her Elemental Mastery. This effect is also boosted by {LINK#N11220003}<color=#FFD780FF>Veil of Falsehood</color>{/LINK}.

constellations.name: Observation Feeds Strategy
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent {LINK#P1222101}<color=#FFD780FF>A Wager of Moonlight</color>{/LINK}: Extends {LINK#N11220003}<color=#FFD780FF>Veil of Falsehood</color>{/LINK}'s duration by 5s, and increases its stack limit to 5, as well as causing {LINK#N11220002}<color=#FFD780FF>Phantasm Performance</color>{/LINK} to deal up to 140% of its original DMG. When Nefer unleashes her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11222}Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights{/LINK}</color>, she will instantly gain 2 stacks of Veil of Falsehood. Additionally, when Veil of Falsehood reaches 5 stacks, or when the fifth stack's duration is refreshed, Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 200 for 8s instead.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "A Wager of Moonlight."

constellations.name: Deceit Cloaks the Truth
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11222}Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Delusion Ensnares Reason
constellations.description:
When Nefer is on the field and in the {LINK#N11220001}<color=#FFD780FF>Shadow Dance</color>{/LINK} state, you will gain Verdant Dew 25% faster.
Additionally, while Nefer is in the Shadow Dance state, nearby opponents will have their <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro RES</color> decreased by 20%. When Nefer exits the Shadow Dance state or after she strays a certain distance away from the opponents, this effect will be removed after 4.5s.

constellations.name: Opportunity Hides in the Margins
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11225}Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Victory Flows from the Turning of Tides
constellations.description:
When Nefer unleashes {LINK#N11220002}<color=#FFD780FF>Phantasm Performance</color>{/LINK}, the second stage of DMG dealt by herself will be converted to deal <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> equal to 85% of her Elemental Mastery. Additionally, when the attacks from Phantasm Performance end, an extra instance of <color=#99FF88FF>AoE Dendro DMG</color> equal to 120% of Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be dealt. All of the aforementioned DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG dealt by Phantasm Performance.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>
Nefer's Lunar-Bloom DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 15%.

constellations.name: Adamah's Redemption
constellations.description:
After casting his Elemental Burst, Durin's effects will vary depending on the form of his Elemental Burst:
· <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color>: All other nearby party members gain 20 stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Cycle of Enlightenment</color> lasting 20s. When nearby active characters deal Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst DMG, 1 stack of Cycle of Enlightenment will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 60% of Durin's ATK. Stack counts for characters in the party who have Cycle of Enlightenment are managed individually.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder</color>: Durin gains 20 stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Cycle of Enlightenment</color> lasting 20s. When Durin deals Elemental Burst DMG, 2 stacks of Cycle of Enlightenment will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Durin's ATK.

When an Elemental Burst is used, <color=#FFD780FF>Cycle of Enlightenment</color> stacks will be refreshed.

constellations.name: Unground Visions
constellations.description: For 20s after Durin uses an Elemental Burst, after nearby party members trigger Vaporize, Melt, Burning, Overloaded, Pyro Swirl, or Pyro Crystallize reactions, or deal <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> or <color=#99FF88FF>Dendro DMG</color> to an opponent affected by Burning, all nearby party members gain a 50% increase to their <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> and to the corresponding elemental DMG involved in the reaction for 6s.

constellations.name: Flame Mirror's Revelation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11235}Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Emanare's Source
constellations.description: Durin's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 40%. Additionally, when effects that consume <color=#FFD780FF>Cycle of Enlightenment</color> stacks are triggered as part of the Constellation <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#T1231}Adamah's Redemption{/LINK}</color>, there is a 30% chance that no Cycle of Enlightenment stacks will be consumed.

constellations.name: Scouring Flame's Sundering
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11232}Binary Form: Convergence and Division{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Dual Birth
constellations.description:
Durin's Elemental Burst DMG ignores 30% of opponents' DEF.
Additionally, Durin's Elemental Bursts <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder</color> are each enhanced:
· After <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of White Flame</color> hit an opponent, that opponent's DEF is decreased by 30% for 6s.
· DMG from <color=#FFD780FF>Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Dragon of Dark Decay</color> will ignore an additional 40% of opponents' DEF.

constellations.name: One More Flask!
constellations.description: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Fluffy Meowball</color> fired by the {LINK#N11240001}<color=#FFD780FF>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils</color> hits an enemy, there is a 50% chance for it to bounce, dealing the corresponding Elemental DMG to nearby opponents.

constellations.name: Rogue's Quick Thinking
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: In the Ascension Talent {LINK#P1242101}<color=#FFD780FF>"Plan to Get Paid,"</color>{/LINK} Jahoda can secretly track, in addition to the element with the highest number of characters, the element with the next highest number of characters among the remaining types. This allows up to two elemental effects to be active at once. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Plan to Get Paid."

constellations.name: Desperate Gamble
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11245}Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Wild Berry Amid the Dust
constellations.description: When a {LINK#N11240002}<color=#FFD780FF>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter</color> undergoes an Elemental Conversion, Jahoda will recover 4 Elemental Energy.

constellations.name: The Greatest Treasure
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11242}Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Littlest Luck
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: After the {LINK#N11240001}<color=#FFD780FF>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color>{/LINK} from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils</color> is full, nearby Moonsign characters in your party have their CRIT Rate increased by 5% and CRIT DMG increased by 40% for 20s.

constellations.name: Radiance Over Blossoms and Peaks
constellations.description:
Unleashing her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Eternal Tides</color> will immediately trigger an effect equivalent to the effect of {LINK#N11250001}<color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Interference</color>{/LINK}. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>
When Gravity Interference is triggered, if the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Charged</color>: Your current active character will recover 6 Energy.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Bloom</color>: Your active character's interruption resistance will be increased for 8s.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Crystallize</color>: Summons a <color=#FFD780FF>Rainsea Shield</color>. The Rainsea Shield's DMG absorption is based on 12% of Columbina's Max HP, and it will absorb <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness for 8s.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 1.5%.

constellations.name: Not in Lone Splendor
constellations.description:
Rate of accumulating {LINK#N11250001}<color=#FFD780FF>Gravity</color>{/LINK} increases by 34%. 
When <color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Interference</color> is triggered, Columbina will receive the <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Brilliance</color> effect, which increases her Max HP by 40% for 8s.
<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Brilliance</color> is active, if, during the current trigger of <color=#FFD780FF>Gravity Interference</color>, the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Charged</color>: ATK of your current active character increases. Increase in ATK is equal to 1% of Columbina's Max HP.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Bloom</color>: Elemental Mastery of your current active character increases. Increase in Elemental Mastery is equal to 0.35% of Columbina's Max HP.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar-Crystallize</color>: DEF of your current active character increases. Increase in DEF is equal to 1% of Columbina's Max HP.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 7%.

constellations.name: Dreamlike Glow Across Tranquil Waters
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11252}Eternal Tides{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 1.5%.

constellations.name: Cloudveiled Ridges in Floral Mists
Silence Tending One Lone Song
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11255}Moonlit Melancholy{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 1.5%.

constellations.name: Through Darkness Led by Moonlight
constellations.description:
For 8s after characters in the {LINK#N11250002}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Domain</color>{/LINK} trigger a Lunar reaction, based on the elements involved in the reaction, the CRIT DMG of the corresponding Elemental DMG done by all party members is increased by 80%. The CRIT DMG-increasing effects for the same Elemental Type do not stack.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 7%.

constellations.name: Burst Forth With Vigor, But Enter in Silence
constellations.description:
After using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color>, Zibai will immediately gain 100 {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color>{/LINK}, and the max number of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> usages per <color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color> mode is increased to 5 times.
Additionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.

constellations.name: At Birth Are Souls Born, and in Death Leave But Husks
constellations.description:
When in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1262101}The Selenic Adeptus Descends{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Selenic Adeptus Descends."

constellations.name: Free From Constraints and Worldly Ties
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11262}Heaven and Earth Made Manifest{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Spirit Passes, Then Form Follows
constellations.description: While in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> hits opponents, Zibai will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>"Scattermoon Splendor"</color> effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

constellations.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11265}Tri-Sphere Eminence{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The World, A Journey in Passing
constellations.description:
While Zibai is in the {LINK#N11260001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lunar Phase Shift</color>{/LINK} mode, her <color=#FFD780FF>Phase Shift Radiance</color> gain rate is increased by 50%.
Additionally, <color=#FFD780FF>Spirit Steed's Stride</color> will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevate</color>{/LINK} the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.

constellations.name: Vigilant Sentinel
constellations.description: After Illuga triggers a <color=#FFE699FF>Geo-related Reaction</color> on the field, he will regain 12 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s.

constellations.name: Elk With Fanged Antlers
constellations.description: When Elemental Burst {LINK#S11275}<color=#FFD780FF>Shadowless Reflection</color>{/LINK}'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, for every 7 stacks of {LINK#N11270001}<color=#FFD780FF>Nightingale's Song</color>{/LINK} consumed, Illuga will summon Aedon, dealing a single instance of <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> to 1 nearby opponent. The DMG dealt is based on 400% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery and 200% of his DEF. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

constellations.name: Earthshaking Maw
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Solarhunting Wolf
constellations.description: When Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11275}Shadowless Reflection{/LINK}</color>'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, nearby active party members will have their DEF increased by 200.

constellations.name: Hurricane Steed
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11272}Dawnbearing Songbird{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Nightmare Orioles
constellations.description:
Enhances the Lightkeeper's Oath effect of the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1272101}Torchforger's Covenant{/LINK}</color>: For <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color> dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, CRIT DMG is increased by 30%.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam:</color>
When characters are affected by Lightkeeper's Oath, Elemental Mastery is increased by 80.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "<color=#FFD780FF>Torchforger's Covenant</color>."

constellations.name: "Come, Friend, Let Us Dance Beneath the Moon's Soft Glow"
constellations.description:
When Varka switches to {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK}, he will obtain an additional use of the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}.
Additionally, after switching to <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, Varka will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Lyrical Libation</color> effect: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>, or when performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, Varka will consume this effect to deal 200% of the original DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>.

constellations.name: "When Dawn Breaks, Our Journey Shall Take Flight"
constellations.description: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, or when performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, Varka will perform an additional strike, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> equal to 800% of Varka's ATK.

constellations.name: "O Friend, Quaff Not the Bitter Wine That Brings Tears of Woe"
constellations.description:
Increases Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11282}Windbound Execution{/LINK}</color> Level by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "For None May Take From Us Our Freedom of Song"
constellations.description: When Varka triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, based on the Elemental Types involved in the reaction, all nearby party members gain a 20% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> and the corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.

constellations.name: "Fill High the Cup With Fine Wine, for Tyrants Come and Go"
constellations.description:
Increases Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11285}Northwind Avatar{/LINK}</color> Level by 3.
 Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Beloved Mondstadt, Steadfast You Shall Shine"
constellations.description:
{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} is enhanced:
· For a short time after unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, Tapping on Varka's Elemental Skill or Holding his Normal Attack will not expend any uses of Four Winds' Ascension, and will perform one additional instance of the special Charged Attack, <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>.
· For a short time after performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, tap on Varka's Elemental Skill to unleash an additional instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> without expending any uses of Four Winds' Ascension.
When triggering an additional special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, or unleashing an additional special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, in this manner, the above effect cannot be triggered.

Additionally, the <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> effect in Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1282201}Wind's Vanguard{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: Every stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> will increase Varka's CRIT DMG by 20%.

constellations.name: O Breezes, That So Oft Bear Sorrowful Lament
constellations.description:
Lohen's maximum {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} limit is increased to 300% of its original value.
Additionally, when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, they accumulate 500% as much <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color> for him as they originally would have.

constellations.name: In Flight, I Strike Whatever Flies
constellations.description: When in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, after the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> is unleashed, Lohen gains "Evilsbane Blade" for 4s: The next time Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will follow up with an additional strike that deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> equal to 500% of his ATK, and increase the Elemental Mastery of other nearby party members by 200 for 8s. Evilsbane Blade can be triggered once every 4s.

constellations.name: Only the Spear That Wounds Can Heal
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11292}Unforeseen Strike{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Radiant Love, Laughing Death
constellations.description:
When Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> while in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, his {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} will be maxed out, causing this instance of his Elemental Burst to gain the maximum possible DMG increase.

Additionally, when Lohen switches to <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> mode, the following will occur depending on how much Elemental Energy he has:
· When Elemental Energy is not full: Lohen recovers 15 Elemental Energy.
· When Elemental Energy is full: If, during the next 15s, Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color>, he will recover 15 Elemental Energy.

constellations.name: Never Ask, Nor Trouble You to Know
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11295}Manifest Judgment{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Drown, to Sink, Unconscious — Supreme Joy
constellations.description:
Using the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} and hitting an opponent with it or, while {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode is active, unleashing the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color>, will not consume any {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK}. Instead, Lohen's {LINK#N11290003}<color=#FFD780FF>Joy</color>{/LINK} will be maxed out, and if he hits an opponent the next time he uses the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>, the duration of this instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> will be extended by 1.25s. This effect can be triggered once every 7s.
Additionally, the CRIT DMG of all the DMG described above is increased by 175%, and the number of times Lohen can unleash <color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color> during this instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> is increased by 2.

constellations.name: Provisional Classification
constellations.description:
When unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color>, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea gains 6 stacks of the <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color> effect for 10s. Max 18 stacks. When nearby party members deal Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, consume 1 stack of Field Catalog to increase the DMG dealt. The increase in DMG is equal to 75% of Linnea's DEF.
Additionally, when Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}</color>, Linnea can consume up to 5 stacks of Field Catalog. Each stack will increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Linnea's DEF.

constellations.name: Tidings of Joy and Sorrow
constellations.description:
Within 8s after triggering Moondrift Harmony, all <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> and <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party members have their CRIT DMG increased by 40%. Additionally, when Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}</color>, the CRIT DMG of that attack increases by an additional 150%. 

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: When Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Heavy Overdrive Hammer</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}</color>, or when she uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her Ultimate Power Form, an instance of Moondrift Harmony will be triggered. For this instance of Moondrift Harmony, all <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> and <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> characters in the party will be considered to have applied their Elements in the reaction.

constellations.name: Eventful Log Page
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Expert Instinct
constellations.description: Within 5s after Moondrift Harmony is triggered, increase the DEF of Linnea and your current active character by 25% respectively. When Linnea is on field, the DEF-increasing effect can be stacked.

constellations.name: Fairyland's Farewell Gift
constellations.description:
Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions{/LINK}</color> increases by 3 Levels.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Golden Beagle's Dream
constellations.description:
The effects of the Constellation, <color=#FFD780FF>Provisional Classification</color>, are enhanced: When unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color>, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea will directly gain the maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color> stacks. When consuming <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color>, consume twice the original number of stacks, such that the increase in DMG will be boosted to 150% of the original value.

<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%.

constellations.name: "Do Not Be Afraid, Child Who Is Loved"
constellations.description:
When the current active character of your own in the party hits an opponent, an additional special "Arcane Projection: Unity" will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type at 600% of their ATK. This DMG will be considered as having been dealt by the corresponding character.
This effect can trigger once every 6s.

constellations.name: "I Will Guide You and Show You the Path You Should Tread"
constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11312}Revelation: Uncreated Light{/LINK}</color>: {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK} increases ATK by an additional 300 (which does not count toward this effect's ATK Bonus limit), while {LINK#N11310002}<color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>{/LINK} decreases nearby opponents' Elemental RES based on the corresponding character's Elemental Type by 25%. This effect does not stack for the same Element.
Additionally, when Nicole unleashes her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Revelation: Uncreated Light</color>, nearby active party members will also gain a Shield of Blazing Light.

constellations.name: "A Lamp by Your Side, A Light to Shine the Way"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11312}Revelation: Uncreated Light{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Whether Left or Right, No Matter Which Way You Turn"
constellations.description:
When nearby party members have their {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK} upgraded to {LINK#N11310002}<color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>{/LINK}, Nicole also bestows upon them the Pathfinder's Blessing effect for 20s. Each character can gain this effect once every 16s.
The Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG of characters with Pathfinder's Blessing is increased by 70% of Nicole's ATK. This effect will be removed once it has taken effect 8 times or when its duration is over.
When multiple opponents are hit at once, instances of Pathfinder's Blessing are consumed equal to the number of opponents hit. Each character's Pathfinder's Blessing is counted independently.

constellations.name: "You Will Hear My Voice Beside You"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11315}Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "This Is the Path, Walk It Without Delay"
constellations.description:
When Nicole's {LINK#N11310001}<color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>{/LINK} is upgraded to {LINK#N11310002}<color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>{/LINK}, all nearby party members' <color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color> will also be upgraded to <color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color>. Once upgraded, <color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color> will no longer revert to <color=#FFD780FF>Grace of Kenosis</color>.
Additionally, DMG dealt by characters with <color=#FFD780FF>Guidance of Theosis</color> will ignore 40% of opponents' DEF.

constellations.name: With a Vow to Rescue, the Journey Begins
constellations.description: After the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, Prune will regain 2 Energy. This effect can occur once every 1.8s.

constellations.name: Useful for Cleaning Messy Baggage, Elemental Powers Are Indeed
constellations.description:
During the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color>, when the Witchlure Bell is in Hunter-Seeker mode, Prune gains the Hunt the Witch effect: Prune's ATK increases by 10%, and when the Witchlure Bell and the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it further increases her ATK by 5%. Prune's ATK can be increased by up to 40% in this way.
The original instance of the above effect will be removed if "The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!" is used again during this time.

constellations.name: The Caravan Exits the Mountain Pass, the Scenery Once More Changed
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Looking Back Following the Wind, One's Shadow Still Halved
constellations.description: After the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it will ricochet and land on a nearby opponent, dealing 80% ATK as DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type.

constellations.name: 100 Defeats? No Problem, Tomorrow, We Go Again
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11322}Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: And That's the Story! Share It With Your Friends!
constellations.description:
The duration of the Witchlure Bell's Hunter-Seeker mode from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color> is extended by 4s.
Additionally, after party members affected by Tolling Rally trigger any Elemental Reaction, they will cause Prune and the other current active character(s) affected by Tolling Rally to gain 350 ATK for 5s.

constellations.name: Morrow After the Golden Dusk
constellations.description: When in <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> increases at a 50% lower rate, and all party members deal 30% increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

constellations.name: An Heiress Gazed Into the Looking-Glass
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: Increases CRIT DMG from Charged Attack condensed beams by 40%. Also, each time a beam is fired, CRIT DMG dealt by all condensed beams fired during this <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode period will be further increased by 20%. Max 3 stacks.

constellations.name: Refuse the Wake of Dusk, the Moonlit Yoke
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of {LINK#S11331}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: In Knowledge Lies the World's True Ground
constellations.description: When Sandrone deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, she will also summon an extra Prismatic Resonance Cannon to fire off a coordinated attack which deals <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> at 125% or 187.5% of her ATK, respectively. This DMG is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, and the effect can occur once every 4s.

constellations.name: Of All Beside, She Takes No Part
constellations.description:
