Increases the Level of {LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Narcissus Wakes, Her Eyes Upon the Dawn
constellations.description:
When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode, the beam becomes a more powerful <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> at 100% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> attack deals 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. The DMG dealt with this attack, which is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, is equal to:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: 80% of Sandrone's ATK.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: 120% of Sandrone's ATK.
Additionally, all Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Sandrone is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 20%.

constellations.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing
constellations.description:
The maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> additionally creates 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color>.
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.
Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

constellations.name: The Matter That Slumbers Beyond Inertness
constellations.description:
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, all opponents within the <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color> have their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> decreased by 20%.
Additionally, if the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> created is:
·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery;
·Overloaded: Your own active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.

constellations.name: The Knotted String of Invariant Topology
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11362}<color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Isotopes Born of Decay
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Cores{/LINK}</color> created by Mitya himself deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 300% of Mitya's Elemental Mastery to nearby opponents for every 5 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> consumed while it is on the field. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

constellations.name: The Periodic Law That Orders All
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: {LINK#S11361}<color=#FFD780FF>Chain Reaction</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Elemental Transition at the Gate of Reason
constellations.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is enhanced. If the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color>:
 · Is in the Steady State: <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> deals 115% of its original DMG.
· Is Overloaded: There is a 34% chance to create 1 new <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color> whenever Mitya consumes a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> with the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11190007}Elevated{/LINK}</color> by 20%.

constellations.name: The Cadence of Suppressive Fire
constellations.description:
Valeriy regenerates 6 Elemental Energy after performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>. For every 10 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> consumed beyond 40 when performing this special Charged Attack, he regenerates an additional 1.5 Elemental Energy. Each time he performs <color=#FFD780FF>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</color>, he can regenerate up to 15 Elemental Energy in this way. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Additionally, each time Valeriy enters combat, the first time he uses his Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color>, he gains an additional amount of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> equal to 150% of the amount normally gained.

constellations.name: Ranks That Charge as One
constellations.description:
All nearby party members gain 100 Elemental Mastery for 18s after Valeriy uses his Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, while protected by a Supercharged Shield, if Valeriy is already at maximum <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, any further <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> he would gain is instead converted into increased DMG Absorption for the shield. Each point of excess <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> increases the Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption by an amount equal to 8% of Valeriy's ATK. Up to 20 excess <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> can be converted in this way.

constellations.name: Vigilance at Close Quarters
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30601}Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Fortitude Unshaken by Attrition
constellations.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>'s limit is increased by 30, and its charging efficiency is increased by 30%.
Additionally, the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1372101}Advance With the Creeping Barrage{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: The maximum amount of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> that can be gained from this Talent after using the Elemental Burst is 104. You must unlock the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>Advance With the Creeping Barrage</color> to gain access to this effect.

constellations.name: Resolve to Divide and Destroy
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Strength to Breach Enemy Lines
constellations.description: The special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shells</color> from Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30605}Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo{/LINK}</color> are enhanced: Their DMG is increased by 100%, and opponents they hit have the CRIT Rate of <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> they take increased by 10% for 7s. If the <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> taken is Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, that DMG instance's CRIT DMG is also increased by 40%.

constellations.name: Waters in Full Splendor
constellations.description: Each time Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color>, it also increases the ATK of all nearby party members by 0.8% of her Max HP for 5s.

constellations.name: Echoes That Pierce the Snow
constellations.description:
When the <color=#FFD780FF>Horn of Spring's Call</color> from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> attacks the opponent, Vodyanitsa gains the "Two Voices in Black and White" effect which increases the CRIT DMG from <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> dealt by your own currently active party member by 50% for 5s.
If there is a Wandering Vortex present on the field or in the 5s after a Wandering Vortex explodes, the effect changes to: increases the CRIT DMG from Stellar Swirl reaction DMG caused by your own currently active party member by 60% for 5s.
Additionally, the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is enhanced as follows: the duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is extended by 9s.

constellations.name: Song Lingering on a Spring Morning
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Melancholic Voice Upon the Gentle Waters
constellations.description:
When Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color>, an additional effect will be triggered based on the healed character's HP.
· If the character's HP is below 40%: The healing is increased by 50%; and
· If the character's HP is 40% or above: Vodyanitsa's Max HP is increased by 20% for 6s. Max 3 stacks, and each stack's duration is counted independently.

constellations.name: Together, Down Into the Deep
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11405}Koda: Sink With Thee{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Neverending Song of Revelry
constellations.description:
The Constellation <color=#FFD780FF>Echoes That Pierce the Snow</color> is enhanced: "Two Voices in Black and White" now applies to all nearby party members.
Additionally, while the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is active, Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25% while <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> dealt are increased by 60%.

constellations.name: Winter's Farewell Feast
constellations.description:
When in the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430001}Armed for Action{/LINK}</color> mode, Vesna can unleash <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430003}Windborne Sword{/LINK}</color> at the highest level 4 times instead of 3. Also, each time she enters the <color=#FFD780FF>Armed for Action</color> mode, she will not consume <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430002}Sword Essence{/LINK}</color> the first time she uses <color=#FFD780FF>Windborne Sword</color> at the highest level.
Additionally, Vesna deals 20% increased Stellar Swirl reaction DMG when in the <color=#FFD780FF>Armed for Action</color> mode.

constellations.name: Kolo of Spring's Arrival
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1432101}Rite of Spring's Procession{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: Vesna gains the maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>Disciplinary Action</color> stacks when she enters <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430001}Armed for Action{/LINK}</color> mode. Vesna's ATK is increased by 40% when she has maximum <color=#FFD780FF>Disciplinary Action</color> stacks.
You must unlock the Ascension Talent "Rite of Spring's Procession" to gain access to the above effects.

constellations.name: Winter's Last Offering
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11432}The Art of Victory{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Glory to Our Forebears
constellations.description: The Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1432201}Truth Prevails{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: Its ATK and Elemental Mastery bonuses increase to 3 times their original values.

constellations.name: The Nobleborn's Charge
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11435}For the Tsaritsa!{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Unwavering Ardor
constellations.description:
Tapping on Normal Attack or Elemental Skill in the 5s after Vesna uses <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430003}Windborne Sword{/LINK}</color> at its highest level will unleash the secret Vila ability <color=#FFD780FF>Windborne Sword: Transpose</color>, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> at 150% of Vesna's ATK as well as summoning <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430004}Spirit Blades{/LINK}</color> which deal an additional instance of <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> at 200% of Vesna's ATK. If Vesna is in the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11430001}Armed for Action{/LINK}</color> mode, she will also summon a wind pinion to perform Coordinated Attacks against opponents.
Additionally, Vesna's Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 20%.

constellations.name: Frostvale Thunderclap
constellations.description: Alyosha regenerates 15 Elemental Energy when nearby party members trigger an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related reaction</color> on an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

constellations.name: Howl From Afar
constellations.description:
The duration of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> is extended by 6s.
Additionally, each time {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks the opponent, he will also apply the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to a target. This effect does not activate existing <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Marks</color>.

constellations.name: Friendly Call
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderbolt Strike</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Harvest the Spoils
constellations.description: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, he will also restore 60% of Alyosha's ATK as HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP by percentage.

constellations.name: When the Nightbird Falls Silent
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Standard Reclaimed
constellations.description: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained from activating a {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} can now stack, max 2 stacks. When the stack count reaches 2, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> will also have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100 if they are on the field.

constellations.name: "On This Danceless Morn, She Gazes at Her Reflection"
constellations.description:
After unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}, at the dance duet's end Odette will deal an additional instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo AoE DMG</color> to nearby opponents that is considered:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 300% of Odette's ATK;
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 450% of Odette's ATK.

Additionally, the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is also enhanced: now, when the {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} is summoned, Odette also gains 2 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}. When Odette is off-field, the rate at which <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> is removed is sped up to 2 stacks per second.

constellations.name: "I Must See the Snow Swan's Unseen Dream for Myself, She Thought"
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: every stack of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} active also increases the character's ATK by 7%.
Additionally, if Odette is in the {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK} state when there is a {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} on the field, opponents near the <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> will also have their corresponding Elemental RES lowered by 20%.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color>.

constellations.name: "I'll Chase the Shouting Wind Along, Climbing Alone As I Go"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11502}Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue"
constellations.description:
The Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color> is enhanced as follows: when Odette obtains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other nearby party members is increased by 50% of <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan Dream</color>'s effects.

Additionally, when a party member deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to an opponent, Odette will also join in with a coordinated attack, dealing an instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. This effect, which can trigger once every 3.5s, will be considered:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 66% of Odette's ATK.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 99% of Odette's ATK.

constellations.name: "Oh! I Have Slipped the Surly Bonds of Earth"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11505}Presto: Bluebird Finale{/LINK} </color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Put Out My Hand, and Touched the Face of the Divine"
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: When Odette grants {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} to all nearby party members, her own Marvelous Splendor stacks will no longer decrease.
Additionally, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> have their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt to opponents {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%, and Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Odette is elevated by an additional 20%.

constellations.name: Starfire's Flowing Light
constellations.description: While <color=#FFD780FF>Blazing Threshold</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Scorching Threshold</color> are active, the current active character deals 6% increased DMG. If said character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, they will deal an additional 9% DMG.

constellations.name: Ever-Lit Candle
constellations.description: Within 12s of using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Flowfire Blade</color>, after nearby party members trigger a <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro-related reaction</color> on an opponent, the Traveler will regain 14 Nightsoul points. Each use of <color=#FFD780FF>Flowfire Blade</color> will restore at most 28 Nightsoul points in this way.

constellations.name: Relayed Beacon
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Flowfire Blade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Ravaging Flame
constellations.description: After using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Plains Scorcher</color>, the Traveler gains 20% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color> for 9s.

constellations.name: The Fire Inextinguishable
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Plains Scorcher</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Sacred Flame Imperishable
constellations.description: While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Traveler's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to Nightsoul-aligned <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> that cannot be overridden, and the CRIT DMG of these attacks is increased by 40%.

constellations.name: Invincible Stonewall
constellations.description: Party members within the radius of <color=#FFD780FF>Wake of Earth</color> have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption.

constellations.name: Rockcore Meltdown
constellations.description: When the meteorite created by <color=#FFD780FF>Starfell Sword</color> is destroyed, it will also explode, dealing additional <color=#FFE699FF>AoE Geo DMG</color> equal to the amount of damage dealt by Starfell Sword.

constellations.name: Will of the Rock
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Wake of Earth</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Reaction Force
constellations.description:
The shockwave triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Wake of Earth</color> regenerates 5 Energy for every opponent hit.
A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

constellations.name: Meteorite Impact
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Starfell Sword</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Everlasting Boulder
constellations.description:
The barrier created by <color=#FFD780FF>Wake of Earth</color> lasts 5s longer.
The meteorite created by <color=#FFD780FF>Starfell Sword</color> lasts 10s longer.

constellations.name: Swelling Lake
constellations.description:
Picking up a Sourcewater Droplet will restore 2 Energy to the Traveler.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Spotless Waters."

constellations.name: Trickling Purity
constellations.description: The Movement SPD of <color=#FFD780FF>Rising Waters</color>' bubble will be decreased by 30%, and its duration increased by 3s.

constellations.name: Turbulent Ripples
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Aquacrest Saber</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Pouring Descent
constellations.description:
When using <color=#FFD780FF>Aquacrest Saber</color>, an Aquacrest Aegis that can absorb 10% of the Traveler's Max HP in DMG will be created and will absorb <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> with 250% effectiveness. It will persist until the Traveler finishes using the skill.
Once every 2s, after a Dewdrop hits an opponent, if the Traveler is being protected by Aquacrest Aegis, the DMG Absorption of the Aegis will be restored to 10% of the Traveler's Max HP. If the Traveler is not presently being protected by an Aegis, one will be redeployed.

constellations.name: Churning Whirlpool
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Rising Waters</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Tides of Justice
constellations.description: When the Traveler picks up a Sourcewater Droplet, they will restore HP to a nearby party member with the lowest remaining HP percentage based on 6% of said member's Max HP.

constellations.name: Spring Thunder of Fertility
constellations.description: The number of Abundance Amulets that can be generated using <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Blade</color> is increased to 3.

constellations.name: Violet Vehemence
constellations.description: When Falling Thunder created by <color=#FFD780FF>Bellowing Thunder</color> hits an opponent, it will decrease their <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> by 15% for 8s.

constellations.name: Distant Crackling
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Bellowing Thunder</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Fickle Cloudstrike
constellations.description: When a character obtains Abundance Amulets generated by <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Blade</color>, if this character's Energy is less than 35%, the Energy restored by the Abundance Amulets is increased by 100%.

constellations.name: Clamor in the Wilds
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lightning Blade</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: World-Shaker
constellations.description: Every 2 Falling Thunder attacks triggered by <color=#FFD780FF>Bellowing Thunder</color> will greatly increase the DMG dealt by the next Falling Thunder, which will deal 200% of its original DMG and will restore an additional 1 Energy to the current character.

constellations.name: Raging Vortex
constellations.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Palm Vortex</color> pulls in opponents and objects within a 5m radius.

constellations.name: Uprising Whirlwind
constellations.description: Increases Energy Recharge by 16%.

constellations.name: Sweeping Gust
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Gust Surge</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Cherishing Breezes
constellations.description: Reduces DMG taken while casting <color=#FFD780FF>Palm Vortex</color> by 10%.

constellations.name: Vortex Stellaris
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Palm Vortex</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Intertwined Winds
constellations.description:
Targets who take DMG from <color=#FFD780FF>Gust Surge</color> have their <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.

constellations.name: Somber Freeze
constellations.description: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

constellations.name: Frostfall Reverberation
constellations.description:
The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an <color=#FFD780FF>ice crystal</color> fired by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.

constellations.name: Glacial Shard
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Enduring Ice
constellations.description: The duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> created by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> is increased by 25%.

constellations.name: Bittercold Fog
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Brumal Grimfrost
constellations.description: Every stack of {LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostglow</color>{/LINK} consumed when using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. A maximum 40% increase can be obtained in this way.
